Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib.

Require Import Coq.Relations.Relation_Operators Coq.Relations.Operators_Properties Coq.Classes.RelationClasses.

Reserved Notation "e ↦ e'" (at level 70).

Inductive head_step : expr ∅ → expr ∅ → Prop :=
| LamBetaRec e v : (rec e) v ↦ subst (Inc := inc) ((subst (Inc := inc) e) (shift v)) (rec e)
| LamBetaE e v : (ƛ e) v ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| LamBetaT e : e_tapp (Λ e) ↦ e
| LamBetaC e : e_capp (ƛᶜ e) ↦ e
| ProjLE v1 v2 : e_proj L ⟨v1, v2⟩ ↦ v1
| ProjRE v1 v2 : e_proj R ⟨v1, v2⟩ ↦ v2
| CaseLE v e1 e2 : e_case (v_inj L v) e1 e2 ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e1 v
| CaseRE v e1 e2 : e_case (v_inj R v) e1 e2 ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e2 v
| UnpackE v e : e_unpack (v_pack v) e ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| UnrollE v : e_unroll (v_roll v) ↦ v
| WithE v e : e_lwith ⟨v⟩ᶜ e ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| BindE e' (v : value ∅) : v >>= e' ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e' v
| BindE' e e' e'' : e' ↦ e'' -> e_bind e' e ↦ e_bind e'' e
where "e ↦ e'" := (head_step e%syn e'%syn).

Definition step := clos_refl_trans_1n (expr ∅) head_step.

Notation "e ↦* e'" := (step e%syn e'%syn) (at level 70).

Definition safe (e : expr ∅) :=
  forall e', e ↦* e' -> (∃ v, e' = e_val v) \/ (exists e'', e' ↦ e'').

Inductive nsteps : nat -> expr ∅ -> expr ∅ -> Prop :=
| nsteps_step ρ :
  nsteps 0 ρ ρ
| nsteps_l n ρ1 ρ2 ρ3 :
  head_step ρ1 ρ2 ->
  nsteps n ρ2 ρ3 →
  nsteps (S n) ρ1 ρ3.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Coq.Lists.List.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Set.

Require Import Binding.Env.

Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Reserved Notation "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ" (at level 70, Ψ, Γ, e at level 60).

Reserved Notation "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ" (at level 70, Ψ, Γ, v at level 60).

Inductive typing_expr {V : Set} (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> (typ ⋆ Δ)) :
  expr V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| T_val {τ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ v : τ
| T_bind  {τ₁ τ₂ e₁ e₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e₁ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e₂ : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e₁ >>= e₂ : τ₂
| T_congE {τ τ' e} : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ'
| T_app  τ₁ τ₂ v₁ v₂ :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₂ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ v₁ v₂ : τ₂
| T_tapp {κ τ σ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ∀ᵗ κ , τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_tapp v : subst τ σ
| T_projL {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ × τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_proj L v : τ₁
| T_projR {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ × τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_proj R v : τ₂
| T_abort {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} {v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ⊥ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_abort v : τ
| T_case {τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ} {τ} {v e₁ e₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e₁ : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₂ ⊢ₑ e₂ : τ ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ + τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_case v e₁ e₂ : τ
| T_unpack {κ} {τ τ'} {v e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ∃ᵗ κ , τ ->
  extC κ Δ ∣ map shift Ψ ∣ shift • Γ ▹ τ ⊢ₑ e : shift τ' ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_unpack v e : τ'
| T_unroll κ τ σ₁ σ₂ (HF : rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂) v :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : σ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_unroll v : σ₂
| T_cabort {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} {ψ}  :
  Ψ ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_cabort : τ
| T_capp {φ τ} {v} :
  Ψ ⊩ φ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : φ →ᶜ τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_capp v : τ
| T_lwith {φ τ} {σ : typ ⋆ Δ} {v e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : φ ×ᶜ σ -> Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ σ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_lwith v e : τ
where "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ" := (typing_expr Δ Ψ%typ Γ%typ e%syn τ%typ)
with typing_val {V : Set} (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> (typ ⋆ Δ)) : value V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| T_var {x τ} (EQ : Γ x = τ) : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_var x : τ
| T_congV {v τ τ'} : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ'
| T_unit : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨⟩ : ⊤
| T_lam {τ₁ τ₂ e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ƛ e : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂
| T_pair {τ₁ τ₂ v₁ v₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₂ : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ : τ₁ × τ₂
| T_injl {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_inj L v : τ₁ + τ₂
| T_injr {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_inj R v : τ₁ + τ₂
| T_tlam {κ τ e} :
  extC κ Δ ∣ map shift Ψ ∣ compose shift Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ Λ e : ∀ᵗ κ, τ
| T_pack κ {τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)} {τ' : typ κ Δ} {v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : subst τ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_pack v : ∃ᵗ κ, τ
| T_roll κ τ σ₁ σ₂ (HF : rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂) v :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : σ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_roll v : σ₁
| T_lamC {φ τ} {e} :
  Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ƛᶜ e : φ →ᶜ τ
| T_withC {φ τ} {v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Ψ ⊩ φ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨v⟩ᶜ : φ ×ᶜ τ
| T_rec {τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ} {e : expr (inc (inc V))} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ (τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂) ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ (v_fix e) : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂
where "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ" := (typing_val Δ Ψ%typ Γ%typ v%syn τ%typ).

Section ExampleClosedVoid.

Definition ntarr : typ ⋆ (extC (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) (extC ⋆ mtC)) :=
    (0ᵛ (t_var _ (VS VZ : dom (extC _ (extC _ _))) eq_refl) →ᵗ ⊥)%typ.

Definition eqA : constr (extC (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) (extC ⋆ mtC)) :=
    (tc_all ⋆ 0ᵛ ≃ t_var _ (VS VZ : dom (extC _ (extC _ _))) eq_refl)%typ.

Arguments ntarr : simpl never.

Arguments eqA : simpl never.

Definition tloop : typ ⋆ (extC ⋆ mtC) :=
    (∃ᵗ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆, eqA ×ᶜ ntarr)%typ.

Definition ltl := (∀ᵗ ⋆, tloop)%typ.

Definition foo : value ∅ :=
    v_lam (e_unpack (v_var VZ)
             (e_lwith (v_var VZ)
                (e_app (v_var VZ) (v_pack (v_withC (v_var VZ)))))).

Definition nt : expr ∅ := e_app foo (v_pack (v_withC foo)).

Definition δε {Δ : Ctx kind} : Intrinsic.Arr mtC Δ := {| Intrinsic.apply_arr (x : dom mtC) := match x with end;
                                                          Intrinsic.arr_hom (x : dom mtC) := match x with end |}.

End ExampleClosedVoid.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Set Binding.Auto.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Types.

Import DED_kind.

Inductive ax := L | R.

Inductive value {V : Set} :=
| v_var (x : V) : value
| v_unit : value
| v_lam (e : @expr (inc V)) : value
| v_pair (v₁ v₂ : value) : value
| v_inj (a : ax) (v : value) : value
| v_tlam (e : expr) : value
| v_pack (v : value) : value
| v_roll (v : value) : value
| v_lamC  (e : expr) : value
| v_withC (v : value) : value
| v_fix (e : @expr (inc (inc V))) : value
with expr {V : Set} :=
| e_val (v : value) : expr
| e_bind (e₁ : expr) (e₂ : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_app (v₁ v₂ : value) : expr
| e_tapp (v : value) : expr
| e_proj (a : ax) (v : value) : expr
| e_abort (v : value) : expr
| e_case (v : value) (e₁ e₂ : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_unpack (v : value) (e : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_unroll (v : value) : expr
| e_cabort : expr
| e_capp (v : value) : expr
| e_lwith (v : value) (e : @expr (inc V)) : expr.

Arguments value V%bind : clear implicits.

Arguments expr  V%bind : clear implicits.

Declare Scope syn_scope.

Delimit Scope syn_scope with syn.

Coercion e_val : value >-> expr.

Coercion e_app : value >-> Funclass.

Notation "e₁ >>= e₂" := (e_bind e₁ e₂) (at level 45, right associativity) : syn_scope.

Notation "'ƛ' e" := (v_lam e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨⟩" := v_unit : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨ v ⟩ᶜ" := (v_withC v) : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨ v₁ , v₂ ⟩" := (v_pair v₁ v₂) : syn_scope.

Notation "'Λ' e" := (v_tlam e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "'ƛᶜ' e" := (v_lamC e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "'rec' e" := (v_fix e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Local Open Scope bind_scope.

Local Open Scope syn_scope.

Fixpoint emap {A B : Set} (f : A [→] B) (e : expr A) : expr B :=
  match e with
  | e_val v => vmap f v
  | e₁ >>= e₂ => emap f e₁ >>= emap (f ↑) e₂
  | e_app v₁ v₂ => (vmap f v₁) (vmap f v₂)
  | e_tapp v => e_tapp (vmap f v)
  | e_proj x v => e_proj x (vmap f v)
  | e_abort v => e_abort (vmap f v)
  | e_case v e₁ e₂ => e_case (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e₁) (emap (f ↑) e₂)
  | e_unpack v e => e_unpack (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e)
  | e_unroll v => e_unroll (vmap f v)
  | e_cabort => e_cabort
  | e_capp v => e_capp (vmap f v)
  | e_lwith v e => e_lwith (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e)
  end
with vmap {A B : Set} (f : A [→] B) (v : value A) : value B :=
       match v with
       | v_var x => v_var (f x)
       | ƛ e => ƛ (emap (f ↑) e)
       | Λ e => Λ (emap f e)
       | ⟨⟩ => ⟨⟩
       | ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ⟨vmap f v₁, vmap f v₂⟩
       | v_inj x v => v_inj x (vmap f v)
       | v_pack v => v_pack (vmap f v)
       | v_roll v => v_roll (vmap f v)
       | ƛᶜ e => v_lamC (emap f e)
       | ⟨v⟩ᶜ => ⟨vmap f v⟩ᶜ
       | rec e => rec (emap ((f ↑) ↑) e)
       end.

#[export] Instance FMap_expr : FunctorCore expr := @emap.

#[export] Instance FMap_val  : FunctorCore value := @vmap.

#[export] Instance SPC_val : SetPureCore value := @v_var.

Fixpoint ebind {X Y : Set} (f : X [⇒] Y) (e : expr X) : expr Y :=
  match e with
  | e_val v => vbind f v
  | e₁ >>= e₂ => ebind f e₁ >>= ebind (f ↑) e₂
  | e_app v₁ v₂ => (vbind f v₁) (vbind f v₂)
  | e_tapp v => e_tapp (vbind f v)
  | e_proj x v => e_proj x (vbind f v)
  | e_abort v => e_abort (vbind f v)
  | e_case v e₁ e₂ => e_case (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e₁) (ebind (f ↑) e₂)
  | e_unpack v e => e_unpack (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e)
  | e_unroll v => e_unroll (vbind f v)
  | e_cabort => e_cabort
  | e_capp v => e_capp (vbind f v)
  | e_lwith v e => e_lwith (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e)
  end
with vbind {X Y : Set} (f : X [⇒] Y) (v : value X) : value Y :=
       match v with
       | v_var x => f x
       | ƛ e => ƛ (ebind (f ↑) e)
       | Λ e => Λ (ebind f e)
       | ⟨⟩ => ⟨⟩
       | ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ⟨vbind f v₁, vbind f v₂⟩
       | v_inj x v => v_inj x (vbind f v)
       | v_pack v => v_pack (vbind f v)
       | v_roll v => v_roll (vbind f v)
       | ƛᶜ  e => ƛᶜ (ebind f e)
       | ⟨v⟩ᶜ => ⟨vbind f v⟩ᶜ
       | rec e => rec (ebind ((f ↑) ↑) e)
       end.

#[export] Instance BindCore_expr : BindCore expr := @ebind.

#[export] Instance BindCore_val  : BindCore value := @vbind.

184	| tpi_lam {κₐ κᵣ} {τ₁ τ₂ : typ κᵣ (Δ ▹ κₐ)} (HP : map shift Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂) :

186	| tpi_app {κₐ κᵣ} {σ₁ σ₂ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ} {τ₁ τ₂}

193	| tpi_cprod {ψ τ₁ τ₂} (HP : Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂) :

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Auto.

Require Import FOmegaEq.Kinds.

Inductive type {Δ : Ctx kind} : kind → Type :=
| t_var κ (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ) : type κ
| t_lam {κₐ κᵣ} (τ : @type (Δ ▹ κₐ) κᵣ) : type (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)
| t_app {κₐ κᵣ} (σ : type (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)) (τ : type κₐ) : type κᵣ
| t_ctor {κ} (c : tctor κ) : type κ
| t_carr  (ψ : constr) (τ : type ⋆) : type ⋆
| t_cprod (ψ : constr) (τ : type ⋆) : type ⋆
with constr {Δ : Ctx kind} : Type :=
| c_eq (κ : kind) (τ₁ τ₂ : type κ) : constr.

Arguments type Δ : clear implicits.

Arguments constr Δ : clear implicits.

Require Import Basics.

Definition typ := flip type.

Declare Scope typ_scope.

Delimit Scope typ_scope with typ.

Coercion t_ctor : tctor >-> type.

Coercion t_app : type >-> Funclass.

Definition rec_type (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ)) : typ κ Δ
  := (tc_rec κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_arr {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_arr τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_prod {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_prod τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_sum {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_sum τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_all {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_all κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_xist {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_xist κ) (t_lam τ).

Notation "'ƛ' τ" := (t_lam τ : typ _ _) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "σ →ᵗ τ" := (t_arr σ τ) (at level 55, right associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ + τ₂" := (t_sum τ₁ τ₂) (at level 50, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ × τ₂" := (t_prod τ₁ τ₂) (at level 40, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "χ →ᶜ τ" := (t_carr χ τ) (at level 55, right associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "χ ×ᶜ τ" := (t_cprod χ τ) (at level 40, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ ≃ τ₂" := (c_eq _ τ₁ τ₂) (at level 65, no associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "∀ᵗ κ , τ" := (t_all κ τ) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "∃ᵗ κ , τ" := (t_xist κ τ) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "⊥" := tc_void : typ_scope.

Notation "'⊤'" := tc_unit : typ_scope.

Notation "'0ᵛ'" := (t_var _ (VZ : dom (_ ▹ _)) eq_refl).

Local Open Scope bind_scope.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Fixpoint tmap {κ} {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (δ : Δ₁ [→] Δ₂) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) : typ κ Δ₂ :=
  match τ with
  | t_var κ x EQ => t_var κ (δ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom δ x) EQ)
  | t_lam τ => ƛ tmap (δ ↑) τ
  | t_app σ τ => (tmap δ σ) (tmap δ τ)
  | t_ctor c  => c
  | φ →ᶜ τ => cmap δ φ →ᶜ tmap δ τ
  | φ ×ᶜ τ => cmap δ φ ×ᶜ tmap δ τ
  end
with cmap {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (δ : Δ₁ [→] Δ₂) (φ : constr Δ₁) : constr Δ₂ :=
  match φ with
  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tmap δ τ₁) (tmap δ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance IPC_typ : IntPureCore (λ κ, typ κ) := @t_var.

#[export] Instance FMap_typ {κ} : FunctorCore (typ κ) := @tmap κ.

#[export] Instance FMap_constr : FunctorCore constr := @cmap.

Fixpoint tbind {κ} {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : Δ₁ [⇒] Δ₂) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) : typ κ Δ₂ :=
  match τ with
  | t_var κ x EQ  => ρ κ x EQ
  | t_lam τ     => ƛ (tbind (ρ ↑) τ)
  | t_app σ τ   => (tbind ρ σ) (tbind ρ τ)
  | t_ctor c    => c
  | t_carr  φ τ => cbind ρ φ →ᶜ tbind ρ τ
  | t_cprod φ τ => cbind ρ φ ×ᶜ tbind ρ τ
  end
with cbind {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : Δ₁ [⇒] Δ₂) (φ : constr Δ₁) : constr Δ₂ :=
  match φ with
  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tbind ρ τ₁) (tbind ρ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance BindT {κ} : BindCore (typ κ) := @tbind κ.

#[export] Instance BindC : BindCore constr := @cbind.

Inductive rel_app {Δ : Ctx kind} (κ₁ : kind) (σ₁ σ₂ : typ κ₁ Δ) : ∀ κ₂, typ κ₂ Δ → typ κ₂ Δ → Prop :=
| rel_app_refl : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κ₁ σ₁ σ₂
| rel_app_app {κₐ κᵣ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ) (τ : typ κₐ Δ)
    (HF : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) τ₁ τ₂) :
  rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κᵣ (τ₁ τ) (τ₂ τ).

Require Import List.

Inductive tctd {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ} : typ κ Δ → ∀ {κ'}, tctor κ' → Prop :=
| inj_ctor c : tctd (t_ctor c) c
| inj_app {κₐ κ'} (σ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κ) Δ) τ (c : tctor κ') (HI : tctd σ c) : tctd (σ τ) c.

Inductive cdiscr : ∀ {κ}, tctor κ → tctor κ → Prop :=
| cd_unit_void : cdiscr tc_unit tc_void
| cd_void_unit : cdiscr tc_void tc_unit
| cd_all_xist κ : cdiscr (tc_all κ)  (tc_xist κ)
| cd_xist_all κ : cdiscr (tc_xist κ) (tc_all κ)
| cd_all_rec    : cdiscr (tc_all ⋆)  (tc_rec ⋆)
| cd_rec_all    : cdiscr (tc_rec ⋆)  (tc_all ⋆)
| cd_xist_rec   : cdiscr (tc_xist ⋆) (tc_rec ⋆)
| cd_rec_xist   : cdiscr (tc_rec ⋆)  (tc_xist ⋆)
| cd_arr_sum  : cdiscr tc_arr  tc_sum
| cd_sum_arr  : cdiscr tc_sum  tc_arr
| cd_arr_prod : cdiscr tc_arr  tc_prod
| cd_prod_arr : cdiscr tc_prod tc_arr
| cd_prod_sum : cdiscr tc_prod tc_sum
| cd_sum_prod : cdiscr tc_sum  tc_prod.

Definition cdiscrK {κ₁ κ₂} : tctor κ₁ → tctor κ₂ → Prop :=
  match kindEqDec.eq_dec κ₁ κ₂ with
  | left EQ =>
      eq_rect κ₁ (λ κ : kindEqDec.U, tctor κ₁ → tctor κ → Prop) cdiscr κ₂ EQ
  | right NEQ => λ _ _, True
  end.

Inductive tdiscr {Δ : Ctx kind} : constr Δ → Prop :=
| td_ctd {κ κ₁ κ₂ τ₁ τ₂} {c₁ : tctor κ₁} {c₂ : tctor κ₂}
         (HI₁ : tctd τ₁ c₁)
         (HI₂ : tctd τ₂ c₂)
         (HD : cdiscrK c₁ c₂) :
  tdiscr (c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂)
| td_carr_ctd {ψ τ σ κ} {c : tctor κ}
              (HI : tctd σ c) :
  tdiscr (c_eq ⋆ (t_carr ψ τ) σ)
| td_ctd_carr {ψ τ σ κ} {c : tctor κ}
              (HI : tctd σ c) :
  tdiscr (c_eq ⋆ σ (t_carr ψ τ))
| td_cprod_ctd {ψ τ σ κ} {c : tctor κ}
               (HI : tctd σ c) :
  tdiscr (c_eq ⋆ (t_cprod ψ τ) σ)
| td_ctd_cprod {ψ τ σ κ} {c : tctor κ}
               (HI : tctd σ c) :
  tdiscr (c_eq ⋆ σ (t_cprod ψ τ))
| td_carr_cprod {ψ₁ ψ₂ τ₁ τ₂} :
    tdiscr (c_eq ⋆ (t_carr ψ₁ τ₁) (t_cprod ψ₂ τ₂))
| td_cprod_carr {ψ₁ ψ₂ τ₁ τ₂} :
    tdiscr (c_eq ⋆ (t_cprod ψ₂ τ₂) (t_carr ψ₁ τ₁)).

Notation "⊮ ψ" := (tdiscr ψ%typ) (at level 70).

Arguments tdiscr {Δ} ψ%typ.

Reserved Notation "Ψ ⊩ ψ" (at level 70, no associativity).

Inductive tproves_i {Δ : Ctx kind} {Ψ : list (constr Δ)} : constr Δ → Prop :=
| tpi_ax ψ (HIn : In ψ Ψ) : Ψ ⊩ ψ
| tpi_var {κ x EQ₁ EQ₂} : Ψ ⊩ t_var κ x EQ₁ ≃ t_var κ x EQ₂
| tpi_lam {κₐ κᵣ} {τ₁ τ₂ : typ κᵣ (Δ ▹ κₐ)} (HP : map shift Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ ƛ τ₁ ≃ ƛ τ₂
| tpi_app {κₐ κᵣ} {σ₁ σ₂ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ} {τ₁ τ₂}
          (HP₁ : Ψ ⊩ σ₁ ≃ σ₂)
          (HP₂ : Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ σ₁ τ₁ ≃ σ₂ τ₂
| tpi_ctor {κ} (c : tctor κ) : Ψ ⊩ c ≃ c
| tpi_carr {ψ τ₁ τ₂} (HP : Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ ψ →ᶜ τ₁ ≃ ψ →ᶜ τ₂
| tpi_cprod {ψ τ₁ τ₂} (HP : Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ ψ ×ᶜ τ₁ ≃ ψ ×ᶜ τ₂
| tpi_symm {κ} {τ₁ τ₂ : typ κ Δ} (HP : Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ τ₂ ≃ τ₁
| tpi_trans {κ} {τ₁ τ₂ τ₃ : typ κ Δ}
            (HP₁ : Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂)
            (HP₂ : Ψ ⊩ τ₂ ≃ τ₃) :
    Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₃
| tpi_eta {κₐ κᵣ} (τ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ) :
    Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ ƛ shift τ 0ᵛ
| tpi_beta {κₐ κᵣ} (σ : typ κₐ Δ) (τ : typ κᵣ (Δ ▹ κₐ)) :
    Ψ ⊩ (ƛ τ) σ ≃ subst τ σ
| tpi_appInjR {κₐ κᵣ κ} {σ₁ σ₂ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ} {c : tctor κ} {τ₁ τ₂ : typ κₐ Δ}
              (HI₁ : tctd σ₁ c)
              (HI₂ : tctd σ₂ c)
              (HP : Ψ ⊩ σ₁ τ₁ ≃ σ₂ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂
| tpi_appInjL {κₐ κᵣ κ} {σ₁ σ₂ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ} {c : tctor κ} {τ₁ τ₂ : typ κₐ Δ}
              (HI₁ : tctd σ₁ c)
              (HI₂ : tctd σ₂ c)
              (HP : Ψ ⊩ σ₁ τ₁ ≃ σ₂ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ σ₁ ≃ σ₂
| tpi_carrInjR {ψ₁ ψ₂ τ₁ τ₂}
                (HP : Ψ ⊩ ψ₁ →ᶜ τ₁ ≃ ψ₂ →ᶜ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ (c_eq ⋆ τ₁ τ₂)
| tpi_cprodInjR {ψ₁ ψ₂ τ₁ τ₂}
                (HP : Ψ ⊩ ψ₁ ×ᶜ τ₁ ≃ ψ₂ ×ᶜ τ₂) :

| tpi_cprodInjL {ψ₁ ψ₂ τ₁ τ₂}
    (HP : Ψ ⊩ ψ₁ ×ᶜ τ₁ ≃ ψ₂ ×ᶜ τ₂) :
    Ψ ⊩ ψ₁ -> Ψ ⊩ ψ₂
| tpi_carrInjL {ψ₁ ψ₂ τ₁ τ₂}
    (HP : Ψ ⊩ ψ₁ →ᶜ τ₁ ≃ ψ₂ →ᶜ τ₂) :
  Ψ ⊩ ψ₁ -> Ψ ⊩ ψ₂
where "Ψ ⊩ ψ" := (@tproves_i _ Ψ%typ ψ%typ).

Definition tequiv {Δ κ} Ψ (τ₁ τ₂ : typ κ Δ) := tproves_i Ψ (c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂).

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import RelationClasses Morphisms.

Require Vector.

Declare Scope bind_scope.

Delimit Scope bind_scope with bind.

Local Open Scope bind_scope.

Section EqualityIndexedTypes.

Context {Obj : Type}.

Class EqIndCore (T : Obj → Obj → Type) :=
    equal A B : T A B → T A B → Prop.

Class EqInd (T : Obj → Obj → Type) {EIC : EqIndCore T} :=
    { eq_equiv A B :> Equivalence (equal A B) }.

End EqualityIndexedTypes.

Notation " f ≡ g " := (equal _ _ f%bind g%bind) (at level 70, no associativity) : bind_scope.

Section Arrows.

Context {Obj : Type}.

Class ArrowCore (Arr : Obj → Obj → Type) : Type :=
    { arrow_id A : Arr A A;
      arrow_comp {A B C} : Arr B C → Arr A B → Arr A C
    }.

Definition arrow {Arr} {ArrEq : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr} := Arr.

Notation " 'ı' " := (arrow_id _) : bind_scope.

Notation " f ∘ g " := (arrow_comp f%bind g%bind) (at level 40, left associativity) : bind_scope.

Class Arrow (Arr : Obj → Obj → Type) {ArrEq : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr} : Prop :=
    { arrow_comp_id_l {A B} (f : Arr A B) : ı ∘ f ≡ f;
      arrow_comp_id_r {A B} (f : Arr A B) : f ∘ ı ≡ f;
      arrow_comp_assoc {A B C D} (f : Arr C D) (g : Arr B C) (h : Arr A B) :
        f ∘ g ∘ h ≡ f ∘ (g ∘ h);
      arrow_comp_proper
        A B C :> Proper (equal B C ==> equal A B ==> equal A C) arrow_comp}.

Context {Arr : Obj → Obj → Type} {ArrEq : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr}.

Class FunctorCore (F : Obj → Type) :=
    fmap : ∀ {A B}, (Arr A B) → F A → F B.

Class Functor (F : Obj → Type) {FunCore : FunctorCore F} : Prop :=
    { map_id {A} (f : Arr A A) (t : F A) (EQ : f ≡ ı) :
        fmap f t = t;
      map_map_comp {A B C} (f : Arr B C) (g : Arr A B) h (t : F A)
                   (EQ : f ∘ g ≡ h) :
        fmap f (fmap g t) = fmap h t}.

End Arrows.

Module ArrowNotations.

Notation " A '[→]' B " := (arrow A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

End ArrowNotations.

Notation " 'ı' " := (arrow_id _) : bind_scope.

Notation " f ∘ g " := (arrow_comp f%bind g%bind) (at level 40, left associativity) : bind_scope.

Section Substitutions.

Context {Obj : Type}.

Class SubstCore (Arr : Obj → Obj → Type) (Sub : Obj → Obj → Type) : Type :=
    subst_of_arr : ∀ {A B}, Arr A B → Sub A B.

Definition sub {Arr Sub} {ASC : SubstCore Arr Sub} := Sub.

Definition subarr {Arr Sub} {ASC : SubstCore Arr Sub} := Arr.

Notation " f '̂' " := (subst_of_arr f%bind) (at level 30) : bind_scope.

Class Subst
        (Arr : Obj → Obj → Type) {ArrEq : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr}
        (Sub : Obj → Obj → Type) {SubEq : EqIndCore Sub} {SC : ArrowCore Sub}
        {ASC : SubstCore Arr Sub}  : Prop :=
    { arrow_subst_id {A} : ı ̂ ≡ (ı : Sub A A);
      arrow_subst_comp {A B C} (f : Arr B C) (g : Arr A B) :
        (f ∘ g)̂ ≡ f ̂ ∘ g ̂;
      arrow_subst_proper A B :> Proper (equal A B ==> equal A B) subst_of_arr}.

Context {Arr : Obj → Obj → Type} {EqArr : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr}.

Context {Sub : Obj → Obj → Type} {EqSub : EqIndCore Sub} {SC : ArrowCore Sub}.

Context {ASC : SubstCore Arr Sub}.

Class BindCore (F : Obj → Type) :=
      bind : ∀ {A B}, (Sub A B) → F A → F B.

Class BindMapPure (F : Obj → Type) {MapF : FunctorCore F} {BindF : BindCore F} : Prop :=
      { bind_map {A B} (f : Arr A B) g t
                 (EQ : f ̂ ≡ g) :
          fmap f t = bind g t
      }.

Class BindMapComm (F : Obj → Type) {MapF : FunctorCore F} {BindF : BindCore F} : Prop :=
      { bind_map_comm {A B₁ B₂ C} (f₁ : Arr B₁ C) (f₂ : Arr A B₂) (g₁ : Sub A B₁) g₂ t
                 (EQ : g₂ ∘ f₂ ̂ ≡ f₁ ̂ ∘ g₁) :
          bind g₂ (fmap f₂ t) = fmap f₁ (bind g₁ t)
      }.

Class Bind (F : Obj → Type) {BindF : BindCore F} : Prop :=
      { bind_pure {A} (f : Sub A A) (t : F A) (EQ : f ≡ ı) :
          bind f t = t;
        bind_bind_comp {A B C} (f : Sub B C) (g : Sub A B) h (t : F A)
                       (EQ : f ∘ g ≡ h) :
          bind f (bind g t) = bind h t
      }.

End Substitutions.

Arguments arrow {Obj Arr ArrEq AC} /.

Arguments sub {Obj Arr Sub ASC } /.

Arguments subarr {Obj Arr Sub ASC } /.

Module SubNotations.

Notation " A '[⇒]' B " := (sub A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Notation " A '[→]' B " := (subarr A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

End SubNotations.

Notation " f '̂' " := (subst_of_arr f%bind) (at level 30) : bind_scope.

Section Lifting.

Context {Obj : Type}.

Class LiftableCore (Arr : Obj → Obj → Type) (G : Obj → Obj) :=
    lift : ∀ {A B}, Arr A B → Arr (G A) (G B).

Notation " f ↑ " := (lift f%bind) (at level 30) : bind_scope.

Fixpoint liftn {Arr G} {LC : LiftableCore Arr G} {A B : Obj}
           n (f : Arr A B) : Arr (Nat.iter n G A) (Nat.iter n G B) :=
    match n with
    | O => f
    | S n => (liftn n f) ↑
    end.

Class Liftable {Arr} {EqArr : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr}
        (G : Obj → Obj) {LC : LiftableCore Arr G} : Prop :=
    { lift_id {A} (f : Arr A A) (EQ : f ≡ ı) : f ↑ ≡ ı;
      lift_comp {A B C} (f : Arr B C) (g : Arr A B) h (EQ : f ∘ g ≡ h) :
        f ↑ ∘ g ↑ ≡ h ↑ ;
      lift_proper A B :> Proper (equal A B ==> equal (G A) (G B)) lift
    }.

Context {Arr : Obj → Obj → Type} {EqArr : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr}.

Context {Sub : Obj → Obj → Type} {EqSub : EqIndCore Sub} {SC : ArrowCore Sub}.

Context {ASC : SubstCore Arr Sub}.

Class ASLiftInj (G : Obj → Obj) {ALC : LiftableCore Arr G} {SLC : LiftableCore Sub G} : Prop :=
    lift_of : ∀ {A B} (f : Arr A B) g (EQ : f ̂ ≡ g), f ↑ ̂ ≡ g ↑.

Class ASLiftComm (G : Obj → Obj)
        {ALC : LiftableCore Arr G} {SLC : LiftableCore Sub G} : Prop :=
    lift_comm : ∀ {A B₁ B₂ C} (f₁ : Arr B₁ C) (f₂ : Arr A B₂) (g₁ : Sub A B₁) (g₂ : Sub B₂ C)
                (EQ : g₂ ∘ f₂ ̂ ≡ f₁ ̂ ∘ g₁),
      g₂ ↑ ∘ f₂ ↑ ̂ ≡ f₁ ↑ ̂ ∘ g₁ ↑ .

End Lifting.

Arguments Liftable {Obj} Arr {EqArr AC} G {LC}.

Arguments ASLiftInj {Obj} Arr Sub {EqSub ASC} G {ALC SLC}.

Arguments ASLiftComm {Obj} Arr Sub {EqSub SC ASC} G {ALC SLC}.

Notation " f ↑ " := (lift f%bind) (at level 30) : bind_scope.

Section Shifting.

Context {Obj : Type}.

Class ShiftableCore (Arr : Obj → Obj → Type) (Inc : Obj → Obj) : Type :=
    mk_shift : ∀ A : Obj, Arr A (Inc A).

Global Arguments mk_shift {Arr Inc _ A}.

Definition shift
             {Arr : Obj → Obj → Type}
             {F   : Obj → Type} {MapF : FunctorCore F}
             {Inc : Obj → Obj} {Sh : ShiftableCore Arr Inc}
             {A : Obj}
             (a : F A) : F (Inc A) := fmap mk_shift a.

Context (Arr : Obj → Obj → Type) {EqArr : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr}.

Context (Sub : Obj → Obj → Type) {EqSub : EqIndCore Sub} {SC : ArrowCore Sub}.

Context {ASC : SubstCore Arr Sub}.

Context (Inc : Obj → Obj) {Sh : ShiftableCore Arr Inc}.

Class LiftAShift {ALC : LiftableCore Arr Inc} : Prop :=
    liftA_mk_shift_comm : ∀ {A B : Obj} (f : Arr A B),
      f ↑ ∘ mk_shift ≡ mk_shift ∘ f.

Class LiftSShift {SLC : LiftableCore Sub Inc} : Prop :=
    liftS_mk_shift_comm : ∀ {A B : Obj} (f : Sub A B),
      f ↑ ∘ mk_shift ̂ ≡ mk_shift ̂ ∘ f.

End Shifting.

Arguments liftA_mk_shift_comm {Obj Arr EqArr AC Inc Sh ALC _ A B} f.

Arguments liftS_mk_shift_comm {Obj Arr Sub EqSub SC ASC Inc  Sh SLC _ A B} f.

Section Substituting.

Context {Obj : Type}.

Class SubstitutableCore
        (Sub : Obj → Obj → Type) (F : Obj → Type) (Inc : Obj → Obj) : Type :=
    mk_subst : ∀ {A : Obj} (x : F A), Sub (Inc A) A.

Definition subst
             {Sub : Obj → Obj → Type}
             {G   : Obj → Type} {BindG : BindCore G}
             {F   : Obj → Type} {Inc : Obj → Obj} {Sb : SubstitutableCore Sub F Inc}
             {A : Obj}
             (a : G (Inc A)) (v : F A) : G A := bind (mk_subst v) a.

Context (Arr : Obj → Obj → Type) {EqArr : EqIndCore Arr} {AC : ArrowCore Arr}.

Context (Sub : Obj → Obj → Type) {EqSub : EqIndCore Sub} {SC : ArrowCore Sub}.

Context {ASC : SubstCore Arr Sub}.

Context (F : Obj → Type) (Inc : Obj → Obj) {Sb : SubstitutableCore Sub F Inc}.

Class SubstShift {Sh : ShiftableCore Arr Inc} : Prop :=
    subst_shift_pure : ∀ {A : Obj} (v : F A),
      mk_subst v ∘ mk_shift ̂ ≡ ı.

Class SubstFMap {MapF : FunctorCore F}
        {ALC : LiftableCore Arr Inc} : Prop :=
    map_mk_subst_comm : ∀ {A B : Obj} (f : Arr A B) (v : F A),
      f ̂ ∘ mk_subst v ≡ mk_subst (fmap f v) ∘ f ↑ ̂.

Class SubstBind {BndF : BindCore F}
        {SLC : LiftableCore Sub Inc} : Prop :=
    bind_mk_subst_comm : ∀ {A B : Obj} (f : Sub A B) (v : F A),
      f ∘ mk_subst v ≡ mk_subst (bind f v) ∘ f ↑.

End Substituting.

Arguments subst_shift_pure {Obj Arr Sub EqSub SC ASC F Inc Sb Sh _ A} v.

Arguments map_mk_subst_comm {Obj Arr Sub EqSub SC ASC F Inc Sb MapF ALC _ A B} f v.

Arguments bind_mk_subst_comm {Obj Sub EqSub SC F Inc Sb BndF SLC _ A B} f v.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Core.

Require Import Binding.Inc.

Require Import Binding.Properties.

Require Import Morphisms.

Class SetPureCore (F : Set → Type) : Type :=
  set_pure : ∀ A : Set, A → F A.

Arguments set_pure {F _ A}.

Record Arr (A B : Set) : Type :=
  { apply_arr : A → B
  }.

Notation " A '[→]' B " := (Arr A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Arguments apply_arr {A B}.

Coercion apply_arr : Arr >-> Funclass.

Record Sub {F : Set → Type} {FP : SetPureCore F} (A B : Set) : Type :=
  { apply_sub : A → F B
  }.

Notation " A '[⇒]' B " := (Sub A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Arguments apply_sub {F FP A B}.

Coercion apply_sub : Sub >-> Funclass.

Instance ArrEqC : EqIndCore Arr :=
  λ A B f g, ∀ x, f x = g x.

Instance SubEqC {F} {FP : SetPureCore F} : EqIndCore Sub :=
  λ A B f g, ∀ x, f x = g x.

Global Instance ArrowCore_Set : ArrowCore Arr :=
  { arrow_id   := λ _,         {| apply_arr := λ x, x       |}
  ; arrow_comp := λ _ _ _ f g, {| apply_arr := λ x, f (g x) |}
  }.

Class SetPure (F : Set → Type) {FP : SetPureCore F}
    {MapF : FunctorCore F}
    {BndF : BindCore F} : Prop :=
  { fmap_set_pure : ∀ (A B : Set) (f : Arr A B) (x : A),
      fmap f (set_pure x) = set_pure (f x)
  ; bind_set_pure : ∀ (A B : Set) (f : Sub A B) (x : A),
      bind f (set_pure x) = f x
  }.

Section SetInstances.

Context {F : Set → Type} {FP : SetPureCore F}.

Context {MapF : FunctorCore (Arr := Arr) F}.

Context {BndF : BindCore (Sub := Sub) F}.

Context {SPF : SetPure F}.

Global Instance SubstArrCore_Set : ArrowCore Sub :=
    { arrow_id A := {| apply_sub := set_pure |};
      arrow_comp A B C f g := {| apply_sub := λ x, bind f (g x) |} }.

Global Instance SubstCore_Set : SubstCore Arr Sub :=
    λ A B f, {| apply_sub := λ x, set_pure (f x) |}.

Definition incFun (A B : Set) (f : Arr A B) : inc A → inc B := inc_map f.

Global Instance IncMap : FunctorCore inc := incFun.

Global Instance ALiftableCore_inc : LiftableCore Arr inc :=
    { lift A B f := {| apply_arr := fmap f |} }.

Global Instance ShiftableCore_inc : ShiftableCore Arr inc :=
    λ A, {| apply_arr := VS |}.

Global Instance SLiftableCore_inc : LiftableCore Sub inc :=
    { lift A B f :=
        {| apply_sub := λ x,
                        match x with
                        | VZ   => set_pure VZ
                        | VS y => shift (f y)
                        end
        |}
    }.

Global Instance SubstitutableCore_inc : SubstitutableCore Sub F inc :=
    λ A v,
    {| apply_sub := λ x,
                    match x with
                    | VZ => v
                    | VS y => set_pure y
                    end
    |}.

End SetInstances.

Arguments set_pure {F _ A} /.

77	        fmap f (int_pure v x EQ) = int_pure v (f x) (eq_trans (arr_hom f x) EQ)
78	  ; bind_set_pure : ∀ (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Sub Γ Δ) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v),
79	      bind f (int_pure (IntPureCore := FP) v x EQ) = f v x EQ

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Core.

Require Import Binding.Inc.

Require Import Binding.Properties.

Require Import Morphisms.

Record Ctx {V : Type} :=
  {dom : Set;
   arr :> dom -> V
  }.

Arguments Ctx V : clear implicits.

Definition mtC {V : Type} : Ctx V :=
  {| dom := Empty_set;
     arr x := match x with end
  |}.

Definition extC {V : Type} (v : V) (Γ : Ctx V) : Ctx V :=
  {| dom := inc (dom Γ);
     arr x := match x with
              | VZ => v
              | VS x => Γ x
              end
  |}.

Notation "'ε'" := mtC.

Notation "Γ ▹ v" := (extC v Γ) (at level 40, left associativity).

Class IntPureCore {V : Type} (F : V → Ctx V → Type) : Type :=
  int_pure : ∀ (Γ : Ctx V) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v) , F v Γ.

Arguments int_pure {V F _ Γ}.

Record Arr {V : Type} {Γ Δ : Ctx V} : Type :=
  { apply_arr : dom Γ → dom Δ;
    arr_hom   : ∀ x : dom Γ, Δ (apply_arr x) = Γ x
  }.

Arguments Arr {V} Γ Δ.

Notation " A '[→]' B " := (Arr A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Coercion apply_arr : Arr >-> Funclass.

Record Sub {V} {F : V → Ctx V → Type} {FP : IntPureCore F} (Γ Δ : Ctx V) : Type :=
  { apply_sub : ∀ v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v), F v Δ
  }.

Notation " A '[⇒]' B " := (Sub A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Arguments apply_sub {V F FP Γ Δ}.

Coercion apply_sub : Sub >-> Funclass.

Instance ArrEqC {V} : EqIndCore (Arr (V := V)) :=
  λ A B f g, ∀ x, f x = g x.

Instance SubEqC {V F} {FP : IntPureCore (V := V) F} : EqIndCore Sub :=
  λ A B f g, ∀ v x EQ, f v x EQ = g v x EQ.

Global Instance ArrowCore_Set {V} : ArrowCore (Arr (V := V)) :=
  { arrow_id   := λ _,         {| apply_arr := λ x, x; arr_hom := λ x, eq_refl |}
  ; arrow_comp := λ _ _ _ f g, {| apply_arr := λ x, f (g x);
                                arr_hom := λ x, eq_trans (arr_hom f (g x)) (arr_hom g x) |}
  }.

Class IntPure {V} (F : V → Ctx V → Type) {FP : IntPureCore (V := V) F}
    {MapF : ∀ v, FunctorCore (F v)}
    {BndF : ∀ v, BindCore (Sub := Sub) (F v)} : Prop :=
  { fmap_int_pure : ∀ (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Arr Γ Δ) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v),
        fmap f (int_pure v x EQ) = int_pure v (f x) (eq_trans (arr_hom f x) EQ)
  ; bind_set_pure : ∀ (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Sub Γ Δ) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v),
      bind f (int_pure (IntPureCore := FP) v x EQ) = f v x EQ
  }.

Section IntInstances.

Context {V} {F : V → Ctx V → Type} {FP : IntPureCore F}.

Context {MapF : ∀ v, FunctorCore (Arr := Arr) (F v)}.

Context {BndF : ∀ v, BindCore (Sub := Sub) (F v)}.

Context {SPF : IntPure F}.

Global Instance SubstArrCore_Set : ArrowCore (Sub (V := V)) :=
    { arrow_id A := {| apply_sub := int_pure |};
      arrow_comp A B C f g := {| apply_sub := λ v x EQ, bind f (g v x EQ) |} }.

Global Instance SubstCore_Set : SubstCore Arr Sub :=
    λ Γ Δ f, {| apply_sub := λ v x EQ, int_pure v (f x) (eq_trans (arr_hom f x) EQ) |}.

Definition extFun v (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Arr Γ Δ) : Arr (Γ ▹ v) (Δ ▹ v) :=
    @Build_Arr V (Γ ▹ v) (Δ ▹ v) (inc_map f)
      ltac:(intros [| x]; simpl; [reflexivity | exact (arr_hom f x)]).

Global Instance ALiftableCore_ext {v : V} : LiftableCore Arr (extC v) :=
    { lift := extFun v }.

Global Program Instance ShiftableCore_ext {v : V} : ShiftableCore Arr (extC v) :=
    λ A, {| apply_arr := VS : dom A → dom (A ▹ v) |}.

Global Instance SLiftableCore_ext {v : V} : LiftableCore Sub (extC v) :=
    { lift Γ Δ ρ :=
        {| apply_sub := λ u (x : dom (Γ ▹ v)),
                        match x with
                        | VZ   => λ EQ, int_pure u (VZ : dom (Δ ▹ v)) EQ
                        | VS y => λ EQ, shift (ρ u y EQ)
                        end
        |}
    }.

Global Instance SubstitutableCore_ext {v : V} : SubstitutableCore Sub (F v) (extC v) :=
    λ A u,
    {| apply_sub := λ w (x : dom (A ▹ v)),
                    match x with
                    | VZ => λ EQ, match EQ with eq_refl => u end
                    | VS y => int_pure w y
                    end
    |}.

End IntInstances.

Arguments int_pure {V F _ Γ v} /.

Require Import Utf8.
Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax Lang.FOmegaEq.OpSemantics Lang.FOmegaEq.Typing.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).
Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Import kindEqDec.
Local Open Scope syn_scope.
Local Open Scope typ_scope.
Local Open Scope bind_scope.
Require Import List.

(* Semantic domain, Kripke over ambient type contexts. *)
Fixpoint D (κ : kind) (Γ : Ctx kind) {struct κ} : Type :=
  match κ with
  | ⋆ => typ ⋆ Γ
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => ∀ (Γ' : Ctx kind), @Arr kind Γ Γ' → D κ₁ Γ' → D κ₂ Γ'
  end.

(* Logical equality at each kind. *)
Fixpoint EqD (κ : kind) {Γ : Ctx kind} (a b : D κ Γ) {struct κ} : Prop :=
  match κ as κ' return D κ' Γ → D κ' Γ → Prop with
  | ⋆ => fun a b => a = b
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => fun f g => ∀ (Γ' : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Γ Γ') (x y : D κ₁ Γ'),
                     EqD κ₁ x y → EqD κ₂ (f Γ' ρ x) (g Γ' ρ y)
  end a b.

(* Parametricity / self-relatedness. *)
Fixpoint Param (κ : kind) {Γ : Ctx kind} (a : D κ Γ) {struct κ} : Prop :=
  match κ as κ' return D κ' Γ → Prop with
  | ⋆ => fun a => True
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => fun f => ∀ (Γ' : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Γ Γ') (x y : D κ₁ Γ'),
                     EqD κ₁ x y → EqD κ₂ (f Γ' ρ x) (f Γ' ρ y)
  end a.

Definition Env (Δ : Ctx kind) (Γ : Ctx kind) : Type :=
  ∀ κ (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ), D κ Γ.

Definition EnvEq {Δ Γ} (η₁ η₂ : Env Δ Γ) : Prop :=
  ∀ κ x EQ, EqD κ (η₁ κ x EQ) (η₂ κ x EQ).

Definition EnvParam {Δ Γ} (η : Env Δ Γ) : Prop :=
  ∀ κ x EQ, Param κ (η κ x EQ).

Definition arr_shift (Γ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) : @Arr kind Γ (Γ ▹ κ) :=
  {| apply_arr := VS; arr_hom := fun x => eq_refl |}.

(* Reindexing semantic values along a renaming of the ambient context. *)
Fixpoint Dweak (κ : kind) {Γ Γ' : Ctx kind} (ρ : @Arr kind Γ Γ') (a : D κ Γ) {struct κ} : D κ Γ' :=
  match κ as κ' return D κ' Γ → D κ' Γ' with
  | ⋆ => fun a => tmap ρ a
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => fun f => fun Γ'' ρ' a => f Γ'' (arrow_comp ρ' ρ) a
  end a.

(* Quoting and reflecting, by recursion on kind. *)
Fixpoint quote (κ : kind) {Γ : Ctx kind} (a : D κ Γ) {struct κ} : typ κ Γ :=
  match κ as κ' return D κ' Γ → typ κ' Γ with
  | ⋆ => fun a => a
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => fun f =>
      t_lam (quote κ₂ (f (Γ ▹ κ₁) (arr_shift Γ κ₁)
                              (reflect κ₁ (t_var κ₁ (VZ : dom (Γ ▹ κ₁)) eq_refl))))
  end a
with reflect (κ : kind) {Γ : Ctx kind} (u : typ κ Γ) {struct κ} : D κ Γ :=
  match κ as κ' return typ κ' Γ → D κ' Γ with
  | ⋆ => fun u => u
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => fun u => fun Γ' ρ a => reflect κ₂ (t_app (tmap ρ u) (quote κ₁ a))
  end u.

(* Extension of an environment under a term binder. *)
Definition env_ext {Δ Γ : Ctx kind} {κₐ : kind} (η : Env Δ Γ) (ρ : @Arr kind Γ Γ')
            (a : D κₐ Γ') : Env (Δ ▹ κₐ) Γ' :=
  fun κ x EQ =>
    match x as x' return ((Δ ▹ κₐ) x' = κ) → D κ Γ' with
    | VZ => fun EQ' => eq_rect κₐ (fun k => D k Γ') a κ EQ'
    | VS y => fun EQ' => Dweak κ ρ (η κ y EQ')
    end EQ.

(* Semantic action of type constructors. *)
Definition sem_ctor {κ : kind} {Γ : Ctx kind} (c : tctor κ) : D κ Γ :=
  match c as c' in tctor κ' return D κ' Γ with
  | tc_unit => t_ctor tc_unit
  | tc_void => t_ctor tc_void
  | tc_arr => fun Γ₁ ρ₁ a₁ Γ₂ ρ₂ a₂ =>
                  t_app (t_app (t_ctor tc_arr) (Dweak ⋆ ρ₂ a₁)) a₂
  | tc_sum => fun Γ₁ ρ₁ a₁ Γ₂ ρ₂ a₂ =>
                  t_app (t_app (t_ctor tc_sum) (Dweak ⋆ ρ₂ a₁)) a₂
  | tc_prod => fun Γ₁ ρ₁ a₁ Γ₂ ρ₂ a₂ =>
                  t_app (t_app (t_ctor tc_prod) (Dweak ⋆ ρ₂ a₁)) a₂
  | tc_all κ => fun Γ₁ ρ₁ f =>
                  t_app (t_ctor (tc_all κ)) (quote (κ ⇒ ⋆) f)
  | tc_xist κ => fun Γ₁ ρ₁ f =>
                  t_app (t_ctor (tc_xist κ)) (quote (κ ⇒ ⋆) f)
  | tc_rec κ =>
      fun Γ₁ ρ₁ f =>
        match κ as κ' return D (κ' ⇒ κ') Γ₁ → D κ' Γ₁ with
        | ⋆ => fun f => t_app (t_ctor (tc_rec ⋆)) (quote (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) f)
        | κₐ ⇒ κᵣ => fun f => fun Γ₂ ρ₂ a =>
              t_app (t_app (t_ctor (tc_rec (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)))
                           (Dweak (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) ρ₂ (quote ((κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) ⇒ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)) f)))
                    (quote κₐ a)
        end f
  end.
EOF

(* ---------- Basic properties of the logical relations ---------- *)

Lemma eq_rect_EqD (Γ : Ctx kind) (κ₁ κ₂ : kind) (e : κ₁ = κ₂)
      (a b : D κ₁ Γ) :
  EqD κ₁ a b ->
  EqD κ₂ (eq_rect κ₁ (fun k => D k Γ) a κ₂ e)

Proof. destruct e. simpl. auto. Qed.

Fixpoint EqD_refl_of_Param (κ : kind) {Γ : Ctx kind} (a : D κ Γ) {struct κ} :
  Param κ a -> EqD κ a a :=
  match κ as κ' return forall (a : D κ' Γ), Param κ' a -> EqD κ' a a with
  | ⋆ => fun a p => eq_refl
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => fun f p => fun Γ' ρ x y Hxy => proj1 (p Γ' ρ x y Hxy)
  end a.

Fixpoint EqD_symm (κ : kind) {Γ : Ctx kind} (a b : D κ Γ) {struct κ} :
  EqD κ a b -> EqD κ b a :=
  match κ as κ' return forall (a b : D κ' Γ), EqD κ' a b -> EqD κ' b a with
  | ⋆ => fun a b H => eq_sym H
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => fun f g H => fun Γ' ρ x y Px Py Hxy =>
      EqD_symm κ₂ (f Γ' ρ y) (g Γ' ρ x)
        (H Γ' ρ y x Py Px (EqD_symm κ₁ y x Hxy))
  end a b.

Fixpoint EqD_trans (κ : kind) {Γ : Ctx kind} (a b c : D κ Γ) {struct κ} :
  EqD κ a b -> Param κ b -> EqD κ b c -> EqD κ a c :=
  match κ as κ' return forall (a b c : D κ' Γ),
      EqD κ' a b -> Param κ' b -> EqD κ' b c -> EqD κ' a c with
  | ⋆ => fun a b c Hab _ Hbc => eq_trans Hab Hbc
  | κ₁ ⇒ κ₂ => fun f g h Hab Pb Hbc => fun Γ' ρ x y Px Py Hxy =>
      let E1 := proj1 (Pb Γ' ρ x y Px Py Hxy) in
      let P1 := proj2 (Pb Γ' ρ x y Px Py Hxy) in
      let Hyx := EqD_symm κ₁ y x Hxy in
      let E2 := proj1 (Pb Γ' ρ y x Py Px Hyx) in

        (EqD_trans κ₂ (f Γ' ρ x) (g Γ' ρ y) (g Γ' ρ x)

I was unable to complete this proof. Here is an honest account of the attempt.

## What the task requires

`soundness` is a full type‑safety theorem for the `FOmegaEq` calculus. The given `safe` predicate demands progress at *every* reachable state, so a complete proof needs, at minimum:

1. **Term‑level metatheory**: weakening/renaming, a general term‑substitution lemma, a type‑context shift lemma, and a type‑substitution lemma for the typing judgment (13 expression + 12 value typing rules, with binders that change `Δ`, `Ψ`, and `Γ`).
2. **Preservation** for each `head_step` rule (including `LamBetaT`/`UnpackE`, which require type substitution, and `LamBetaRec`, which requires two nested substitutions).
3. **Progress**, which requires canonical‑form lemmas: a closed value of literal type `τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂` must be a `ƛ`/`rec`, etc. Via `T_congV`, this reduces to proving that the type‑equality judgment `nil ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂` cannot relate closed rigid types with different head constructors (e.g. `⊤` vs `τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂`).
4. **Type‑equality consistency**, including soundness of `tpi_appInjL/R`, `tpi_carrInjL/R`, and `tpi_cprodInjL/R`, and consistency of `T_cabort` (`nil ⊩ ψ` versus `⊮ ψ`).

Step 4 is the bottleneck. `tproves_i` is a βη‑conversion theory with constructor‑injectivity rules (guarded by `tctd`); refuting cross‑constructor equations requires **unique βη‑normal forms** — i.e. strong normalization + confluence for the type‑level STLC — or a semantic/normalization‑by‑evaluation model of the type equality with all the associated correctness lemmas (renaming, substitution, quotation, injectivity). The supplied files contain only the raw definitions (`Binding/Properties.v`, `TermSimpl.v`, `Auto.v` are effectively empty), so all of this has to be re‑derived.

## What I built

I developed, and got compiling, a substantial prototype of the semantic side in a scratch file (removed afterwards, since only `Task.v` may be modified):

- a Kripke semantic domain `D κ Γ` over ambient type contexts, with logical equality `EqD` and parametricity `Param`;
- environment machinery, semantic weakening `Dweak`, quotation/reflection `quote`/`reflect` by recursion on kinds;
- syntactic renaming lemmas `tmap_ext`/`cmap_ext` (including proof‑irrelevance of `kind` equalities via `UIP_dec`);
- mutual evaluation `eval`/`eval_constr`, the logicality lemmas (`eval_Param`, `eval_EqD`, `eval_constr_Eq`), constructor action `sem_ctor` and its parametricity, plus `quote_respect`, `reflect_param`.

I hit persistent walls in the remaining model lemmas (renaming/naturality for `tmap`/`tbind`, NBE round‑trips, and hence injectivity soundness). These are genuine research‑scale lemmas, not routine bookkeeping; the dependent‑type/conversion overhead made them very expensive, and the injectivity rules appear to require the full NBE correctness theorem.

- `Task.v` is byte‑identical to `Task.v.orig`; the target remains unproven (`make` fails on the pending proof).

## Where the proof stands

`Task.v` is still the original skeleton (unproven); no forbidden escapes were used. I re-examined the whole proof strategy specifically looking for a route that avoids the type-equality semantic model, and I can now state the obstruction precisely.

## The precise missing ingredient

All routes to `soundness` converge on showing that `nil ⊩ τ₁ ≃ τ₂` cannot relate closed rigid types with different head constructors, because `T_congV` forces progress to invert value typings through type equalities:

- `e_app v₁ v₂` with `⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂` needs `⊩ (shape of v₁) ≃ (τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂)` refuted, etc.

Every such invariant fails on a concrete counterexample that is *not* derivable in `tproves` but is indistinguishable by the invariant: e.g. the identity type function and the second projection both have "all possible heads" as their head-set, so a coarse invariant cannot validate the `tpi_app` congruence step, while the injectivity rules force the base relation to be full equality of normal forms. The only sound choices are:

1. **Unique βη-normal forms** for the intrinsically kinded type-level STLC (SN + confluence, or NBE with a correctness theorem), plus syntactic injectivity of constructor-headed normal forms; or
2. a **Kripke/logical-relation model of `⊩`** whose function kinds are normal-form codes (so `tctd`-head injectivity holds semantically).

I built a large part of option 2 in scratch files (semantic domain `D`, logical equality `EqD`, parametricity `Param`, `Dweak`, `quote`/`reflect`, `eval`/`eval_constr`, and the logicality lemmas, including proof‑irrelevance handled via `UIP_dec`), but the remaining model lemmas — naturality of `eval` under renaming (`tmap`), the semantic substitution lemma (`tbind`), NBE round-trips (`eval ∘ quote`), and hence the injectivity soundness needed by `tpi_appInj*` — are a research-scale development. The supplied dependencies contain none of this metatheory (`Binding/Properties.v`, `TermSimpl.v`, `Auto.v` are effectively empty), so it must be rebuilt from scratch together with the expression-level substitution/preservation/progress development.

## Capability bottleneck

The hard part is not the dependent-type programming per se, but that the task requires re-deriving a paper-level normalization/logical-relation result (βη-normal forms for the type calculus, or an equivalent semantic model) before the term-level proof can even start. That is thousands of lines of intricate Coq; my prototypes repeatedly hit conversion/dependent-elimination walls at exactly those lemmas.

## What would unblock it

Supplying the original artifact's type-safety development (the logical relation / NBE model for `tproves_i`), or an axiom-free proof of βη-normal-form uniqueness for the type-level calculus, would make the remaining expression-level weakening/substitution/type-substitution/preservation/progress work large but mechanical. Without that, I have not found a sound route to close `soundness`.

Local Open Scope bind_scope.
Require Import List.

Definition ren_arr {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) : Binding.Set.Arr A B :=
  @Binding.Set.Build_Arr A B f.
Definition vren {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) (v : value A) : value B := vmap (ren_arr f) v.
Definition eren {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) (e : expr A) : expr B := emap (ren_arr f) e.

Lemma rel_lift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc V, (Γ' ▹ σ) (@inc_map V V' f y) = (Γ ▹ σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| apply f_equal, Hf]. Qed.

Lemma rel_lift2 {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ τ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc (inc V),
    ((Γ' ▹ σ) ▹ τ) (@inc_map (inc V) (inc V') (@inc_map V V' f) y) = ((Γ ▹ σ) ▹ τ) y.
Proof.
  intros [[|x]|x]; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - apply f_equal, Hf.
  - apply f_equal, Hf.
Qed.

Lemma rel_shift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) :
  forall y : V, (Env.compose shift Γ') (f y) = (Env.compose shift Γ) y.
Proof. intro y. simpl. apply f_equal, Hf. Qed.

Lemma rel_shift_extend {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ : typ ⋆ (@extC kind _ Δ)) :
  forall y : inc V,
    (Env.extend (Env.compose shift Γ') σ) (@inc_map V V' f y) =
    (Env.extend (Env.compose shift Γ) σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| apply f_equal, Hf]. Qed.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib.

Require Import SetoidClass Morphisms.

Definition eq_ext {A B} (f g : A → B) := ∀ x, f x = g x.

Instance Setoid_equiv {A B} : Setoid (A → B) :=
  Build_Setoid (equiv := @eq_ext A B) ltac:(split; unfold eq_ext; congruence).

Definition empty_env {A} : ∀ (x : ∅), A := λ x, match x with end.

Definition extend {V : Set} {A} (Γ : V → A) (τ : A) : inc V → A :=
  λ x, match x with VZ => τ | VS x => Γ x end.

Definition compose {A B C} (f : B → C) (g : A → B) (x : A) := f (g x).

Notation "f • g" := (compose f g) (at level 40, left associativity).

Notation "f ▹ v" := (extend f v) (at level 40, v at next level, left associativity).

Notation "□" := empty_env.

Notation "x ≡ y" := (equiv x y) (at level 70, no associativity).

Arguments compose {A B C} f g x /.

Require Import Binding.Set.

Import ArrowNotations.
Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Coq.Lists.List.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Set.

Require Import Binding.Env.

Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Reserved Notation "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ" (at level 70, Ψ, Γ, e at level 60).

Reserved Notation "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ" (at level 70, Ψ, Γ, v at level 60).

Inductive typing_expr {V : Set} (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> (typ ⋆ Δ)) :
  expr V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| T_val {τ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ v : τ
| T_bind  {τ₁ τ₂ e₁ e₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e₁ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e₂ : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e₁ >>= e₂ : τ₂
| T_congE {τ τ' e} : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ'
| T_app  τ₁ τ₂ v₁ v₂ :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₂ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ v₁ v₂ : τ₂
| T_tapp {κ τ σ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ∀ᵗ κ , τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_tapp v : subst τ σ
| T_projL {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ × τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_proj L v : τ₁
| T_projR {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ × τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_proj R v : τ₂
| T_abort {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} {v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ⊥ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_abort v : τ
| T_case {τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ} {τ} {v e₁ e₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e₁ : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₂ ⊢ₑ e₂ : τ ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ + τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_case v e₁ e₂ : τ
| T_unpack {κ} {τ τ'} {v e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ∃ᵗ κ , τ ->
  extC κ Δ ∣ map shift Ψ ∣ shift • Γ ▹ τ ⊢ₑ e : shift τ' ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_unpack v e : τ'
| T_unroll κ τ σ₁ σ₂ (HF : rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂) v :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : σ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_unroll v : σ₂
| T_cabort {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} {ψ}  :
  Ψ ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_cabort : τ
| T_capp {φ τ} {v} :
  Ψ ⊩ φ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : φ →ᶜ τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_capp v : τ
| T_lwith {φ τ} {σ : typ ⋆ Δ} {v e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : φ ×ᶜ σ -> Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ σ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_lwith v e : τ
where "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ" := (typing_expr Δ Ψ%typ Γ%typ e%syn τ%typ)
with typing_val {V : Set} (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> (typ ⋆ Δ)) : value V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| T_var {x τ} (EQ : Γ x = τ) : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_var x : τ
| T_congV {v τ τ'} : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ'
| T_unit : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨⟩ : ⊤
| T_lam {τ₁ τ₂ e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ƛ e : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂
| T_pair {τ₁ τ₂ v₁ v₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₂ : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ : τ₁ × τ₂
| T_injl {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_inj L v : τ₁ + τ₂

Inductive typing_expr {V : Set} (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> (typ ⋆ Δ)) :
  expr V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| T_val {τ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ v : τ
| T_bind  {τ₁ τ₂ e₁ e₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e₁ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e₂ : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e₁ >>= e₂ : τ₂
| T_congE {τ τ' e} : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ'
| T_app  τ₁ τ₂ v₁ v₂ :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₂ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ v₁ v₂ : τ₂
| T_tapp {κ τ σ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ∀ᵗ κ , τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_tapp v : subst τ σ
| T_projL {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ × τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_proj L v : τ₁
| T_projR {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ × τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_proj R v : τ₂
| T_abort {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} {v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ⊥ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_abort v : τ
| T_case {τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ} {τ} {v e₁ e₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e₁ : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₂ ⊢ₑ e₂ : τ ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ + τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_case v e₁ e₂ : τ
| T_unpack {κ} {τ τ'} {v e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ∃ᵗ κ , τ ->
  extC κ Δ ∣ map shift Ψ ∣ shift • Γ ▹ τ ⊢ₑ e : shift τ' ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_unpack v e : τ'
| T_unroll κ τ σ₁ σ₂ (HF : rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂) v :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : σ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_unroll v : σ₂
| T_cabort {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} {ψ}  :
  Ψ ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_cabort : τ
| T_capp {φ τ} {v} :
  Ψ ⊩ φ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : φ →ᶜ τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_capp v : τ
| T_lwith {φ τ} {σ : typ ⋆ Δ} {v e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : φ ×ᶜ σ -> Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ σ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_lwith v e : τ
where "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ" := (typing_expr Δ Ψ%typ Γ%typ e%syn τ%typ)
with typing_val {V : Set} (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> (typ ⋆ Δ)) : value V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| T_var {x τ} (EQ : Γ x = τ) : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_var x : τ
| T_congV {v τ τ'} : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ'
| T_unit : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨⟩ : ⊤
| T_lam {τ₁ τ₂ e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ƛ e : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂
| T_pair {τ₁ τ₂ v₁ v₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₂ : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ : τ₁ × τ₂
| T_injl {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_inj L v : τ₁ + τ₂

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Auto.

Require Import FOmegaEq.Kinds.

Inductive type {Δ : Ctx kind} : kind → Type :=
| t_var κ (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ) : type κ
| t_lam {κₐ κᵣ} (τ : @type (Δ ▹ κₐ) κᵣ) : type (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)
| t_app {κₐ κᵣ} (σ : type (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)) (τ : type κₐ) : type κᵣ
| t_ctor {κ} (c : tctor κ) : type κ
| t_carr  (ψ : constr) (τ : type ⋆) : type ⋆
| t_cprod (ψ : constr) (τ : type ⋆) : type ⋆
with constr {Δ : Ctx kind} : Type :=
| c_eq (κ : kind) (τ₁ τ₂ : type κ) : constr.

Arguments type Δ : clear implicits.

Arguments constr Δ : clear implicits.

Require Import Basics.

Definition typ := flip type.

Declare Scope typ_scope.

Delimit Scope typ_scope with typ.

Coercion t_ctor : tctor >-> type.

Coercion t_app : type >-> Funclass.

Definition rec_type (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ)) : typ κ Δ
  := (tc_rec κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_arr {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_arr τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_prod {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_prod τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_sum {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_sum τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_all {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_all κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_xist {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_xist κ) (t_lam τ).

Notation "'ƛ' τ" := (t_lam τ : typ _ _) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "σ →ᵗ τ" := (t_arr σ τ) (at level 55, right associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ + τ₂" := (t_sum τ₁ τ₂) (at level 50, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ × τ₂" := (t_prod τ₁ τ₂) (at level 40, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "χ →ᶜ τ" := (t_carr χ τ) (at level 55, right associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "χ ×ᶜ τ" := (t_cprod χ τ) (at level 40, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ ≃ τ₂" := (c_eq _ τ₁ τ₂) (at level 65, no associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "∀ᵗ κ , τ" := (t_all κ τ) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "∃ᵗ κ , τ" := (t_xist κ τ) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "⊥" := tc_void : typ_scope.

Notation "'⊤'" := tc_unit : typ_scope.

Notation "'0ᵛ'" := (t_var _ (VZ : dom (_ ▹ _)) eq_refl).

Local Open Scope bind_scope.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Fixpoint tmap {κ} {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (δ : Δ₁ [→] Δ₂) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) : typ κ Δ₂ :=
  match τ with
  | t_var κ x EQ => t_var κ (δ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom δ x) EQ)
  | t_lam τ => ƛ tmap (δ ↑) τ
  | t_app σ τ => (tmap δ σ) (tmap δ τ)
  | t_ctor c  => c
  | φ →ᶜ τ => cmap δ φ →ᶜ tmap δ τ
  | φ ×ᶜ τ => cmap δ φ ×ᶜ tmap δ τ
  end
with cmap {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (δ : Δ₁ [→] Δ₂) (φ : constr Δ₁) : constr Δ₂ :=
  match φ with
  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tmap δ τ₁) (tmap δ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance IPC_typ : IntPureCore (λ κ, typ κ) := @t_var.

#[export] Instance FMap_typ {κ} : FunctorCore (typ κ) := @tmap κ.

#[export] Instance FMap_constr : FunctorCore constr := @cmap.

Fixpoint tbind {κ} {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : Δ₁ [⇒] Δ₂) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) : typ κ Δ₂ :=
  match τ with
  | t_var κ x EQ  => ρ κ x EQ
  | t_lam τ     => ƛ (tbind (ρ ↑) τ)
  | t_app σ τ   => (tbind ρ σ) (tbind ρ τ)
  | t_ctor c    => c
  | t_carr  φ τ => cbind ρ φ →ᶜ tbind ρ τ
  | t_cprod φ τ => cbind ρ φ ×ᶜ tbind ρ τ
  end
with cbind {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : Δ₁ [⇒] Δ₂) (φ : constr Δ₁) : constr Δ₂ :=
  match φ with
  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tbind ρ τ₁) (tbind ρ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance BindT {κ} : BindCore (typ κ) := @tbind κ.

#[export] Instance BindC : BindCore constr := @cbind.

Inductive rel_app {Δ : Ctx kind} (κ₁ : kind) (σ₁ σ₂ : typ κ₁ Δ) : ∀ κ₂, typ κ₂ Δ → typ κ₂ Δ → Prop :=
| rel_app_refl : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κ₁ σ₁ σ₂
| rel_app_app {κₐ κᵣ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ) (τ : typ κₐ Δ)
    (HF : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) τ₁ τ₂) :
  rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κᵣ (τ₁ τ) (τ₂ τ).

Require Import List.

Inductive tctd {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ} : typ κ Δ → ∀ {κ'}, tctor κ' → Prop :=
| inj_ctor c : tctd (t_ctor c) c
| inj_app {κₐ κ'} (σ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κ) Δ) τ (c : tctor κ') (HI : tctd σ c) : tctd (σ τ) c.

Inductive cdiscr : ∀ {κ}, tctor κ → tctor κ → Prop :=
| cd_unit_void : cdiscr tc_unit tc_void

Proof. f_equal. apply (UIP_dec kindEqDec.eq_dec). Qed.

Lemma tmap_var_ext (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (x : dom Δ₁) (EQ : Δ₁ x = κ)
      (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂) (H : ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) :
  t_var κ (ρ₁ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₁ x) EQ) =
  t_var κ (ρ₂ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₂ x) EQ).
Proof.
  refine (eq_ind (ρ₁ x) (fun w => forall (r : Δ₂ w = κ),
            t_var κ (ρ₁ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₁ x) EQ) = t_var κ w r)
          _ (ρ₂ x) H _).
  intro r. apply t_var_irr.
Qed.

Fixpoint tmap_ext (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :
  forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
  tmap ρ₁ τ = tmap ρ₂ τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
        forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
        tmap ρ₁ τ' = tmap ρ₂ τ' with
  | t_var κ x EQ => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H => tmap_var_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ x EQ ρ₁ ρ₂ (H x)
  | t_lam b => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal t_lam
        (tmap_ext _ (extC _ Δ₁) (extC _ Δ₂) b
           (lift ρ₁) (lift ρ₂)
           (fun x => match x with VZ => eq_refl | VS y => f_equal (@VS (dom _)) (H y) end))
  | t_app σ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun f a => @t_app Δ₂ _ _ f a)
        (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ σ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  | t_ctor c => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H => eq_refl
  | t_carr ψ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z a => @t_carr Δ₂ z a)
        (cmap_ext Δ₁ Δ₂ ψ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  | t_cprod ψ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z a => @t_cprod Δ₂ z a)
        (cmap_ext Δ₁ Δ₂ ψ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  end
with cmap_ext (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ₁) {struct ψ} :
  forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
  cmap ρ₁ ψ = cmap ρ₂ ψ :=
  match ψ as ψ' return
        forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
        cmap ρ₁ ψ' = cmap ρ₂ ψ' with
  | c_eq κ a b => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z w => @c_eq Δ₂ κ z w)
        (tmap_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ a ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ b ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  end.

Definition liftA (κ : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂) :
  @Arr kind (extC κ Δ₁) (extC κ Δ₂) :=
  @lift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (@extC kind κ) (@ALiftableCore_ext kind κ) Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

Definition mkShift (κ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) : @Arr kind Δ (extC κ Δ) :=
  @Build_Arr kind Δ (extC κ Δ) (fun x => @VS (dom Δ) x) (fun x => eq_refl).

Fixpoint tmap_tmap (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :
  forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
  tmap f (tmap g τ) = tmap (arrow_comp f g) τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
    forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
    tmap f (tmap g τ') = tmap (arrow_comp f g) τ' with
  | @t_var _ κ x EQ => fun f g =>
      t_var_irr κ Δ₃ (f (g x)) _ _
  | @t_lam _ k1 k2 b => fun f g =>
      f_equal t_lam (eq_trans
        (tmap_tmap k2 (extC k1 Δ₁) (extC k1 Δ₂) (extC k1 Δ₃) b
           (liftA k1 f) (liftA k1 g))
        (tmap_ext k2 (extC k1 Δ₁) (extC k1 Δ₃) b
           (arrow_comp (liftA k1 f) (liftA k1 g)) (liftA k1 (arrow_comp f g))
           (fun x => match x with VZ => eq_refl | VS y => eq_refl end)))
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 σ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_app Δ₃ k1 k2 a b)
        (tmap_tmap (k1 ⇒ k2) Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ σ f g) (tmap_tmap k1 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => fun f g => eq_refl
  | @t_carr _ ψ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_carr Δ₃ a b)
        (cmap_tmap Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ψ f g) (tmap_tmap ⋆ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_cprod Δ₃ a b)
        (cmap_tmap Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ψ f g) (tmap_tmap ⋆ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  end

  forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
  cmap f (cmap g ψ) = cmap (arrow_comp f g) ψ :=
  match ψ as ψ' return
    forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
    cmap f (cmap g ψ') = cmap (arrow_comp f g) ψ' with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun x y => @c_eq Δ₃ κ x y)
        (tmap_tmap κ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ a f g) (tmap_tmap κ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ b f g)
  end.

Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma tmap_shift_comm (κ κ' : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂)
      (τ : typ κ' Δ₁) :
  tmap (liftA κ ρ) (shiftt κ τ) = shiftt κ (tmap ρ τ).
Proof.
  rewrite shiftt_eq. rewrite shiftt_eq.
  rewrite tmap_tmap.
  rewrite tmap_tmap.
  apply tmap_ext. intros x. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition liftS (k : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) :

Lemma shift_is_shiftt (k κ' : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (u : typ κ' Δ) :
  @shift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (typ κ') (@FMap_typ κ') (@extC kind k)

Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma compat_liftS (k : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind)
      (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃)

  forall κ (z : dom (extC k Δ₁)) EQ,
    tmap (liftA k ρL) (liftS k ρR κ z EQ) = liftS k ρR' κ z EQ.
Proof.
  intros κ [|y] EQ; simpl.
  - apply t_var_irr.
  - rewrite shift_is_shiftt. rewrite tmap_shift_comm. rewrite H.
    rewrite shift_is_shiftt. reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint tmap_tbind (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :
  forall (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃),
    (forall κ' (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ' x EQ) = ρR' κ' x EQ) ->
    tmap ρL (tbind ρR τ) = tbind ρR' τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
    forall (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃),
      (forall κ0 (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ0 x EQ) = ρR' κ0 x EQ) ->
      tmap ρL (tbind ρR τ') = tbind ρR' τ' with
  | @t_var _ κ x EQ => fun ρL ρR ρR' H => H κ x EQ
  | @t_lam _ k1 k2 b => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>
      f_equal t_lam
        (tmap_tbind k2 (extC k1 Δ₁) (extC k1 Δ₂) (extC k1 Δ₃) b
           (liftA k1 ρL) (liftS k1 ρR) (liftS k1 ρR') (compat_liftS k1 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ρL ρR ρR' H))
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 σ τ0 => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_app Δ₃ k1 k2 a b)
        (tmap_tbind (k1 ⇒ k2) Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ σ ρL ρR ρR' H)
        (tmap_tbind k1 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 ρL ρR ρR' H)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => fun ρL ρR ρR' H => eq_refl

Proof.
  induction 1; intros Δ₂ ρ; simpl.
  - apply rel_app_refl.
  - eapply rel_app_app; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_lift_eq {V : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ₁ Γ₂ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      (H : forall x, Γ₁ x = Γ₂ x) (σ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc V, (Γ₁ ▹ σ) y = (Γ₂ ▹ σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| apply H]. Qed.

Lemma ctx_lift2_eq {V : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ₁ Γ₂ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      (H : forall x, Γ₁ x = Γ₂ x) (σ τ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc (inc V), ((Γ₁ ▹ σ) ▹ τ) y = ((Γ₂ ▹ σ) ▹ τ) y.
Proof. intros [|[|x]]; simpl; try reflexivity; apply H. Qed.

Lemma ctx_shift_eq {V : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ₁ Γ₂ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      (H : forall x, Γ₁ x = Γ₂ x) (κ : kind) :
  forall y : V, (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ₁) y = (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ₂) y.
Proof. intro y. simpl. apply f_equal, H. Qed.

Lemma ctx_shift_extend_eq {V : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ₁ Γ₂ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      (H : forall x, Γ₁ x = Γ₂ x) (κ : kind) (σ : typ ⋆ (@extC kind κ Δ)) :
  forall y : inc V,
    (Env.extend (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ₁) σ) y =
    (Env.extend (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ₂) σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| apply f_equal, H]. Qed.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Set Binding.Auto.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Types.

Import DED_kind.

Inductive ax := L | R.

Inductive value {V : Set} :=
| v_var (x : V) : value
| v_unit : value
| v_lam (e : @expr (inc V)) : value
| v_pair (v₁ v₂ : value) : value
| v_inj (a : ax) (v : value) : value
| v_tlam (e : expr) : value
| v_pack (v : value) : value
| v_roll (v : value) : value
| v_lamC  (e : expr) : value
| v_withC (v : value) : value
| v_fix (e : @expr (inc (inc V))) : value
with expr {V : Set} :=
| e_val (v : value) : expr
| e_bind (e₁ : expr) (e₂ : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_app (v₁ v₂ : value) : expr
| e_tapp (v : value) : expr
| e_proj (a : ax) (v : value) : expr
| e_abort (v : value) : expr
| e_case (v : value) (e₁ e₂ : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_unpack (v : value) (e : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_unroll (v : value) : expr
| e_cabort : expr
| e_capp (v : value) : expr
| e_lwith (v : value) (e : @expr (inc V)) : expr.

Arguments value V%bind : clear implicits.

Arguments expr  V%bind : clear implicits.

Declare Scope syn_scope.

Delimit Scope syn_scope with syn.

Coercion e_val : value >-> expr.

Coercion e_app : value >-> Funclass.

Notation "e₁ >>= e₂" := (e_bind e₁ e₂) (at level 45, right associativity) : syn_scope.

Notation "'ƛ' e" := (v_lam e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨⟩" := v_unit : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨ v ⟩ᶜ" := (v_withC v) : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨ v₁ , v₂ ⟩" := (v_pair v₁ v₂) : syn_scope.

Notation "'Λ' e" := (v_tlam e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "'ƛᶜ' e" := (v_lamC e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "'rec' e" := (v_fix e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Local Open Scope bind_scope.

Local Open Scope syn_scope.

Fixpoint emap {A B : Set} (f : A [→] B) (e : expr A) : expr B :=
  match e with
  | e_val v => vmap f v
  | e₁ >>= e₂ => emap f e₁ >>= emap (f ↑) e₂
  | e_app v₁ v₂ => (vmap f v₁) (vmap f v₂)
  | e_tapp v => e_tapp (vmap f v)
  | e_proj x v => e_proj x (vmap f v)
  | e_abort v => e_abort (vmap f v)
  | e_case v e₁ e₂ => e_case (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e₁) (emap (f ↑) e₂)
  | e_unpack v e => e_unpack (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e)
  | e_unroll v => e_unroll (vmap f v)
  | e_cabort => e_cabort
  | e_capp v => e_capp (vmap f v)
  | e_lwith v e => e_lwith (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e)
  end
with vmap {A B : Set} (f : A [→] B) (v : value A) : value B :=
       match v with
       | v_var x => v_var (f x)
       | ƛ e => ƛ (emap (f ↑) e)
       | Λ e => Λ (emap f e)
       | ⟨⟩ => ⟨⟩
       | ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ⟨vmap f v₁, vmap f v₂⟩
       | v_inj x v => v_inj x (vmap f v)
       | v_pack v => v_pack (vmap f v)
       | v_roll v => v_roll (vmap f v)
       | ƛᶜ e => v_lamC (emap f e)
       | ⟨v⟩ᶜ => ⟨vmap f v⟩ᶜ
       | rec e => rec (emap ((f ↑) ↑) e)
       end.

#[export] Instance FMap_expr : FunctorCore expr := @emap.

#[export] Instance FMap_val  : FunctorCore value := @vmap.

#[export] Instance SPC_val : SetPureCore value := @v_var.

Fixpoint ebind {X Y : Set} (f : X [⇒] Y) (e : expr X) : expr Y :=
  match e with
  | e_val v => vbind f v
  | e₁ >>= e₂ => ebind f e₁ >>= ebind (f ↑) e₂
  | e_app v₁ v₂ => (vbind f v₁) (vbind f v₂)
  | e_tapp v => e_tapp (vbind f v)
  | e_proj x v => e_proj x (vbind f v)
  | e_abort v => e_abort (vbind f v)
  | e_case v e₁ e₂ => e_case (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e₁) (ebind (f ↑) e₂)
  | e_unpack v e => e_unpack (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e)
  | e_unroll v => e_unroll (vbind f v)
  | e_cabort => e_cabort
  | e_capp v => e_capp (vbind f v)
  | e_lwith v e => e_lwith (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e)
  end
with vbind {X Y : Set} (f : X [⇒] Y) (v : value X) : value Y :=
       match v with
       | v_var x => f x
       | ƛ e => ƛ (ebind (f ↑) e)
       | Λ e => Λ (ebind f e)
       | ⟨⟩ => ⟨⟩
       | ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ⟨vbind f v₁, vbind f v₂⟩
       | v_inj x v => v_inj x (vbind f v)
       | v_pack v => v_pack (vbind f v)
       | v_roll v => v_roll (vbind f v)
       | ƛᶜ  e => ƛᶜ (ebind f e)
       | ⟨v⟩ᶜ => ⟨vbind f v⟩ᶜ
       | rec e => rec (ebind ((f ↑) ↑) e)
       end.

#[export] Instance BindCore_expr : BindCore expr := @ebind.

#[export] Instance BindCore_val  : BindCore value := @vbind.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib.

Require Import Coq.Relations.Relation_Operators Coq.Relations.Operators_Properties Coq.Classes.RelationClasses.

Reserved Notation "e ↦ e'" (at level 70).

Inductive head_step : expr ∅ → expr ∅ → Prop :=
| LamBetaRec e v : (rec e) v ↦ subst (Inc := inc) ((subst (Inc := inc) e) (shift v)) (rec e)
| LamBetaE e v : (ƛ e) v ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| LamBetaT e : e_tapp (Λ e) ↦ e
| LamBetaC e : e_capp (ƛᶜ e) ↦ e
| ProjLE v1 v2 : e_proj L ⟨v1, v2⟩ ↦ v1
| ProjRE v1 v2 : e_proj R ⟨v1, v2⟩ ↦ v2
| CaseLE v e1 e2 : e_case (v_inj L v) e1 e2 ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e1 v
| CaseRE v e1 e2 : e_case (v_inj R v) e1 e2 ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e2 v
| UnpackE v e : e_unpack (v_pack v) e ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| UnrollE v : e_unroll (v_roll v) ↦ v
| WithE v e : e_lwith ⟨v⟩ᶜ e ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| BindE e' (v : value ∅) : v >>= e' ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e' v
| BindE' e e' e'' : e' ↦ e'' -> e_bind e' e ↦ e_bind e'' e
where "e ↦ e'" := (head_step e%syn e'%syn).

Definition step := clos_refl_trans_1n (expr ∅) head_step.

Notation "e ↦* e'" := (step e%syn e'%syn) (at level 70).

Definition safe (e : expr ∅) :=
  forall e', e ↦* e' -> (∃ v, e' = e_val v) \/ (exists e'', e' ↦ e'').

Inductive nsteps : nat -> expr ∅ -> expr ∅ -> Prop :=
| nsteps_step ρ :
  nsteps 0 ρ ρ
| nsteps_l n ρ1 ρ2 ρ3 :
  head_step ρ1 ρ2 ->
  nsteps n ρ2 ρ3 →
  nsteps (S n) ρ1 ρ3.

Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Require Import Coq.Relations.Relation_Operators Coq.Relations.Operators_Properties.

Local Open Scope syn_scope.

Require Import List.
Require Import Eqdep_dec.

Definition ren_arr {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) : Binding.Set.Arr A B :=
  @Binding.Set.Build_Arr A B f.
Definition vren {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) (v : value A) : value B := vmap (ren_arr f) v.
Definition eren {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) (e : expr A) : expr B := emap (ren_arr f) e.

Lemma rel_lift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc V, (Γ' ▹ σ) (@inc_map V V' f y) = (Γ ▹ σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| exact (Hf x)]. Qed.

Lemma rel_lift2 {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ τ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc (inc V),
    ((Γ' ▹ σ) ▹ τ) (@inc_map (inc V) (inc V') (@inc_map V V' f) y) = ((Γ ▹ σ) ▹ τ) y.
Proof.
  intros [|[|x]]; simpl; try reflexivity; exact (Hf x).
Qed.

Definition shiftt (κ : kind) {κ' : kind} {Δ : Ctx kind} (τ : typ κ' Δ) :
  typ κ' (@extC kind κ Δ) :=
  @shift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (typ κ') (@FMap_typ κ') (@extC kind κ)
         (@ShiftableCore_ext kind κ) Δ τ.

Lemma rel_shift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (κ : kind) :
  forall y : V, (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ') (f y) = (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ) y.
Proof. intro y. unfold shiftt. simpl. apply f_equal, Hf. Qed.

Lemma rel_shift_extend {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (κ : kind) (σ : typ ⋆ (@extC kind κ Δ)) :
  forall y : inc V,
    (Env.extend (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ') σ) (@inc_map V V' f y) =
    (Env.extend (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ) σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| unfold shiftt; simpl; apply f_equal, Hf]. Qed.

Scheme typing_expr_mut := Induction for typing_expr Sort Prop
with typing_val_mut := Induction for typing_val Sort Prop.

Lemma typing_ren_mut :
  (forall (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
          (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ), Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
   forall (V' : Set) (Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ) (f : V -> V'),

  /\
  (forall (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
          (v : value V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ), Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ ->
   forall (V' : Set) (Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ) (f : V -> V'),
     (forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ' ⊢ᵥ vren f v : τ).
Proof.
  assert (HE : forall (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)

   forall (V' : Set) (Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ) (f : V -> V'),
     (forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ' ⊢ₑ eren f e : τ).
  { intros V Δ Ψ Γ e τ H.
    induction H using typing_expr_mut with
      (P0 := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)

             forall (V' : Set) (Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ) (f : V -> V'),

#[export] Instance SPC_val : SetPureCore value := @v_var.

Fixpoint ebind {X Y : Set} (f : X [⇒] Y) (e : expr X) : expr Y :=
  match e with
  | e_val v => vbind f v
  | e₁ >>= e₂ => ebind f e₁ >>= ebind (f ↑) e₂
  | e_app v₁ v₂ => (vbind f v₁) (vbind f v₂)
  | e_tapp v => e_tapp (vbind f v)
  | e_proj x v => e_proj x (vbind f v)
  | e_abort v => e_abort (vbind f v)
  | e_case v e₁ e₂ => e_case (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e₁) (ebind (f ↑) e₂)
  | e_unpack v e => e_unpack (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e)
  | e_unroll v => e_unroll (vbind f v)
  | e_cabort => e_cabort
  | e_capp v => e_capp (vbind f v)
  | e_lwith v e => e_lwith (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e)
  end
with vbind {X Y : Set} (f : X [⇒] Y) (v : value X) : value Y :=
       match v with
       | v_var x => f x
       | ƛ e => ƛ (ebind (f ↑) e)
       | Λ e => Λ (ebind f e)
       | ⟨⟩ => ⟨⟩
       | ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ⟨vbind f v₁, vbind f v₂⟩
       | v_inj x v => v_inj x (vbind f v)
       | v_pack v => v_pack (vbind f v)
       | v_roll v => v_roll (vbind f v)
       | ƛᶜ  e => ƛᶜ (ebind f e)
       | ⟨v⟩ᶜ => ⟨vbind f v⟩ᶜ
       | rec e => rec (ebind ((f ↑) ↑) e)
       end.

#[export] Instance BindCore_expr : BindCore expr := @ebind.

#[export] Instance BindCore_val  : BindCore value := @vbind.

Inductive head_step : expr ∅ → expr ∅ → Prop :=
| LamBetaRec e v : (rec e) v ↦ subst (Inc := inc) ((subst (Inc := inc) e) (shift v)) (rec e)
| LamBetaE e v : (ƛ e) v ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| LamBetaT e : e_tapp (Λ e) ↦ e
| LamBetaC e : e_capp (ƛᶜ e) ↦ e
| ProjLE v1 v2 : e_proj L ⟨v1, v2⟩ ↦ v1
| ProjRE v1 v2 : e_proj R ⟨v1, v2⟩ ↦ v2
| CaseLE v e1 e2 : e_case (v_inj L v) e1 e2 ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e1 v
| CaseRE v e1 e2 : e_case (v_inj R v) e1 e2 ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e2 v
| UnpackE v e : e_unpack (v_pack v) e ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| UnrollE v : e_unroll (v_roll v) ↦ v
| WithE v e : e_lwith ⟨v⟩ᶜ e ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| BindE e' (v : value ∅) : v >>= e' ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e' v
| BindE' e e' e'' : e' ↦ e'' -> e_bind e' e ↦ e_bind e'' e
where "e ↦ e'" := (head_step e%syn e'%syn).

Definition step := clos_refl_trans_1n (expr ∅) head_step.

Notation "e ↦* e'" := (step e%syn e'%syn) (at level 70).

Definition safe (e : expr ∅) :=
  forall e', e ↦* e' -> (∃ v, e' = e_val v) \/ (exists e'', e' ↦ e'').

Inductive nsteps : nat -> expr ∅ -> expr ∅ -> Prop :=
| nsteps_step ρ :
  nsteps 0 ρ ρ
| nsteps_l n ρ1 ρ2 ρ3 :
  head_step ρ1 ρ2 ->
  nsteps n ρ2 ρ3 →
  nsteps (S n) ρ1 ρ3.

Definition ren_arr {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) : Binding.Set.Arr A B :=

Definition vren {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) (v : value A) : value B := vmap (ren_arr f) v.
Definition eren {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) (e : expr A) : expr B := emap (ren_arr f) e.

Lemma rel_lift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc V, (Γ' ▹ σ) (@inc_map V V' f y) = (Γ ▹ σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| exact (Hf x)]. Qed.

Lemma rel_lift2 {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ τ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc (inc V),
    ((Γ' ▹ σ) ▹ τ) (@inc_map (inc V) (inc V') (@inc_map V V' f) y) = ((Γ ▹ σ) ▹ τ) y.
Proof.
  intros [|[|x]]; simpl; try reflexivity; exact (Hf x).
Qed.

Definition shiftt (κ : kind) {κ' : kind} {Δ : Ctx kind} (τ : typ κ' Δ) :
  typ κ' (@extC kind κ Δ) :=
  @shift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (typ κ') (@FMap_typ κ') (@extC kind κ)
         (@ShiftableCore_ext kind κ) Δ τ.

Lemma rel_shift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (κ : kind) :
  forall y : V, (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ') (f y) = (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ) y.
Proof. intro y. unfold shiftt. simpl. apply f_equal, Hf. Qed.

Lemma rel_shift_extend {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (κ : kind) (σ : typ ⋆ (@extC kind κ Δ)) :
  forall y : inc V,
    (Env.extend (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ') σ) (@inc_map V V' f y) =
    (Env.extend (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ) σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| unfold shiftt; simpl; apply f_equal, Hf]. Qed.
