  (forall (V : Set) (Δ₁ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ₁)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ₁)
          (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ₁), Δ₁ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
   forall (Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
     Δ₂ ∣ map (cmap ρ) Ψ ∣ (fun x => tmap ρ (Γ x)) ⊢ₑ e : tmap ρ τ)
  /\
  (forall (V : Set) (Δ₁ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ₁)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ₁)
          (v : value V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ₁), Δ₁ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ ->
   forall (Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
     Δ₂ ∣ map (cmap ρ) Ψ ∣ (fun x => tmap ρ (Γ x)) ⊢ᵥ v : tmap ρ τ).
Proof.
  assert (HE : forall (V : Set) (Δ₁ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ₁)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ₁)
          (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ₁), Δ₁ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
   forall (Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
     Δ₂ ∣ map (cmap ρ) Ψ ∣ (fun x => tmap ρ (Γ x)) ⊢ₑ e : tmap ρ τ).
  { intros V Δ₁ Ψ Γ e τ H.
    induction H using typing_expr_mut with
      (P := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
                 (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) (_ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ) =>
             forall (Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ Δ₂),
               Δ₂ ∣ map (cmap ρ) Ψ ∣ (fun x => tmap ρ (Γ x)) ⊢ₑ e : tmap ρ τ)
      (P0 := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
                 (v : value V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) (_ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ) =>
             forall (Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ Δ₂),
               Δ₂ ∣ map (cmap ρ) Ψ ∣ (fun x => tmap ρ (Γ x)) ⊢ᵥ v : tmap ρ τ).
    - (* T_val *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_val; eauto.
    - (* T_bind *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_bind.
      + eauto.
      + eapply typing_expr_congr.
        * eauto.
        * intros [|x]; simpl; reflexivity.
    - (* T_congE *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_congE; eauto using tproves_tmap.
    - (* T_app *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_app; eauto.
    - (* T_tapp *) intros Δ₂ ρ. rewrite (tmap_subst κ ⋆ _ Δ₂ ρ τ σ). eapply T_tapp; eauto.
    - (* T_projL *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_projL; eauto.
    - (* T_projR *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_projR; eauto.
    - (* T_abort *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_abort; eauto.
    - (* T_case *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_case.
      + eapply typing_expr_congr.
        * eauto.
        * intros [|x]; simpl; reflexivity.
      + eapply typing_expr_congr.
        * eauto.
        * intros [|x]; simpl; reflexivity.
      + eauto.
    - (* T_unpack *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_unpack.
      + eauto.
      + rewrite <- map_shift_cmap.
        eapply typing_expr_congr.
        * rewrite <- tmap_shift_comm. eauto.
        * intros [|x]; simpl.
          -- reflexivity.
          -- rewrite tmap_shift_comm. reflexivity.
    - (* T_unroll *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_unroll.
      + exact (rel_app_tmap HF Δ₂ ρ).
      + eauto.
    - (* T_cabort *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_cabort; eauto using tproves_tmap, tdiscr_cmap.
    - (* T_capp *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_capp; eauto using tproves_tmap.
    - (* T_lwith *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_lwith.
      + eauto.
      + eapply typing_expr_congr.
        * eauto.
        * intros [|x]; simpl; reflexivity. }
  split; [ exact HE | ].
  intros V Δ₁ Ψ Γ v τ H.
  induction H using typing_val_mut with
    (P := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
               (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) (_ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ) =>
           forall (Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ Δ₂),
             Δ₂ ∣ map (cmap ρ) Ψ ∣ (fun x => tmap ρ (Γ x)) ⊢ₑ e : tmap ρ τ)
    (P0 := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
               (v : value V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) (_ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ) =>
           forall (Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ Δ₂),
             Δ₂ ∣ map (cmap ρ) Ψ ∣ (fun x => tmap ρ (Γ x)) ⊢ᵥ v : tmap ρ τ).
  - (* T_var *) intros Δ₂ ρ. apply T_var. simpl. rewrite EQ. reflexivity.
  - (* T_congV *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_congV; eauto using tproves_tmap.
  - (* T_unit *) intros Δ₂ ρ. apply T_unit.
  - (* T_lam *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_lam.
    eapply typing_expr_congr.
    + eauto.
    + intros [|x]; simpl; reflexivity.
  - (* T_pair *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_pair; eauto.
  - (* T_injl *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_injl; eauto.
  - (* T_injr *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_injr; eauto.
  - (* T_tlam *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_tlam.
    rewrite <- map_shift_cmap.
    eapply typing_expr_congr.
    + eauto.
    + intro x. simpl. rewrite tmap_shift_comm. reflexivity.
  - (* T_pack *) intros Δ₂ ρ. rewrite (tmap_subst κ ⋆ _ Δ₂ ρ τ τ'). eapply T_pack; eauto.
  - (* T_roll *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_roll.
    + exact (rel_app_tmap HF Δ₂ ρ).
    + eauto.
  - (* T_lamC *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_lamC; eauto.
  - (* T_withC *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_withC; eauto using tproves_tmap.
  - (* T_rec *) intros Δ₂ ρ. eapply T_rec.
    eapply typing_expr_congr.
    + eauto.
    + intros [|[|x]]; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

Fixpoint tmap_tbind (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :
  forall (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃),
    (forall κ' (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ' x EQ) = ρR' κ' x EQ) ->
    tmap ρL (tbind ρR τ) = tbind ρR' τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
    forall (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃),
      (forall κ0 (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ0 x EQ) = ρR' κ0 x EQ) ->
      tmap ρL (tbind ρR τ') = tbind ρR' τ' with
  | @t_var _ κ x EQ => fun ρL ρR ρR' H => H κ x EQ
  | @t_lam _ k1 k2 b => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>
      f_equal t_lam
        (tmap_tbind k2 (extC k1 Δ₁) (extC k1 Δ₂) (extC k1 Δ₃) b
           (liftA k1 ρL) (liftS k1 ρR) (liftS k1 ρR') (compat_liftS k1 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ρL ρR ρR' H))
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 σ τ0 => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_app Δ₃ k1 k2 a b)
        (tmap_tbind (k1 ⇒ k2) Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ σ ρL ρR ρR' H)
        (tmap_tbind k1 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 ρL ρR ρR' H)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => fun ρL ρR ρR' H => eq_refl
  | @t_carr _ ψ τ0 => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_carr Δ₃ a b)
        (cmap_cbind Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ψ ρL ρR ρR' H) (tmap_tbind ⋆ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 ρL ρR ρR' H)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ τ0 => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_cprod Δ₃ a b)
        (cmap_cbind Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ψ ρL ρR ρR' H) (tmap_tbind ⋆ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 ρL ρR ρR' H)
  end
with cmap_cbind (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ₁) {struct ψ} :
  forall (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃),
    (forall κ' (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ' x EQ) = ρR' κ' x EQ) ->
    cmap ρL (cbind ρR ψ) = cbind ρR' ψ :=
  match ψ as ψ' return
    forall (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃),
      (forall κ0 (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ0 x EQ) = ρR' κ0 x EQ) ->
      cmap ρL (cbind ρR ψ') = cbind ρR' ψ' with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>
      f_equal2 (fun x y => @c_eq Δ₃ κ x y)
        (tmap_tbind κ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ a ρL ρR ρR' H)
        (tmap_tbind κ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ b ρL ρR ρR' H)
  end.

Definition compSub (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃ :=
  @Build_Sub kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ Δ₁ Δ₃
    (fun v x EQ => tmap ρL (ρR v x EQ)).

      (κ₂ : kind) (τ₁ τ₂ : typ κ₂ Δ₁) :

    rel_app κ₁ (tbind ρ σ₁) (tbind ρ σ₂) κ₂ (tbind ρ τ₁) (tbind ρ τ₂).

  - apply rel_app_refl.
  - eapply rel_app_app; eauto.

Lemma rel_app_tbind_rec {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ))
      (σ₁ σ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) :

              (subst (tbind (liftS κ ρ) τ) (rec_type Δ₂ κ (tbind (liftS κ ρ) τ)))
              ⋆ (tbind ρ σ₁) (tbind ρ σ₂).

  rewrite (tbind_subst κ κ Δ Δ₂ ρ (liftS_pirr κ Δ Δ₂ ρ
             (fun v x e1 e2 => eq_refl)) ) in HR.
  exact HR.
Qed.

Require Import Eqdep.

Require Import Eqdep_dec.

Inductive kind := KTyp | KArr (κ₁ κ₂ : kind).

Notation "⋆" := KTyp.

Notation "κ₁ ⇒ κ₂" := (KArr κ₁ κ₂) (at level 45, right associativity).

| tc_unit : tctor ⋆
| tc_void : tctor ⋆
| tc_arr  : tctor (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆)

| tc_rec  κ : tctor ((κ ⇒ κ) ⇒ κ).

      {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {v : value V} {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} (σ : typ ⋆ Δ) :

  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ),
    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ e_app (v_fix e) v : τ ->
    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ subst (Inc := inc)

  destruct (typing_expr_app_inv H (v_fix e) v eq_refl)

  destruct (Cval_fix_inv (typing_val_canonical HVfix) e eq_refl)

  assert (Hrec : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ᵥ v_fix e : τ1' →ᵗ τ2')
    by (eapply T_congV; [ exact (tpi_symm HEQarr) | exact HVfix ]).
  pose proof (typing_subst_one (V := ∅) (Δ := Δ) (Ψ := Ψ) (Γ := □)
                (v := v_fix e) (σ := τ1' →ᵗ τ2')
                (e := subst (Inc := inc) e (vren (fun x : ∅ => VS x) v))
                (τ := τ2') Hinner Hrec) as Houter.
  change (Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ subst (Inc := inc)
            (subst (Inc := inc) e (vren (fun x : ∅ => VS x) v)) (v_fix e) : τ2')
    in Houter.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax Lang.FOmegaEq.OpSemantics Lang.FOmegaEq.Typing.

Require Import Binding.Intrinsic.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Env.

Import kindEqDec.

Require Import Coq.Relations.Relation_Operators Coq.Relations.Operators_Properties.

Local Open Scope syn_scope.

Require Import List.
Require Import Eqdep_dec.

Definition ren_arr {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) : Binding.Set.Arr A B :=
  @Binding.Set.Build_Arr A B f.
Definition vren {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) (v : value A) : value B := vmap (ren_arr f) v.
Definition eren {A B : Set} (f : A -> B) (e : expr A) : expr B := emap (ren_arr f) e.

Lemma rel_lift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc V, (Γ' ▹ σ) (@inc_map V V' f y) = (Γ ▹ σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| exact (Hf x)]. Qed.

Lemma rel_lift2 {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ τ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc (inc V),
    ((Γ' ▹ σ) ▹ τ) (@inc_map (inc V) (inc V') (@inc_map V V' f) y) = ((Γ ▹ σ) ▹ τ) y.
Proof.
  intros [|[|x]]; simpl; try reflexivity; exact (Hf x).
Qed.

Definition shiftt (κ : kind) {κ' : kind} {Δ : Ctx kind} (τ : typ κ' Δ) :
  typ κ' (@extC kind κ Δ) :=
  @shift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (typ κ') (@FMap_typ κ') (@extC kind κ)
         (@ShiftableCore_ext kind κ) Δ τ.

Lemma rel_shift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (κ : kind) :
  forall y : V, (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ') (f y) = (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ) y.
Proof. intro y. unfold shiftt. simpl. apply f_equal, Hf. Qed.

Lemma rel_shift_extend {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (κ : kind) (σ : typ ⋆ (@extC kind κ Δ)) :
  forall y : inc V,
    (Env.extend (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ') σ) (@inc_map V V' f y) =
    (Env.extend (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ) σ) y.
Proof. intros [|x]; simpl; [reflexivity| unfold shiftt; simpl; apply f_equal, Hf]. Qed.

Scheme typing_expr_mut := Induction for typing_expr Sort Prop
with typing_val_mut := Induction for typing_val Sort Prop.

Lemma typing_ren_mut :
  (forall (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
          (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ), Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
   forall (V' : Set) (Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ) (f : V -> V'),
     (forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ' ⊢ₑ eren f e : τ)
  /\
  (forall (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
          (v : value V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ), Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ ->
   forall (V' : Set) (Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ) (f : V -> V'),
     (forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ' ⊢ᵥ vren f v : τ).
Proof.
  assert (HE : forall (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
          (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ), Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
   forall (V' : Set) (Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ) (f : V -> V'),

    - (* T_congE *) intros V' Γ' f Hf. simpl. eapply T_congE; eauto.
    - (* T_app *) intros V' Γ' f Hf. simpl. eapply T_app; eauto.
    - (* T_tapp *) intros V' Γ' f Hf. simpl. eapply T_tapp; eauto.
    - (* T_projL *) intros V' Γ' f Hf. simpl. eapply T_projL; eauto.
    - (* T_projR *) intros V' Γ' f Hf. simpl. eapply T_projR; eauto.
    - (* T_abort *) intros V' Γ' f Hf. simpl. eapply T_abort; eauto.
    - (* T_case *) intros V' Γ' f Hf. simpl. eapply T_case; eauto 12 using rel_lift.
    - (* T_unpack *) intros V' Γ' f Hf. simpl. eapply T_unpack; eauto 12 using rel_shift_extend.

Lemma t_var_irr (κ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (x : dom Δ) (p q : Δ x = κ) :
  t_var κ x p = t_var κ x q.
Proof. f_equal. apply (UIP_dec kindEqDec.eq_dec). Qed.

Lemma tmap_var_ext (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (x : dom Δ₁) (EQ : Δ₁ x = κ)
      (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂) (H : ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) :
  t_var κ (ρ₁ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₁ x) EQ) =
  t_var κ (ρ₂ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₂ x) EQ).
Proof.
  refine (eq_ind (ρ₁ x) (fun w => forall (r : Δ₂ w = κ),
            t_var κ (ρ₁ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₁ x) EQ) = t_var κ w r)
          _ (ρ₂ x) H _).
  intro r. apply t_var_irr.
Qed.

Fixpoint tmap_ext (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :
  forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
  tmap ρ₁ τ = tmap ρ₂ τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
        forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
        tmap ρ₁ τ' = tmap ρ₂ τ' with
  | t_var κ x EQ => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H => tmap_var_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ x EQ ρ₁ ρ₂ (H x)
  | t_lam b => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal t_lam
        (tmap_ext _ (extC _ Δ₁) (extC _ Δ₂) b
           (lift ρ₁) (lift ρ₂)
           (fun x => match x with VZ => eq_refl | VS y => f_equal (@VS (dom _)) (H y) end))
  | t_app σ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun f a => @t_app Δ₂ _ _ f a)
        (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ σ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  | t_ctor c => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H => eq_refl
  | t_carr ψ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z a => @t_carr Δ₂ z a)
        (cmap_ext Δ₁ Δ₂ ψ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  | t_cprod ψ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z a => @t_cprod Δ₂ z a)
        (cmap_ext Δ₁ Δ₂ ψ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  end
with cmap_ext (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ₁) {struct ψ} :
  forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
  cmap ρ₁ ψ = cmap ρ₂ ψ :=
  match ψ as ψ' return
        forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
        cmap ρ₁ ψ' = cmap ρ₂ ψ' with
  | c_eq κ a b => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z w => @c_eq Δ₂ κ z w)
        (tmap_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ a ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ b ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  end.

Definition liftA (κ : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂) :
  @Arr kind (extC κ Δ₁) (extC κ Δ₂) :=
  @lift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (@extC kind κ) (@ALiftableCore_ext kind κ) Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

Definition mkShift (κ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) : @Arr kind Δ (extC κ Δ) :=
  @Build_Arr kind Δ (extC κ Δ) (fun x => @VS (dom Δ) x) (fun x => eq_refl).

Fixpoint tmap_tmap (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :
  forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
  tmap f (tmap g τ) = tmap (arrow_comp f g) τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
    forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
    tmap f (tmap g τ') = tmap (arrow_comp f g) τ' with
  | @t_var _ κ x EQ => fun f g =>
      t_var_irr κ Δ₃ (f (g x)) _ _
  | @t_lam _ k1 k2 b => fun f g =>
      f_equal t_lam (eq_trans
        (tmap_tmap k2 (extC k1 Δ₁) (extC k1 Δ₂) (extC k1 Δ₃) b
           (liftA k1 f) (liftA k1 g))
        (tmap_ext k2 (extC k1 Δ₁) (extC k1 Δ₃) b
           (arrow_comp (liftA k1 f) (liftA k1 g)) (liftA k1 (arrow_comp f g))
           (fun x => match x with VZ => eq_refl | VS y => eq_refl end)))
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 σ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_app Δ₃ k1 k2 a b)
        (tmap_tmap (k1 ⇒ k2) Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ σ f g) (tmap_tmap k1 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => fun f g => eq_refl
  | @t_carr _ ψ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_carr Δ₃ a b)
        (cmap_tmap Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ψ f g) (tmap_tmap ⋆ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_cprod Δ₃ a b)
        (cmap_tmap Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ψ f g) (tmap_tmap ⋆ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  end

  forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),

  match ψ as ψ' return
    forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),

  | @c_eq _ κ a b => fun f g =>

        (tmap_tmap κ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ a f g) (tmap_tmap κ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ b f g)
  end.

           (lift ρ₁) (lift ρ₂)
           (fun x => match x with VZ => eq_refl | VS y => f_equal (@VS (dom _)) (H y) end))
  | t_app σ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun f a => @t_app Δ₂ _ _ f a)
        (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ σ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  | t_ctor c => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H => eq_refl
  | t_carr ψ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z a => @t_carr Δ₂ z a)
        (cmap_ext Δ₁ Δ₂ ψ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  | t_cprod ψ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z a => @t_cprod Δ₂ z a)
        (cmap_ext Δ₁ Δ₂ ψ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  end
with cmap_ext (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ₁) {struct ψ} :
  forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
  cmap ρ₁ ψ = cmap ρ₂ ψ :=
  match ψ as ψ' return
        forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
        cmap ρ₁ ψ' = cmap ρ₂ ψ' with
  | c_eq κ a b => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun z w => @c_eq Δ₂ κ z w)
        (tmap_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ a ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ b ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
  end.

Definition liftA (κ : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂) :
  @Arr kind (extC κ Δ₁) (extC κ Δ₂) :=
  @lift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (@extC kind κ) (@ALiftableCore_ext kind κ) Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

Definition mkShift (κ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) : @Arr kind Δ (extC κ Δ) :=
  @Build_Arr kind Δ (extC κ Δ) (fun x => @VS (dom Δ) x) (fun x => eq_refl).

Fixpoint tmap_tmap (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :
  forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
  tmap f (tmap g τ) = tmap (arrow_comp f g) τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
    forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
    tmap f (tmap g τ') = tmap (arrow_comp f g) τ' with
  | @t_var _ κ x EQ => fun f g =>
      t_var_irr κ Δ₃ (f (g x)) _ _
  | @t_lam _ k1 k2 b => fun f g =>
      f_equal t_lam (eq_trans
        (tmap_tmap k2 (extC k1 Δ₁) (extC k1 Δ₂) (extC k1 Δ₃) b
           (liftA k1 f) (liftA k1 g))
        (tmap_ext k2 (extC k1 Δ₁) (extC k1 Δ₃) b
           (arrow_comp (liftA k1 f) (liftA k1 g)) (liftA k1 (arrow_comp f g))
           (fun x => match x with VZ => eq_refl | VS y => eq_refl end)))
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 σ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_app Δ₃ k1 k2 a b)
        (tmap_tmap (k1 ⇒ k2) Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ σ f g) (tmap_tmap k1 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => fun f g => eq_refl
  | @t_carr _ ψ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_carr Δ₃ a b)
        (cmap_tmap Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ψ f g) (tmap_tmap ⋆ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ τ0 => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun a b => @t_cprod Δ₃ a b)
        (cmap_tmap Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ψ f g) (tmap_tmap ⋆ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ τ0 f g)
  end
with cmap_tmap (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ₁) {struct ψ} :
  forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
  cmap f (cmap g ψ) = cmap (arrow_comp f g) ψ :=
  match ψ as ψ' return
    forall (f : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (g : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂),
    cmap f (cmap g ψ') = cmap (arrow_comp f g) ψ' with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => fun f g =>
      f_equal2 (fun x y => @c_eq Δ₃ κ x y)
        (tmap_tmap κ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ a f g) (tmap_tmap κ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ b f g)
  end.

Lemma shiftt_eq (κ κ' : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ' Δ) :
  shiftt κ τ = tmap (mkShift κ Δ) τ.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma tmap_shift_comm (κ κ' : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂)

  rewrite tmap_tmap.

Qed.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Auto.

Require Import FOmegaEq.Kinds.

Inductive type {Δ : Ctx kind} : kind → Type :=
| t_var κ (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ) : type κ
| t_lam {κₐ κᵣ} (τ : @type (Δ ▹ κₐ) κᵣ) : type (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)
| t_app {κₐ κᵣ} (σ : type (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)) (τ : type κₐ) : type κᵣ
| t_ctor {κ} (c : tctor κ) : type κ
| t_carr  (ψ : constr) (τ : type ⋆) : type ⋆
| t_cprod (ψ : constr) (τ : type ⋆) : type ⋆
with constr {Δ : Ctx kind} : Type :=
| c_eq (κ : kind) (τ₁ τ₂ : type κ) : constr.

Arguments type Δ : clear implicits.

Arguments constr Δ : clear implicits.

Require Import Basics.

Definition typ := flip type.

Declare Scope typ_scope.

Delimit Scope typ_scope with typ.

Coercion t_ctor : tctor >-> type.

Coercion t_app : type >-> Funclass.

Definition rec_type (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ)) : typ κ Δ
  := (tc_rec κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_arr {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_arr τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_prod {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_prod τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_sum {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_sum τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_all {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_all κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_xist {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_xist κ) (t_lam τ).

Notation "'ƛ' τ" := (t_lam τ : typ _ _) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "σ →ᵗ τ" := (t_arr σ τ) (at level 55, right associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ + τ₂" := (t_sum τ₁ τ₂) (at level 50, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ × τ₂" := (t_prod τ₁ τ₂) (at level 40, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "χ →ᶜ τ" := (t_carr χ τ) (at level 55, right associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "χ ×ᶜ τ" := (t_cprod χ τ) (at level 40, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ ≃ τ₂" := (c_eq _ τ₁ τ₂) (at level 65, no associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "∀ᵗ κ , τ" := (t_all κ τ) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "∃ᵗ κ , τ" := (t_xist κ τ) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "⊥" := tc_void : typ_scope.

Notation "'⊤'" := tc_unit : typ_scope.

Notation "'0ᵛ'" := (t_var _ (VZ : dom (_ ▹ _)) eq_refl).

Local Open Scope bind_scope.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Fixpoint tmap {κ} {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (δ : Δ₁ [→] Δ₂) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) : typ κ Δ₂ :=
  match τ with
  | t_var κ x EQ => t_var κ (δ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom δ x) EQ)
  | t_lam τ => ƛ tmap (δ ↑) τ
  | t_app σ τ => (tmap δ σ) (tmap δ τ)
  | t_ctor c  => c
  | φ →ᶜ τ => cmap δ φ →ᶜ tmap δ τ
  | φ ×ᶜ τ => cmap δ φ ×ᶜ tmap δ τ
  end
with cmap {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (δ : Δ₁ [→] Δ₂) (φ : constr Δ₁) : constr Δ₂ :=
  match φ with
  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tmap δ τ₁) (tmap δ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance IPC_typ : IntPureCore (λ κ, typ κ) := @t_var.

#[export] Instance FMap_typ {κ} : FunctorCore (typ κ) := @tmap κ.

#[export] Instance FMap_constr : FunctorCore constr := @cmap.

Fixpoint tbind {κ} {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : Δ₁ [⇒] Δ₂) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) : typ κ Δ₂ :=
  match τ with
  | t_var κ x EQ  => ρ κ x EQ
  | t_lam τ     => ƛ (tbind (ρ ↑) τ)
  | t_app σ τ   => (tbind ρ σ) (tbind ρ τ)
  | t_ctor c    => c
  | t_carr  φ τ => cbind ρ φ →ᶜ tbind ρ τ
  | t_cprod φ τ => cbind ρ φ ×ᶜ tbind ρ τ
  end
with cbind {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : Δ₁ [⇒] Δ₂) (φ : constr Δ₁) : constr Δ₂ :=
  match φ with
  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tbind ρ τ₁) (tbind ρ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance BindT {κ} : BindCore (typ κ) := @tbind κ.

#[export] Instance BindC : BindCore constr := @cbind.

Inductive rel_app {Δ : Ctx kind} (κ₁ : kind) (σ₁ σ₂ : typ κ₁ Δ) : ∀ κ₂, typ κ₂ Δ → typ κ₂ Δ → Prop :=
| rel_app_refl : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κ₁ σ₁ σ₂
| rel_app_app {κₐ κᵣ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ) (τ : typ κₐ Δ)
    (HF : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) τ₁ τ₂) :
  rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κᵣ (τ₁ τ) (τ₂ τ).

Require Import List.

Inductive tctd {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ} : typ κ Δ → ∀ {κ'}, tctor κ' → Prop :=
| inj_ctor c : tctd (t_ctor c) c
| inj_app {κₐ κ'} (σ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κ) Δ) τ (c : tctor κ') (HI : tctd σ c) : tctd (σ τ) c.

Inductive cdiscr : ∀ {κ}, tctor κ → tctor κ → Prop :=
| cd_unit_void : cdiscr tc_unit tc_void
| cd_void_unit : cdiscr tc_void tc_unit
| cd_all_xist κ : cdiscr (tc_all κ)  (tc_xist κ)
| cd_xist_all κ : cdiscr (tc_xist κ) (tc_all κ)
| cd_all_rec    : cdiscr (tc_all ⋆)  (tc_rec ⋆)
| cd_rec_all    : cdiscr (tc_rec ⋆)  (tc_all ⋆)
| cd_xist_rec   : cdiscr (tc_xist ⋆) (tc_rec ⋆)
| cd_rec_xist   : cdiscr (tc_rec ⋆)  (tc_xist ⋆)
| cd_arr_sum  : cdiscr tc_arr  tc_sum
| cd_sum_arr  : cdiscr tc_sum  tc_arr
| cd_arr_prod : cdiscr tc_arr  tc_prod
| cd_prod_arr : cdiscr tc_prod tc_arr
| cd_prod_sum : cdiscr tc_prod tc_sum
| cd_sum_prod : cdiscr tc_sum  tc_prod.

Definition cdiscrK {κ₁ κ₂} : tctor κ₁ → tctor κ₂ → Prop :=

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Auto.

Require Import FOmegaEq.Kinds.

Inductive type {Δ : Ctx kind} : kind → Type :=
| t_var κ (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ) : type κ
| t_lam {κₐ κᵣ} (τ : @type (Δ ▹ κₐ) κᵣ) : type (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)
| t_app {κₐ κᵣ} (σ : type (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ)) (τ : type κₐ) : type κᵣ
| t_ctor {κ} (c : tctor κ) : type κ
| t_carr  (ψ : constr) (τ : type ⋆) : type ⋆
| t_cprod (ψ : constr) (τ : type ⋆) : type ⋆
with constr {Δ : Ctx kind} : Type :=
| c_eq (κ : kind) (τ₁ τ₂ : type κ) : constr.

Arguments type Δ : clear implicits.

Arguments constr Δ : clear implicits.

Require Import Basics.

Definition typ := flip type.

Declare Scope typ_scope.

Delimit Scope typ_scope with typ.

Coercion t_ctor : tctor >-> type.

Coercion t_app : type >-> Funclass.

Definition rec_type (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ)) : typ κ Δ
  := (tc_rec κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_arr {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_arr τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_prod {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_prod τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_sum {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_sum τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_all {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_all κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_xist {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_xist κ) (t_lam τ).

Notation "'ƛ' τ" := (t_lam τ : typ _ _) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "σ →ᵗ τ" := (t_arr σ τ) (at level 55, right associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ + τ₂" := (t_sum τ₁ τ₂) (at level 50, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ × τ₂" := (t_prod τ₁ τ₂) (at level 40, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "χ →ᶜ τ" := (t_carr χ τ) (at level 55, right associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "χ ×ᶜ τ" := (t_cprod χ τ) (at level 40, left associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "τ₁ ≃ τ₂" := (c_eq _ τ₁ τ₂) (at level 65, no associativity) : typ_scope.

Notation "∀ᵗ κ , τ" := (t_all κ τ) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "∃ᵗ κ , τ" := (t_xist κ τ) (at level 60) : typ_scope.

Notation "⊥" := tc_void : typ_scope.

Notation "'⊤'" := tc_unit : typ_scope.

Notation "'0ᵛ'" := (t_var _ (VZ : dom (_ ▹ _)) eq_refl).

Local Open Scope bind_scope.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Fixpoint tmap {κ} {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (δ : Δ₁ [→] Δ₂) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) : typ κ Δ₂ :=
  match τ with
  | t_var κ x EQ => t_var κ (δ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom δ x) EQ)
  | t_lam τ => ƛ tmap (δ ↑) τ
  | t_app σ τ => (tmap δ σ) (tmap δ τ)
  | t_ctor c  => c
  | φ →ᶜ τ => cmap δ φ →ᶜ tmap δ τ
  | φ ×ᶜ τ => cmap δ φ ×ᶜ tmap δ τ
  end
with cmap {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (δ : Δ₁ [→] Δ₂) (φ : constr Δ₁) : constr Δ₂ :=
  match φ with
  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tmap δ τ₁) (tmap δ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance IPC_typ : IntPureCore (λ κ, typ κ) := @t_var.

#[export] Instance FMap_typ {κ} : FunctorCore (typ κ) := @tmap κ.

#[export] Instance FMap_constr : FunctorCore constr := @cmap.

Fixpoint tbind {κ} {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : Δ₁ [⇒] Δ₂) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) : typ κ Δ₂ :=
  match τ with
  | t_var κ x EQ  => ρ κ x EQ
  | t_lam τ     => ƛ (tbind (ρ ↑) τ)
  | t_app σ τ   => (tbind ρ σ) (tbind ρ τ)
  | t_ctor c    => c
  | t_carr  φ τ => cbind ρ φ →ᶜ tbind ρ τ
  | t_cprod φ τ => cbind ρ φ ×ᶜ tbind ρ τ
  end
with cbind {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : Δ₁ [⇒] Δ₂) (φ : constr Δ₁) : constr Δ₂ :=
  match φ with
  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tbind ρ τ₁) (tbind ρ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance BindT {κ} : BindCore (typ κ) := @tbind κ.

#[export] Instance BindC : BindCore constr := @cbind.

Inductive rel_app {Δ : Ctx kind} (κ₁ : kind) (σ₁ σ₂ : typ κ₁ Δ) : ∀ κ₂, typ κ₂ Δ → typ κ₂ Δ → Prop :=
| rel_app_refl : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κ₁ σ₁ σ₂

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib.

Require Import Coq.Relations.Relation_Operators Coq.Relations.Operators_Properties Coq.Classes.RelationClasses.

Reserved Notation "e ↦ e'" (at level 70).

Inductive head_step : expr ∅ → expr ∅ → Prop :=
| LamBetaRec e v : (rec e) v ↦ subst (Inc := inc) ((subst (Inc := inc) e) (shift v)) (rec e)
| LamBetaE e v : (ƛ e) v ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| LamBetaT e : e_tapp (Λ e) ↦ e
| LamBetaC e : e_capp (ƛᶜ e) ↦ e
| ProjLE v1 v2 : e_proj L ⟨v1, v2⟩ ↦ v1
| ProjRE v1 v2 : e_proj R ⟨v1, v2⟩ ↦ v2
| CaseLE v e1 e2 : e_case (v_inj L v) e1 e2 ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e1 v
| CaseRE v e1 e2 : e_case (v_inj R v) e1 e2 ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e2 v
| UnpackE v e : e_unpack (v_pack v) e ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| UnrollE v : e_unroll (v_roll v) ↦ v
| WithE v e : e_lwith ⟨v⟩ᶜ e ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e v
| BindE e' (v : value ∅) : v >>= e' ↦ subst (Inc := inc) e' v
| BindE' e e' e'' : e' ↦ e'' -> e_bind e' e ↦ e_bind e'' e
where "e ↦ e'" := (head_step e%syn e'%syn).

Definition step := clos_refl_trans_1n (expr ∅) head_step.

Notation "e ↦* e'" := (step e%syn e'%syn) (at level 70).

Definition safe (e : expr ∅) :=
  forall e', e ↦* e' -> (∃ v, e' = e_val v) \/ (exists e'', e' ↦ e'').

Inductive nsteps : nat -> expr ∅ -> expr ∅ -> Prop :=
| nsteps_step ρ :
  nsteps 0 ρ ρ
| nsteps_l n ρ1 ρ2 ρ3 :
  head_step ρ1 ρ2 ->
  nsteps n ρ2 ρ3 →
  nsteps (S n) ρ1 ρ3.

    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ e_capp (v_lamC e) : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ e : τ.
Proof.
  intros Δ Ψ τ H.
  destruct (typing_expr_capp_inv H (v_lamC e) eq_refl)
    as (φ & τ0 & HP & HV & HEQ).
  destruct (Cval_lamC_inv (typing_val_canonical HV) e eq_refl)
    as (φ' & τ' & HEQcarr & HBODY).
  assert (Hτ : Ψ ⊩ τ' ≃ τ0) by (eapply tpi_carrInjR; exact HEQcarr).
  assert (Hφ' : Ψ ⊩ φ') by (eapply tpi_carrInjL; [ exact (tpi_symm HEQcarr) | exact HP ]).
  assert (HB : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ e : τ')
    by (exact (proj1 typing_cut_mut ∅ Δ (φ' :: Ψ) □ e τ' HBODY
                 Ψ φ' (@ins_head (constr Δ) φ' Ψ) Hφ')).
  eapply T_congE; [ exact (tpi_trans Hτ HEQ) | exact HB ].
Qed.

Lemma preservation_WithE (v : value ∅) (e : expr (inc ∅)) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ),
    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ e_lwith (⟨ v ⟩ᶜ) e : τ ->
    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ subst (Inc := inc) e v : τ.
Proof.
  intros Δ Ψ τ H.
  destruct (typing_expr_lwith_inv H (⟨ v ⟩ᶜ) e eq_refl)
    as (φ & σ & τ0 & HV & HBODY & HEQ).
  destruct (Cval_withC_inv (typing_val_canonical HV) v eq_refl)
    as (φ' & τ' & HEQcprod & Cv & HP').
  assert (Hτ : Ψ ⊩ τ' ≃ σ) by (eapply tpi_cprodInjR; exact HEQcprod).
  assert (Hφ : Ψ ⊩ φ) by (eapply tpi_cprodInjL; [ exact HEQcprod | exact HP' ]).
  pose proof (Cval_sound Cv) as Hv'.
  assert (Hv : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ᵥ v : σ)
    by (eapply T_congV; [ exact Hτ | exact Hv' ]).
  assert (Hvφ : Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ᵥ v : σ)
    by (exact (proj2 typing_ins_mut ∅ Δ Ψ □ v σ Hv (φ :: Ψ) φ (@ins_head (constr Δ) φ Ψ))).
  assert (Hsubst : Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ subst (Inc := inc) e v : τ0).
  { change (Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ ebind (mk_subst v) e : τ0).
    exact (typing_subst_one (V := ∅) (Δ := Δ) (Ψ := φ :: Ψ) (Γ := □) (v := v) (σ := σ)
             (e := e) (τ := τ0) HBODY Hvφ). }
  assert (Hcut : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ subst (Inc := inc) e v : τ0)
    by (exact (proj1 typing_cut_mut ∅ Δ (φ :: Ψ) □ (subst (Inc := inc) e v) τ0 Hsubst
                 Ψ φ (@ins_head (constr Δ) φ Ψ) Hφ)).
  eapply T_congE; [ exact HEQ | exact Hcut ].
Qed.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Core.

Require Import Binding.Inc.

Require Import Binding.Properties.

Require Import Morphisms.

Record Ctx {V : Type} :=
  {dom : Set;
   arr :> dom -> V
  }.

Arguments Ctx V : clear implicits.

Definition mtC {V : Type} : Ctx V :=
  {| dom := Empty_set;
     arr x := match x with end
  |}.

Definition extC {V : Type} (v : V) (Γ : Ctx V) : Ctx V :=
  {| dom := inc (dom Γ);
     arr x := match x with
              | VZ => v
              | VS x => Γ x
              end
  |}.

Notation "'ε'" := mtC.

Notation "Γ ▹ v" := (extC v Γ) (at level 40, left associativity).

Class IntPureCore {V : Type} (F : V → Ctx V → Type) : Type :=
  int_pure : ∀ (Γ : Ctx V) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v) , F v Γ.

Arguments int_pure {V F _ Γ}.

Record Arr {V : Type} {Γ Δ : Ctx V} : Type :=
  { apply_arr : dom Γ → dom Δ;
    arr_hom   : ∀ x : dom Γ, Δ (apply_arr x) = Γ x
  }.

Arguments Arr {V} Γ Δ.

Notation " A '[→]' B " := (Arr A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Coercion apply_arr : Arr >-> Funclass.

Record Sub {V} {F : V → Ctx V → Type} {FP : IntPureCore F} (Γ Δ : Ctx V) : Type :=
  { apply_sub : ∀ v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v), F v Δ
  }.

Notation " A '[⇒]' B " := (Sub A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Arguments apply_sub {V F FP Γ Δ}.

Coercion apply_sub : Sub >-> Funclass.

Instance ArrEqC {V} : EqIndCore (Arr (V := V)) :=
  λ A B f g, ∀ x, f x = g x.

Instance SubEqC {V F} {FP : IntPureCore (V := V) F} : EqIndCore Sub :=
  λ A B f g, ∀ v x EQ, f v x EQ = g v x EQ.

Global Instance ArrowCore_Set {V} : ArrowCore (Arr (V := V)) :=
  { arrow_id   := λ _,         {| apply_arr := λ x, x; arr_hom := λ x, eq_refl |}
  ; arrow_comp := λ _ _ _ f g, {| apply_arr := λ x, f (g x);
                                arr_hom := λ x, eq_trans (arr_hom f (g x)) (arr_hom g x) |}
  }.

Class IntPure {V} (F : V → Ctx V → Type) {FP : IntPureCore (V := V) F}
    {MapF : ∀ v, FunctorCore (F v)}
    {BndF : ∀ v, BindCore (Sub := Sub) (F v)} : Prop :=
  { fmap_int_pure : ∀ (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Arr Γ Δ) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v),
        fmap f (int_pure v x EQ) = int_pure v (f x) (eq_trans (arr_hom f x) EQ)
  ; bind_set_pure : ∀ (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Sub Γ Δ) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v),
      bind f (int_pure (IntPureCore := FP) v x EQ) = f v x EQ
  }.

Section IntInstances.

Context {V} {F : V → Ctx V → Type} {FP : IntPureCore F}.

Context {MapF : ∀ v, FunctorCore (Arr := Arr) (F v)}.

Context {BndF : ∀ v, BindCore (Sub := Sub) (F v)}.

Context {SPF : IntPure F}.

Global Instance SubstArrCore_Set : ArrowCore (Sub (V := V)) :=
    { arrow_id A := {| apply_sub := int_pure |};
      arrow_comp A B C f g := {| apply_sub := λ v x EQ, bind f (g v x EQ) |} }.

Global Instance SubstCore_Set : SubstCore Arr Sub :=
    λ Γ Δ f, {| apply_sub := λ v x EQ, int_pure v (f x) (eq_trans (arr_hom f x) EQ) |}.

Definition extFun v (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Arr Γ Δ) : Arr (Γ ▹ v) (Δ ▹ v) :=
    @Build_Arr V (Γ ▹ v) (Δ ▹ v) (inc_map f)
      ltac:(intros [| x]; simpl; [reflexivity | exact (arr_hom f x)]).

Global Instance ALiftableCore_ext {v : V} : LiftableCore Arr (extC v) :=
    { lift := extFun v }.

Global Program Instance ShiftableCore_ext {v : V} : ShiftableCore Arr (extC v) :=
    λ A, {| apply_arr := VS : dom A → dom (A ▹ v) |}.

Global Instance SLiftableCore_ext {v : V} : LiftableCore Sub (extC v) :=
    { lift Γ Δ ρ :=
        {| apply_sub := λ u (x : dom (Γ ▹ v)),
                        match x with
                        | VZ   => λ EQ, int_pure u (VZ : dom (Δ ▹ v)) EQ
                        | VS y => λ EQ, shift (ρ u y EQ)
                        end
        |}
    }.

Global Instance SubstitutableCore_ext {v : V} : SubstitutableCore Sub (F v) (extC v) :=
    λ A u,
    {| apply_sub := λ w (x : dom (A ▹ v)),
                    match x with
                    | VZ => λ EQ, match EQ with eq_refl => u end
                    | VS y => int_pure w y
                    end
    |}.

End IntInstances.

Arguments int_pure {V F _ Γ v} /.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Set Binding.Auto.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Types.

Import DED_kind.

Inductive ax := L | R.

Inductive value {V : Set} :=
| v_var (x : V) : value
| v_unit : value
| v_lam (e : @expr (inc V)) : value
| v_pair (v₁ v₂ : value) : value
| v_inj (a : ax) (v : value) : value
| v_tlam (e : expr) : value
| v_pack (v : value) : value
| v_roll (v : value) : value
| v_lamC  (e : expr) : value
| v_withC (v : value) : value
| v_fix (e : @expr (inc (inc V))) : value
with expr {V : Set} :=
| e_val (v : value) : expr
| e_bind (e₁ : expr) (e₂ : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_app (v₁ v₂ : value) : expr
| e_tapp (v : value) : expr
| e_proj (a : ax) (v : value) : expr
| e_abort (v : value) : expr
| e_case (v : value) (e₁ e₂ : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_unpack (v : value) (e : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_unroll (v : value) : expr
| e_cabort : expr
| e_capp (v : value) : expr
| e_lwith (v : value) (e : @expr (inc V)) : expr.

Arguments value V%bind : clear implicits.

Arguments expr  V%bind : clear implicits.

Declare Scope syn_scope.

Delimit Scope syn_scope with syn.

Coercion e_val : value >-> expr.

Coercion e_app : value >-> Funclass.

Notation "e₁ >>= e₂" := (e_bind e₁ e₂) (at level 45, right associativity) : syn_scope.

Notation "'ƛ' e" := (v_lam e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨⟩" := v_unit : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨ v ⟩ᶜ" := (v_withC v) : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨ v₁ , v₂ ⟩" := (v_pair v₁ v₂) : syn_scope.

Notation "'Λ' e" := (v_tlam e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "'ƛᶜ' e" := (v_lamC e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "'rec' e" := (v_fix e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Local Open Scope bind_scope.

Local Open Scope syn_scope.

Fixpoint emap {A B : Set} (f : A [→] B) (e : expr A) : expr B :=
  match e with
  | e_val v => vmap f v
  | e₁ >>= e₂ => emap f e₁ >>= emap (f ↑) e₂
  | e_app v₁ v₂ => (vmap f v₁) (vmap f v₂)
  | e_tapp v => e_tapp (vmap f v)
  | e_proj x v => e_proj x (vmap f v)
  | e_abort v => e_abort (vmap f v)
  | e_case v e₁ e₂ => e_case (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e₁) (emap (f ↑) e₂)
  | e_unpack v e => e_unpack (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e)
  | e_unroll v => e_unroll (vmap f v)
  | e_cabort => e_cabort
  | e_capp v => e_capp (vmap f v)
  | e_lwith v e => e_lwith (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e)
  end
with vmap {A B : Set} (f : A [→] B) (v : value A) : value B :=
       match v with
       | v_var x => v_var (f x)
       | ƛ e => ƛ (emap (f ↑) e)
       | Λ e => Λ (emap f e)
       | ⟨⟩ => ⟨⟩
       | ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ⟨vmap f v₁, vmap f v₂⟩
       | v_inj x v => v_inj x (vmap f v)
       | v_pack v => v_pack (vmap f v)
       | v_roll v => v_roll (vmap f v)
       | ƛᶜ e => v_lamC (emap f e)
       | ⟨v⟩ᶜ => ⟨vmap f v⟩ᶜ
       | rec e => rec (emap ((f ↑) ↑) e)
       end.

#[export] Instance FMap_expr : FunctorCore expr := @emap.

#[export] Instance FMap_val  : FunctorCore value := @vmap.

#[export] Instance SPC_val : SetPureCore value := @v_var.

Fixpoint ebind {X Y : Set} (f : X [⇒] Y) (e : expr X) : expr Y :=
  match e with
  | e_val v => vbind f v
  | e₁ >>= e₂ => ebind f e₁ >>= ebind (f ↑) e₂
  | e_app v₁ v₂ => (vbind f v₁) (vbind f v₂)
  | e_tapp v => e_tapp (vbind f v)
  | e_proj x v => e_proj x (vbind f v)
  | e_abort v => e_abort (vbind f v)
  | e_case v e₁ e₂ => e_case (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e₁) (ebind (f ↑) e₂)
  | e_unpack v e => e_unpack (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e)
  | e_unroll v => e_unroll (vbind f v)
  | e_cabort => e_cabort
  | e_capp v => e_capp (vbind f v)
  | e_lwith v e => e_lwith (vbind f v) (ebind (f ↑) e)
  end
with vbind {X Y : Set} (f : X [⇒] Y) (v : value X) : value Y :=
       match v with
       | v_var x => f x
       | ƛ e => ƛ (ebind (f ↑) e)
       | Λ e => Λ (ebind f e)
       | ⟨⟩ => ⟨⟩
       | ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ⟨vbind f v₁, vbind f v₂⟩
       | v_inj x v => v_inj x (vbind f v)
       | v_pack v => v_pack (vbind f v)
       | v_roll v => v_roll (vbind f v)
       | ƛᶜ  e => ƛᶜ (ebind f e)
       | ⟨v⟩ᶜ => ⟨vbind f v⟩ᶜ
       | rec e => rec (ebind ((f ↑) ↑) e)
       end.

#[export] Instance BindCore_expr : BindCore expr := @ebind.

#[export] Instance BindCore_val  : BindCore value := @vbind.

Definition liftS (k : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) :

        (@SLiftableCore_ext kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ (fun v => @FMap_typ v) k)
        Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

Lemma shift_is_shiftt (k κ' : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (u : typ κ' Δ) :
  @shift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (typ κ') (@FMap_typ κ') (@extC kind k)
         (@ShiftableCore_ext kind k) Δ u = shiftt k u.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma compat_liftS (k : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind)
      (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃)
      (H : forall κ (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ x EQ) = ρR' κ x EQ) :
  forall κ (z : dom (extC k Δ₁)) EQ,
    tmap (liftA k ρL) (liftS k ρR κ z EQ) = liftS k ρR' κ z EQ.
Proof.
  intros κ [|y] EQ; simpl.
  - apply t_var_irr.
  - rewrite shift_is_shiftt. rewrite tmap_shift_comm. rewrite H.
    rewrite shift_is_shiftt. reflexivity.

Fixpoint tmap_tbind (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :

    tmap ρL (tbind ρR τ) = tbind ρR' τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
    forall (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃),
      (forall κ0 (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ0 x EQ) = ρR' κ0 x EQ) ->
      tmap ρL (tbind ρR τ') = tbind ρR' τ' with
  | @t_var _ κ x EQ => fun ρL ρR ρR' H => H κ x EQ
  | @t_lam _ k1 k2 b => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>

           (liftA k1 ρL) (liftS k1 ρR) (liftS k1 ρR') (compat_liftS k1 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ρL ρR ρR' H))
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 σ τ0 => fun ρL ρR ρR' H =>

        (tmap_tbind (k1 ⇒ k2) Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ σ ρL ρR ρR' H)

Let's look at the tproves_tmap and related lemmas; maybe there's a **model via `tmap` with a renaming into a *singleton context*** that can extract head info! Here's an idea: To prove consistency facts, instantiate the context Δ by a renaming to a *context with a single variable of a chosen kind*, replacing all variables by the same fresh variable? Equality is preserved under tmap (we have tproves_tmap: any Arr maps provable equalities to provable equalities). If we choose an Arr that collapses Δ to a context where types become "first-order codes", could the equality become syntactically impossible? For example, map every variable to a fresh variable of the *same kind*? Δ's variables have different kinds; an Arr must preserve kinds (`arr_hom`). We could map Δ to a context containing variables of all those kinds; not collapse.

What if we map Δ to a **canonical context** and then use a *single* fresh variable? We need one variable per kind; different variables of the same kind can be collapsed to one, but for normal forms, variables matter. Collapsing variables could turn a provable equality into a more restrictive one, so if we prove the collapsed equality impossible, the original is impossible? No: tmap maps a proof to a proof, so nil⊩τ≃σ ⇒ nil⊩tmap τ≃tmap σ. If the mapped equality is impossible, contradiction ⇒ original impossible. So we can choose a *particularly discriminating* Arr (or substitution) to make the equality syntactically impossible! For kind consistency, we need to show no proof exists; mapping to a special instance and refuting it syntactically is sufficient. But refuting the instance is the same problem, hopefully easier if we map variables to closed/rigid types with a *simple context*. We can choose an Arr that is **not injective**, mapping all variables to variables in a context where we can decide. Since tproves_tmap works for any Arr Δ→Δ', we can choose Δ' = mtC only if Δ has no variables; if Δ has variables, Arr requires a function dom Δ -> dom mtC = empty, impossible. But we could map to a context with *one variable per kind occurring in Δ*, or even a context containing variables whose kinds are... arr_hom preserves kinds, so a variable of kind κ must map to a variable of kind κ. If Δ has variables of many kinds, Δ' must have them. Could map Δ' := Δ itself or a quotient; no collapse to empty unless no vars.

Require Import Arith List Eqdep_dec Lia.

Inductive kind := KTyp | KArr (a b : kind).
Notation "⋆" := KTyp.
Notation "a ⇒ b" := (KArr a b) (at level 45, right associativity).

Definition kind_eq_dec : forall (a b : kind), {a=b}+{a<>b} := decide equality.

Inductive tctor : kind -> Type :=
| tc_unit : tctor ⋆
| tc_arr : tctor (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆).

Inductive nf : kind -> Type :=
| nf_lam {k1 k2} (b : nf k2) : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)
| nf_star (s : spine ⋆) : nf ⋆
| nf_carr (c : ncon) (t : nf ⋆) : nf ⋆
with spine : kind -> Type :=
| sp_bvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_fvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_ctor {k} (c : tctor k) : spine k
| sp_app {k1 k2} (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : spine k2
with ncon : Type :=
| nceq (k : kind) (a b : nf k) : ncon.

(* shifting free (outer) bound variables: indices >= cutoff increase by k *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_star s => nf_star (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

(* eta-long expansion of a rigid spine *)
Fixpoint eta_nf (kd : kind) {struct kd} (s : spine kd) : nf kd :=
  match kd as k return spine k -> nf k with
  | ⋆ => fun s => nf_star s
  | k1 ⇒ k2 => fun s =>
      nf_lam (eta_nf k2 (sp_app (shift_sp 0 1 s) (eta_nf k1 (sp_bvar 0))))
  end s.

Definition dummy_nf (kd : kind) : nf kd := eta_nf kd (sp_fvar kd 0).

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Inductive walkres (kd : kind) : Type :=
| WSpine : spine kd -> walkres kd
| WTarget : nf kd -> walkres kd.

Arguments WSpine {kd}.
Arguments WTarget {kd}.

Fixpoint walk_nf (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_star s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_star s'
      | WTarget v => v
      end
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : walkres kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i =>
      match Nat.eq_dec i depth with
      | left _ =>
          match kind_eq_dec k0 kd with
          | left e => WTarget (cast_nf e (shift_nf 0 m arg))
          | right _ => WSpine (sp_bvar i)
          end
      | right _ =>
          WSpine (sp_bvar (if Nat.leb depth i then i - 1 else i))
      end
  | sp_fvar i => WSpine (sp_fvar i)
  | sp_ctor c => WSpine (sp_ctor c)
  | sp_app s a =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      | WTarget v => WTarget (kap _ _ v (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      end
  end
with walk_con (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

Definition kap0 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2 :=
  fun k1 k2 v a => dummy_nf k2.

Fixpoint open (fuel : nat) (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct fuel} : nf kd :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg kap0 t
  | S f =>
      walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg
        (fun k1 k2 (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) =>
           match v in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
           | nf_lam b => fun _ => open f k1 a 0 b
           | nf_star _ => fun E => match kind_discr E with end
           | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match kind_discr E with end
           end eq_refl)

  end.

From Stdlib Require Import Utf8 List Arith Eqdep_dec Lia.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds.

Require Import Binding.Intrinsic.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Import kindEqDec.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Definition ctx_of_list (l : list kind) : Ctx kind :=
  fold_right (@extC kind) mtC l.

Fixpoint var_index (l : list kind) : dom (ctx_of_list l) -> nat :=
  match l as l0 return dom (ctx_of_list l0) -> nat with
  | [] => fun x => match x with end
  | k :: l' => fun x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => 0
      | VS y => S (var_index l' y)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint kind_size (k : kind) : nat :=
  match k with
  | KTyp => 0
  | KArr a b => S (kind_size a + kind_size b)
  end.

(* Locally nameless long beta-eta normal forms, indexed by kind. *)
Inductive nf : kind -> Type :=
| nf_lam {k1 k2} (b : nf k2) : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)
| nf_star (s : spine KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_carr (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_cprod (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
with spine : kind -> Type :=
| sp_bvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_fvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_ctor {k} (c : tctor k) : spine k
| sp_app {k1 k2} (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : spine k2
with ncon : Type :=
| nceq (k : kind) (a b : nf k) : ncon.

Arguments nf_lam {k1 k2}.
Arguments nf_star.
Arguments nf_carr.
Arguments nf_cprod.
Arguments sp_bvar {k}.
Arguments sp_fvar {k}.
Arguments sp_ctor {k}.
Arguments sp_app {k1 k2}.
Arguments nceq.

(* Shift free (relative to the term) bound variables with index >= cutoff by k. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_star s => nf_star (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

(* Eta-long expansion of a rigid spine. *)
Fixpoint eta_nf (kd : kind) {struct kd} : spine kd -> nf kd :=
  match kd with
  | KTyp => fun s => nf_star s
  | KArr k1 k2 => fun s =>
      nf_lam (eta_nf k2 (sp_app (shift_sp 0 1 s) (eta_nf k1 (sp_bvar 0))))
  end.

Definition dummy_nf (kd : kind) : nf kd := eta_nf kd (@sp_fvar kd 0).

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.

Inductive walkres (kd : kind) : Type :=
| WSpine : spine kd -> walkres kd
| WTarget : nf kd -> walkres kd.

Arguments WSpine {kd}.
Arguments WTarget {kd}.

Fixpoint walk_nf (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_star s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_star s'
      | WTarget v => v
      end
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : walkres kd :=
  match s with
  | @sp_bvar kd i =>
      match Nat.eq_dec i depth with
      | left _ =>
          match kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kd with
          | left e => WTarget (cast_nf e (shift_nf 0 m arg))
          | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd i)
          end
      | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd (if Nat.leb depth i then i - 1 else i))
      end
  | @sp_fvar kd i => WSpine (@sp_fvar kd i)
  | @sp_ctor kd c => WSpine (@sp_ctor kd c)
  | @sp_app k1 k2 s a =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      | WTarget v => WTarget (kap k1 k2 v (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      end
  end
with walk_con (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

Definition kap0 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2 :=
  fun k1 k2 v a => dummy_nf k2.

Lemma KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d).
Proof. injection E. intros. split; assumption. Qed.

Definition kapS
  (rec : forall (k0 : kind), nf k0 -> nat -> forall kd : kind, nf kd -> nf kd)
  (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match v in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (rec k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 k3 b) k2 e2
  | nf_star _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

Fixpoint open (fuel : nat) (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct fuel} : nf kd :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg kap0 t
  | S f => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg (kapS (open f)) t
  end.

Definition app_nf {k1 k2 : kind} (f : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match f in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z) (open (kind_size k) (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 b) k2 e2
  | nf_star _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

(* Classify a variable of a context written as binders ++ ambient. *)
Fixpoint split_names (binders : list kind) :
  forall (ambient : list kind), dom (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type :=
  match binders as b return
      forall ambient, dom (ctx_of_list (b ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type with
  | [] => fun ambient x => inr (var_index ambient x)
  | k :: b' => fun ambient x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => inl 0
      | VS y =>
          match split_names b' ambient y with
          | inl i => inl (S i)
          | inr j => inr j
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint norm (binders ambient : list kind) {kd : kind}
    (t : typ kd (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient))) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | t_var κ x EQ =>
      match split_names binders ambient x with
      | inl i => eta_nf κ (@sp_bvar κ i)
      | inr j => eta_nf κ (@sp_fvar κ j)
      end

From Stdlib Require Import Utf8 List Arith Eqdep_dec Lia.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds.

Require Import Binding.Intrinsic.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Import kindEqDec.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Definition ctx_of_list (l : list kind) : Ctx kind :=
  fold_right (@extC kind) mtC l.

Fixpoint var_index (l : list kind) : dom (ctx_of_list l) -> nat :=
  match l as l0 return dom (ctx_of_list l0) -> nat with
  | [] => fun x => match x with end
  | k :: l' => fun x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => 0
      | VS y => S (var_index l' y)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint kind_size (k : kind) : nat :=
  match k with
  | KTyp => 0
  | KArr a b => S (kind_size a + kind_size b)
  end.

(* Locally nameless long beta-eta normal forms, indexed by kind. *)
Inductive nf : kind -> Type :=
| nf_lam {k1 k2} (b : nf k2) : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)
| nf_star (s : spine KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_carr (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_cprod (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
with spine : kind -> Type :=
| sp_bvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_fvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_ctor {k} (c : tctor k) : spine k
| sp_app {k1 k2} (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : spine k2
with ncon : Type :=
| nceq (k : kind) (a b : nf k) : ncon.

Arguments nf_lam {k1 k2}.
Arguments nf_star.
Arguments nf_carr.
Arguments nf_cprod.
Arguments sp_bvar {k}.
Arguments sp_fvar {k}.
Arguments sp_ctor {k}.
Arguments sp_app {k1 k2}.
Arguments nceq.

(* Shift free (relative to the term) bound variables with index >= cutoff by k. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_star s => nf_star (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

(* Eta-long expansion of a rigid spine. *)
Fixpoint eta_nf (kd : kind) {struct kd} : spine kd -> nf kd :=
  match kd with
  | KTyp => fun s => nf_star s
  | KArr k1 k2 => fun s =>
      nf_lam (eta_nf k2 (sp_app (shift_sp 0 1 s) (eta_nf k1 (sp_bvar 0))))
  end.

Definition dummy_nf (kd : kind) : nf kd := eta_nf kd (@sp_fvar kd 0).

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.

Inductive walkres (kd : kind) : Type :=
| WSpine : spine kd -> walkres kd
| WTarget : nf kd -> walkres kd.

Arguments WSpine {kd}.
Arguments WTarget {kd}.

Fixpoint walk_nf (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_star s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_star s'
      | WTarget v => v
      end
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : walkres kd :=
  match s with
  | @sp_bvar kd i =>
      match Nat.eq_dec i depth with
      | left _ =>
          match kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kd with
          | left e => WTarget (cast_nf e (shift_nf 0 m arg))
          | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd i)
          end
      | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd (if Nat.leb depth i then i - 1 else i))
      end
  | @sp_fvar kd i => WSpine (@sp_fvar kd i)
  | @sp_ctor kd c => WSpine (@sp_ctor kd c)
  | @sp_app k1 k2 s a =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      | WTarget v => WTarget (kap k1 k2 v (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      end
  end
with walk_con (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

Definition kap0 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2 :=
  fun k1 k2 v a => dummy_nf k2.

Lemma KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d).
Proof. injection E. intros. split; assumption. Qed.

Definition kapS
  (rec : forall (k0 : kind), nf k0 -> nat -> forall kd : kind, nf kd -> nf kd)
  (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match v in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (rec k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 k3 b) k2 e2
  | nf_star _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

Fixpoint open (fuel : nat) (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct fuel} : nf kd :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg kap0 t
  | S f => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg (kapS (open f)) t
  end.

Definition app_nf {k1 k2 : kind} (f : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match f in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z) (open (kind_size k) (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 b) k2 e2
  | nf_star _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

(* Classify a variable of a context written as binders ++ ambient. *)
Fixpoint split_names (binders : list kind) :
  forall (ambient : list kind), dom (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type :=
  match binders as b return
      forall ambient, dom (ctx_of_list (b ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type with
  | [] => fun ambient x => inr (var_index ambient x)
  | k :: b' => fun ambient x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => inl 0
      | VS y =>
          match split_names b' ambient y with
          | inl i => inl (S i)
          | inr j => inr j
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint norm (binders ambient : list kind) {kd : kind}
    (t : typ kd (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient))) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | t_var κ x EQ =>
      match split_names binders ambient x with
      | inl i => eta_nf κ (@sp_bvar κ i)
      | inr j => eta_nf κ (@sp_fvar κ j)
      end
  | @t_lam _ ka kr b => nf_lam (norm (ka :: binders) ambient b)
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 f a => app_nf (norm binders ambient f) (norm binders ambient a)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => eta_nf κ (@sp_ctor κ c)
  | @t_carr _ ψ t => nf_carr (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ t => nf_cprod (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  end
with norm_con (binders ambient : list kind) (ψ : constr (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)))
    {struct ψ} : ncon :=
  match ψ with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => nceq κ (norm binders ambient a) (norm binders ambient b)
  end.

From Stdlib Require Import Utf8 List Arith Eqdep_dec Lia.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds.

Require Import Binding.Inc Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Import kindEqDec.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Definition ctx_of_list (l : list kind) : Ctx kind :=
  fold_right (@extC kind) mtC l.

Fixpoint var_index (l : list kind) : dom (ctx_of_list l) -> nat :=
  match l as l0 return (dom (ctx_of_list l0) -> nat) with
  | nil => fun _ => 0
  | k :: l' => fun x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => 0
      | VS y => S (var_index l' y)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint kind_size (k : kind) : nat :=
  match k with
  | KTyp => 0
  | KArr a b => S (kind_size a + kind_size b)
  end.

(* Beta-short normal forms (eta is handled by smart_lam, to be defined). *)
Inductive nf : kind -> Type :=
| nf_lam {k1 k2} (b : nf k2) : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)
| nf_neu {k} (s : spine k) : nf k
| nf_carr (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_cprod (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
with spine : kind -> Type :=
| sp_bvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_fvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_ctor {k} (c : tctor k) : spine k
| sp_app {k1 k2} (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : spine k2
with ncon : Type :=
| nceq (k : kind) (a b : nf k) : ncon.

Arguments nf_lam {k1 k2}.
Arguments nf_neu {k}.
Arguments nf_carr.
Arguments nf_cprod.
Arguments sp_bvar {k}.
Arguments sp_fvar {k}.
Arguments sp_ctor {k}.
Arguments sp_app {k1 k2}.
Arguments nceq.

Scheme nf_mutind := Induction for nf Sort Prop
with spine_mutind := Induction for spine Sort Prop
with ncon_mutind := Induction for ncon Sort Prop.

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Definition cast_sp {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (s : spine k0) : spine kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return spine k' with eq_refl => s end.

Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.

Lemma KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d).
Proof. injection E. intros. split; assumption. Qed.

(* Shift free (relative to the term) bound variables with index >= cutoff by k. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

Fixpoint shift_nf_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : shift_nf c 0 t = t
with shift_sp_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : shift_sp c 0 s = s
with shift_con_id (c : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} : shift_con c 0 x = x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_sp_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i); simpl; [rewrite Nat.add_0_r |]; reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_id | apply shift_nf_id ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_id.
Qed.

Fixpoint shift_nf_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    shift_nf c m (shift_nf c n t) = shift_nf c (n + m) t
with shift_sp_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    shift_sp c m (shift_sp c n s) = shift_sp c (n + m) s
with shift_con_compose (c n m : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} :
    shift_con c m (shift_con c n x) = shift_con c (n + m) x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
    + apply shift_sp_compose.
    + apply shift_con_compose.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
    + apply shift_con_compose.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i) eqn:E.
      * assert (Hleb : Nat.leb c (i + n) = true).
        { apply Nat.leb_le. apply Nat.leb_le in E. lia. }
        rewrite Hleb. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_assoc. reflexivity.
      * rewrite E. reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_compose | apply shift_nf_compose ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_compose.
Qed.

(* Lower free bound variables by 1: used for eta reduction and for removing
   the substituted binder in the non-target case. *)
Fixpoint lower_nf (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (lower_nf (S cutoff) b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (lower_sp cutoff s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  end
with lower_sp (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i - 1 else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (lower_sp cutoff s) (lower_nf cutoff a)
  end
with lower_con (cutoff : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (lower_nf cutoff a) (lower_nf cutoff b)
  end.

Inductive walkres (kd : kind) : Type :=
| WSpine : spine kd -> walkres kd
| WTarget : nf kd -> walkres kd.

Arguments WSpine {kd}.
Arguments WTarget {kd}.

Fixpoint walk_nf (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_neu s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_neu s'
      | WTarget v => v
      end
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : walkres kd :=
  match s with
  | @sp_bvar kd i =>
      match Nat.eq_dec i depth with
      | left _ =>
          match kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kd with
          | left e => WTarget (cast_nf e (shift_nf 0 m arg))
          | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd i)
          end
      | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd (if Nat.leb depth i then i - 1 else i))
      end
  | @sp_fvar kd i => WSpine (@sp_fvar kd i)
  | @sp_ctor kd c => WSpine (@sp_ctor kd c)
  | @sp_app k1 k2 s a =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      | WTarget v => WTarget (kap k1 k2 v (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      end
  end
with walk_con (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

Definition dummy_nf (kd : kind) : nf kd := nf_neu (@sp_fvar kd 0).

Definition kap0 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2 :=
  fun k1 k2 v a => dummy_nf k2.

Definition kapS
  (rec : forall (k0 : kind), nf k0 -> nat -> forall kd : kind, nf kd -> nf kd)
  (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match v in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (rec k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 k3 b) k2 e2
  | @nf_neu kd s => fun E => nf_neu (sp_app (cast_sp E s) a)
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

Fixpoint open (fuel : nat) (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct fuel} : nf kd :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg kap0 t
  | S f => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg (kapS (open f)) t
  end.

Definition app_nf {k1 k2 : kind} (f : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match f in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (@open (kind_size k) k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 k3 b) k2 e2
  | @nf_neu kd s => fun E => nf_neu (sp_app (cast_sp E s) a)
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

(* Classify a variable of a context written as binders ++ ambient. *)
Fixpoint split_names (binders : list kind) :
  forall (ambient : list kind), dom (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type :=
  match binders as b return
      forall ambient, dom (ctx_of_list (b ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type with
  | nil => fun ambient x => inr (var_index ambient x)
  | k :: b' => fun ambient x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => inl 0
      | VS y =>
          match split_names b' ambient y with
          | inl i => inl (S i)
          | inr j => inr j
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint norm (binders ambient : list kind) {kd : kind}
    (t : typ kd (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient))) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | t_var κ x EQ =>
      match split_names binders ambient x with
      | inl i => nf_neu (@sp_bvar κ i)
      | inr j => nf_neu (@sp_fvar κ j)
      end
  | @t_lam _ ka kr b => nf_lam (norm (ka :: binders) ambient b)
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 f a => app_nf (norm binders ambient f) (norm binders ambient a)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => nf_neu (@sp_ctor κ c)
  | @t_carr _ ψ t => nf_carr (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ t => nf_cprod (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  end
with norm_con (binders ambient : list kind) (ψ : constr (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)))
    {struct ψ} : ncon :=
  match ψ with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => nceq κ (norm binders ambient a) (norm binders ambient b)
  end.

Definition TSub (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) := @Sub kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ Δ₁ Δ₂.

Definition liftS (k : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) :
  TSub (@extC kind k Δ₁) (@extC kind k Δ₂) :=
  @lift (Ctx kind) TSub (@extC kind k)
        (@SLiftableCore_ext kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ (fun v => @FMap_typ v) k)
        Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

Definition mksubst (κ : kind) {Δ : Ctx kind} (σ : typ κ Δ) : TSub (@extC kind κ Δ) Δ :=
  @mk_subst (Ctx kind) TSub (typ κ) (@extC kind κ)
    (@SubstitutableCore_ext kind (fun k => typ k) IPC_typ κ) Δ σ.

Fixpoint gen_subst (bs : list kind) {ambient : list kind} {κ : kind}
    (A : typ κ (ctx_of_list ambient)) {struct bs} :
    TSub (ctx_of_list (bs ++ κ :: ambient)) (ctx_of_list (bs ++ ambient)) :=
  match bs with
  | nil => mksubst κ A
  | k :: bs' =>
      @liftS k (ctx_of_list (bs' ++ κ :: ambient)) (ctx_of_list (bs' ++ ambient))
        (gen_subst bs' A)
  end.
