From Stdlib Require Import Utf8 List Arith Eqdep_dec Lia.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds.

Require Import Binding.Inc Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Import kindEqDec.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Definition ctx_of_list (l : list kind) : Ctx kind :=
  fold_right (@extC kind) mtC l.

Fixpoint var_index (l : list kind) : dom (ctx_of_list l) -> nat :=
  match l as l0 return (dom (ctx_of_list l0) -> nat) with
  | nil => fun _ => 0
  | k :: l' => fun x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => 0
      | VS y => S (var_index l' y)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint kind_size (k : kind) : nat :=
  match k with
  | KTyp => 0
  | KArr a b => S (kind_size a + kind_size b)
  end.

(* Beta-short normal forms (eta is handled by smart_lam, to be defined). *)
Inductive nf : kind -> Type :=
| nf_lam {k1 k2} (b : nf k2) : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)
| nf_neu {k} (s : spine k) : nf k
| nf_carr (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_cprod (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
with spine : kind -> Type :=
| sp_bvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_fvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_ctor {k} (c : tctor k) : spine k
| sp_app {k1 k2} (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : spine k2
with ncon : Type :=
| nceq (k : kind) (a b : nf k) : ncon.

Arguments nf_lam {k1 k2}.
Arguments nf_neu {k}.
Arguments nf_carr.
Arguments nf_cprod.
Arguments sp_bvar {k}.
Arguments sp_fvar {k}.
Arguments sp_ctor {k}.
Arguments sp_app {k1 k2}.
Arguments nceq.

Scheme nf_mutind := Induction for nf Sort Prop
with spine_mutind := Induction for spine Sort Prop
with ncon_mutind := Induction for ncon Sort Prop.

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Definition cast_sp {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (s : spine k0) : spine kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return spine k' with eq_refl => s end.

Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.

Lemma KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d).
Proof. injection E. intros. split; assumption. Qed.

(* Shift free (relative to the term) bound variables with index >= cutoff by k. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

Fixpoint shift_nf_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : shift_nf c 0 t = t
with shift_sp_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : shift_sp c 0 s = s
with shift_con_id (c : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} : shift_con c 0 x = x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_sp_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i); simpl; [rewrite Nat.add_0_r |]; reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_id | apply shift_nf_id ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_id.
Qed.

Fixpoint shift_nf_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    shift_nf c m (shift_nf c n t) = shift_nf c (n + m) t
with shift_sp_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    shift_sp c m (shift_sp c n s) = shift_sp c (n + m) s
with shift_con_compose (c n m : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} :
    shift_con c m (shift_con c n x) = shift_con c (n + m) x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
    + apply shift_sp_compose.
    + apply shift_con_compose.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
    + apply shift_con_compose.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i) eqn:E.
      * assert (Hleb : Nat.leb c (i + n) = true).
        { apply Nat.leb_le. apply Nat.leb_le in E. lia. }
        rewrite Hleb. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_assoc. reflexivity.
      * rewrite E. reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_compose | apply shift_nf_compose ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_compose.
Qed.

(* Lower free bound variables by 1: used for eta reduction and for removing
   the substituted binder in the non-target case. *)
Fixpoint lower_nf (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (lower_nf (S cutoff) b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (lower_sp cutoff s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  end
with lower_sp (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i - 1 else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (lower_sp cutoff s) (lower_nf cutoff a)
  end
with lower_con (cutoff : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (lower_nf cutoff a) (lower_nf cutoff b)
  end.

Inductive walkres (kd : kind) : Type :=
| WSpine : spine kd -> walkres kd
| WTarget : nf kd -> walkres kd.

Arguments WSpine {kd}.
Arguments WTarget {kd}.

Fixpoint walk_nf (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_neu s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_neu s'
      | WTarget v => v
      end
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : walkres kd :=
  match s with
  | @sp_bvar kd i =>
      match Nat.eq_dec i depth with
      | left _ =>
          match kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kd with
          | left e => WTarget (cast_nf e (shift_nf 0 m arg))
          | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd i)
          end
      | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd (if Nat.leb depth i then i - 1 else i))
      end
  | @sp_fvar kd i => WSpine (@sp_fvar kd i)
  | @sp_ctor kd c => WSpine (@sp_ctor kd c)
  | @sp_app k1 k2 s a =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      | WTarget v => WTarget (kap k1 k2 v (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      end
  end
with walk_con (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

Definition dummy_nf (kd : kind) : nf kd := nf_neu (@sp_fvar kd 0).

Definition kap0 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2 :=
  fun k1 k2 v a => dummy_nf k2.

Definition kapS
  (rec : forall (k0 : kind), nf k0 -> nat -> forall kd : kind, nf kd -> nf kd)
  (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match v in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (rec k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 k3 b) k2 e2
  | @nf_neu kd s => fun E => nf_neu (sp_app (cast_sp E s) a)
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

Fixpoint open (fuel : nat) (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct fuel} : nf kd :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg kap0 t
  | S f => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg (kapS (open f)) t
  end.

Definition app_nf {k1 k2 : kind} (f : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match f in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (@open (kind_size k) k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 k3 b) k2 e2
  | @nf_neu kd s => fun E => nf_neu (sp_app (cast_sp E s) a)
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

(* Classify a variable of a context written as binders ++ ambient. *)
Fixpoint split_names (binders : list kind) :
  forall (ambient : list kind), dom (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type :=
  match binders as b return
      forall ambient, dom (ctx_of_list (b ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type with
  | nil => fun ambient x => inr (var_index ambient x)
  | k :: b' => fun ambient x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => inl 0
      | VS y =>
          match split_names b' ambient y with
          | inl i => inl (S i)
          | inr j => inr j
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint norm (binders ambient : list kind) {kd : kind}
    (t : typ kd (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient))) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | t_var κ x EQ =>
      match split_names binders ambient x with
      | inl i => nf_neu (@sp_bvar κ i)
      | inr j => nf_neu (@sp_fvar κ j)
      end
  | @t_lam _ ka kr b => nf_lam (norm (ka :: binders) ambient b)
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 f a => app_nf (norm binders ambient f) (norm binders ambient a)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => nf_neu (@sp_ctor κ c)
  | @t_carr _ ψ t => nf_carr (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ t => nf_cprod (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  end
with norm_con (binders ambient : list kind) (ψ : constr (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)))
    {struct ψ} : ncon :=
  match ψ with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => nceq κ (norm binders ambient a) (norm binders ambient b)
  end.

Definition TSub (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) := @Sub kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ Δ₁ Δ₂.

Definition liftS (k : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) :
  TSub (@extC kind k Δ₁) (@extC kind k Δ₂) :=
  @lift (Ctx kind) TSub (@extC kind k)
        (@SLiftableCore_ext kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ (fun v => @FMap_typ v) k)
        Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

Definition mksubst (κ : kind) {Δ : Ctx kind} (σ : typ κ Δ) : TSub (@extC kind κ Δ) Δ :=
  @mk_subst (Ctx kind) TSub (typ κ) (@extC kind κ)
    (@SubstitutableCore_ext kind (fun k => typ k) IPC_typ κ) Δ σ.

Fixpoint gen_subst (bs : list kind) {ambient : list kind} {κ : kind}
    (A : typ κ (ctx_of_list ambient)) {struct bs} :
    TSub (ctx_of_list (bs ++ κ :: ambient)) (ctx_of_list (bs ++ ambient)) :=
  match bs with
  | nil => mksubst κ A
  | k :: bs' =>
      @liftS k (ctx_of_list (bs' ++ κ :: ambient)) (ctx_of_list (bs' ++ ambient))
        (gen_subst bs' A)
  end.

Fixpoint lower_nf (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (lower_nf (S cutoff) b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (lower_sp cutoff s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  end
with lower_sp (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i - 1 else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (lower_sp cutoff s) (lower_nf cutoff a)
  end
with lower_con (cutoff : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (lower_nf cutoff a) (lower_nf cutoff b)
  end.

| WTarget : nf kd -> walkres kd.

    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_neu s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_neu s'
      | WTarget v => v
      end
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)

    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)

  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

Fixpoint split_names (binders : list kind) :
  forall (ambient : list kind), dom (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type :=
  match binders as b return
      forall ambient, dom (ctx_of_list (b ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type with
  | nil => fun ambient x => inr (var_index ambient x)

  end.

  TSub (@extC kind k Δ₁) (@extC kind k Δ₂) :=
  @lift (Ctx kind) TSub (@extC kind k)

        Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

  @mk_subst (Ctx kind) TSub (typ κ) (@extC kind κ)

    (A : typ κ (ctx_of_list ambient)) {struct bs} :

  match bs with

  | k :: bs' =>
      @liftS k (ctx_of_list (bs' ++ κ :: ambient)) (ctx_of_list (bs' ++ ambient))

  end.

with ncon_mutind := Induction for ncon Sort Prop.

(* Shift free (relative to the term) bound variables with index >= cutoff by k. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_star s => nf_star (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

(* Eta-long expansion of a rigid spine. *)
Fixpoint eta_nf (kd : kind) {struct kd} : spine kd -> nf kd :=
  match kd with
  | KTyp => fun s => nf_star s
  | KArr k1 k2 => fun s =>
      nf_lam (eta_nf k2 (sp_app (shift_sp 0 1 s) (eta_nf k1 (sp_bvar 0))))
  end.

Definition dummy_nf (kd : kind) : nf kd := eta_nf kd (@sp_fvar kd 0).

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.

Inductive walkres (kd : kind) : Type :=
| WSpine : spine kd -> walkres kd
| WTarget : nf kd -> walkres kd.

Arguments WSpine {kd}.
Arguments WTarget {kd}.

Fixpoint walk_nf (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_star s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_star s'
      | WTarget v => v
      end
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : walkres kd :=
  match s with
  | @sp_bvar kd i =>
      match Nat.eq_dec i depth with
      | left _ =>
          match kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kd with
          | left e => WTarget (cast_nf e (shift_nf 0 m arg))
          | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd i)
          end
      | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd (if Nat.leb depth i then i - 1 else i))
      end
  | @sp_fvar kd i => WSpine (@sp_fvar kd i)
  | @sp_ctor kd c => WSpine (@sp_ctor kd c)
  | @sp_app k1 k2 s a =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      | WTarget v => WTarget (kap k1 k2 v (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      end
  end
with walk_con (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

Definition kap0 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> nf k1 -> nf k2 :=
  fun k1 k2 v a => dummy_nf k2.

Lemma KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d).
Proof. injection E. intros. split; assumption. Qed.

Definition kapS
  (rec : forall (k0 : kind), nf k0 -> nat -> forall kd : kind, nf kd -> nf kd)
  (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match v in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (rec k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 k3 b) k2 e2
  | nf_star _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

Fixpoint open (fuel : nat) (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct fuel} : nf kd :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg kap0 t
  | S f => walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg (kapS (open f)) t
  end.

Definition app_nf {k1 k2 : kind} (f : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match f in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (@open (kind_size k) k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 k3 b) k2 e2
  | nf_star _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

(* Classify a variable of a context written as binders ++ ambient. *)
Fixpoint split_names (binders : list kind) :
  forall (ambient : list kind), dom (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type :=
  match binders as b return
      forall ambient, dom (ctx_of_list (b ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type with
  | nil => fun ambient x => inr (var_index ambient x)
  | k :: b' => fun ambient x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => inl 0
      | VS y =>
          match split_names b' ambient y with
          | inl i => inl (S i)
          | inr j => inr j
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint norm (binders ambient : list kind) {kd : kind}
    (t : typ kd (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient))) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | t_var κ x EQ =>
      match split_names binders ambient x with
      | inl i => eta_nf κ (@sp_bvar κ i)
      | inr j => eta_nf κ (@sp_fvar κ j)
      end
  | @t_lam _ ka kr b => nf_lam (norm (ka :: binders) ambient b)
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 f a => app_nf (norm binders ambient f) (norm binders ambient a)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => eta_nf κ (@sp_ctor κ c)
  | @t_carr _ ψ t => nf_carr (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ t => nf_cprod (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  end
with norm_con (binders ambient : list kind) (ψ : constr (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)))
    {struct ψ} : ncon :=
  match ψ with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => nceq κ (norm binders ambient a) (norm binders ambient b)
  end.


Definition TSub (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) := @Sub kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ Δ₁ Δ₂.

Definition liftS (k : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) :
  TSub (@extC kind k Δ₁) (@extC kind k Δ₂) :=
  @lift (Ctx kind) TSub (@extC kind k)
        (@SLiftableCore_ext kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ (fun v => @FMap_typ v) k)
        Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

Definition mksubst (κ : kind) {Δ : Ctx kind} (σ : typ κ Δ) : TSub (@extC kind κ Δ) Δ :=
  @mk_subst (Ctx kind) TSub (typ κ) (@extC kind κ)
    (@SubstitutableCore_ext kind (fun k => typ k) IPC_typ κ) Δ σ.

Fixpoint gen_subst (bs : list kind) {ambient : list kind} {κ : kind}
    (A : typ κ (ctx_of_list ambient)) {struct bs} :
    TSub (ctx_of_list (bs ++ κ :: ambient)) (ctx_of_list (bs ++ ambient)) :=
  match bs with
  | nil => mksubst κ A
  | k :: bs' =>
      @liftS k (ctx_of_list (bs' ++ κ :: ambient)) (ctx_of_list (bs' ++ ambient))
        (gen_subst bs' A)
  end.





Fixpoint shift_nf_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : shift_nf c 0 t = t
with shift_sp_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : shift_sp c 0 s = s
with shift_con_id (c : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} : shift_con c 0 x = x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_sp_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i); simpl; [rewrite Nat.add_0_r |]; reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_id | apply shift_nf_id ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_id.
Qed.

Fixpoint shift_nf_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    shift_nf c m (shift_nf c n t) = shift_nf c (n + m) t
with shift_sp_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    shift_sp c m (shift_sp c n s) = shift_sp c (n + m) s
with shift_con_compose (c n m : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} :
    shift_con c m (shift_con c n x) = shift_con c (n + m) x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
    + apply shift_sp_compose.
    + apply shift_con_compose.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
    + apply shift_con_compose.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i) eqn:E.
      * assert (Hleb : Nat.leb c (i + n) = true).
        { apply Nat.leb_le. apply Nat.leb_le in E. lia. }
        rewrite Hleb. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_assoc. reflexivity.
      * rewrite E. reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_compose | apply shift_nf_compose ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_compose.
Qed.

Lemma preservation_UnrollE
  (Hroll : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (κ κ' : kind)
             (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ)) (τ' : typ κ' (extC κ' Δ))
             (σ₁ σ₂ σ₁' σ₂' : typ ⋆ Δ),
      rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂ ->
      rel_app κ' (rec_type Δ κ' τ') (subst τ' (rec_type Δ κ' τ')) ⋆ σ₁' σ₂' ->
      Ψ ⊩ σ₁ ≃ σ₁' -> Ψ ⊩ σ₂ ≃ σ₂')
  (v : value ∅) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ),
    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ e_unroll (v_roll v) : τ ->
    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ᵑ v : τ.
Proof.
  intros Δ Ψ τ H.
  destruct (typing_expr_unroll_inv H (v_roll v) eq_refl)
    as (κ0 & τ0 & σ₁ & σ₂ & HF0 & HV & HEQ).
  destruct (Cval_roll_inv (typing_val_canonical HV) v eq_refl)
    as (κb & τb & σ₁b & σ₂b & HFb & HEQroll & Hpay).
  assert (H₂ : Ψ ⊩ σ₂ ≃ σ₂b)
    by (exact (Hroll Δ Ψ κ0 κb τ0 τb σ₁ σ₂ σ₁b σ₂b HF0 HFb (tpi_symm HEQroll))).
  assert (Hv : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ᵥ v : σ₂)
    by (eapply T_congV; [ exact (tpi_symm H₂) | exact Hpay ]).
  eapply T_congE; [ exact HEQ | exact (T_val Hv) ].
Qed.
EOF

Lemma targs_size_final {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ κ₂ : kind} (args : targs Δ κ κ₂) :

  - left; reflexivity.
  - right. simpl. destruct IH as [e|H]; subst.

    + simpl in *. lia.

  | targs_nil _ => fun a => a

    {κa κr : kind} (E : κ₂ = κa ⇒ κr) (u : typ κa Δ) (a : typ κ Δ) :

  = targs_apply (eq_rect κ₂ (fun z => typ z Δ) (targs_apply a args) (κa ⇒ κr) E) u.

  - intros κ0 κa κr E u a. subst κ0. cbn. reflexivity.
  - intros ka kr k2 rest IH uarg κa κr E u a. cbn. apply IH.
Qed.
EOF

  intro x. destruct x.

Lemma preservation_UnpackE
  (Hxist : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (κ κ' : kind)
             (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) (τ' : typ ⋆ (extC κ' Δ)),
             Ψ ⊩ (∃ᵗ κ, τ) ≃ (∃ᵗ κ', τ') -> κ = κ')
  (v : value ∅) (e : expr (inc ∅)) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ),
    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ e_unpack (v_pack v) e : τ ->
    Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ subst (Inc := inc) e v : τ.
Proof.
  intros Δ Ψ τ H.
  destruct (typing_expr_unpack_inv H (v_pack v) e eq_refl)
    as (κ0 & τ0 & τc & HV & HBODY & HEQ).
  destruct (Cval_pack_inv (typing_val_canonical HV) v eq_refl)
    as (κb & τb & τw & HEQx & Hpay).
  pose proof (Hxist Δ Ψ κb κ0 τb τ0 HEQx) as EK.
  subst κ0.
  assert (HEQbody : map shift Ψ ⊩ τb ≃ τ0)
    by (exact (tproves_xist_inj_same HEQx)).
  assert (Hpay' : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ᵥ v : subst τ0 τw)
    by (eapply T_congV; [ exact (tproves_subst_body (κ := κb) (σ := τw) HEQbody) | exact Hpay ]).
  pose proof (typing_unpack_subst ∅ Δ Ψ □ κb τ0 τc τw e HBODY) as HB.
  assert (Hsubst : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ subst (Inc := inc) e v : τc).
  { change (Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ □ ⊢ₑ ebind (mk_subst v) e : τc).
    exact (typing_subst_one (V := ∅) (Δ := Δ) (Ψ := Ψ) (Γ := □) (v := v)
             (σ := subst τ0 τw) (e := e) (τ := τc) HB Hpay'). }
  eapply T_congE; [ exact HEQ | exact Hsubst ].
Qed.

Definition KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d) :=

Lemma box_kind_eq_of_discr
  (Hdiscr : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ), nil ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ κ' : kind) (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) (τ' : typ ⋆ (extC κ' Δ)),
    nil ⊩ ((∀ᵗ κ, τ) ≃ (∀ᵗ κ', τ')) -> κ = κ'.
Proof.
  intros Δ κ κ' τ τ' HP.
  destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec κ κ') as [e|ne]; [ exact e | exfalso ].
  apply (Hdiscr Δ (c_eq ⋆ (∀ᵗ κ, τ) (∀ᵗ κ', τ')) HP).
  unfold t_all.
  eapply (@td_ctd Δ ⋆ ((κ ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) ((κ' ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆)
            ((tc_all κ) (ƛ τ)) ((tc_all κ') (ƛ τ')) (tc_all κ) (tc_all κ')).
  - eapply (@inj_app Δ ⋆ (κ ⇒ ⋆) ((κ ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) (t_ctor (tc_all κ)) (ƛ τ) (tc_all κ)).
    apply (@inj_ctor Δ ((κ ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) (tc_all κ)).
  - eapply (@inj_app Δ ⋆ (κ' ⇒ ⋆) ((κ' ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) (t_ctor (tc_all κ')) (ƛ τ') (tc_all κ')).
    apply (@inj_ctor Δ ((κ' ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) (tc_all κ')).
  - unfold cdiscrK.
    destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec ((κ ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) ((κ' ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆)) as [e|_].
    + exfalso. apply ne.
      destruct (KArr_inj e) as [e1 _].
      destruct (KArr_inj e1) as [ek _].
      exact ek.
    + exact I.
Qed.

Require Import Basics.

Definition typ := flip type.

Declare Scope typ_scope.

Delimit Scope typ_scope with typ.

Coercion t_ctor : tctor >-> type.

Coercion t_app : type >-> Funclass.

Definition rec_type (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ)) : typ κ Δ
  := (tc_rec κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_arr {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_arr τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_prod {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_prod τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_sum {Δ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ) : typ ⋆ Δ :=
  tc_sum τ₁ τ₂.

Definition t_all {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_all κ) (t_lam τ).

Definition t_xist {Δ} κ (τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)) :=
  (tc_xist κ) (t_lam τ).

  | c_eq κ τ₁ τ₂ => c_eq κ (tbind ρ τ₁) (tbind ρ τ₂)
  end.

#[export] Instance BindT {κ} : BindCore (typ κ) := @tbind κ.

#[export] Instance BindC : BindCore constr := @cbind.

Inductive rel_app {Δ : Ctx kind} (κ₁ : kind) (σ₁ σ₂ : typ κ₁ Δ) : ∀ κ₂, typ κ₂ Δ → typ κ₂ Δ → Prop :=
| rel_app_refl : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κ₁ σ₁ σ₂
| rel_app_app {κₐ κᵣ} (τ₁ τ₂ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ) (τ : typ κₐ Δ)
    (HF : rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) τ₁ τ₂) :
  rel_app κ₁ σ₁ σ₂ κᵣ (τ₁ τ) (τ₂ τ).

Require Import List.

Inductive tctd {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ} : typ κ Δ → ∀ {κ'}, tctor κ' → Prop :=
| inj_ctor c : tctd (t_ctor c) c
| inj_app {κₐ κ'} (σ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κ) Δ) τ (c : tctor κ') (HI : tctd σ c) : tctd (σ τ) c.

Inductive cdiscr : ∀ {κ}, tctor κ → tctor κ → Prop :=
| cd_unit_void : cdiscr tc_unit tc_void
| cd_void_unit : cdiscr tc_void tc_unit
| cd_all_xist κ : cdiscr (tc_all κ)  (tc_xist κ)
| cd_xist_all κ : cdiscr (tc_xist κ) (tc_all κ)
| cd_all_rec    : cdiscr (tc_all ⋆)  (tc_rec ⋆)
| cd_rec_all    : cdiscr (tc_rec ⋆)  (tc_all ⋆)
204:    Ψ ⊩ (ƛ τ) σ ≃ subst τ σ

Require Import Coq.Lists.List.

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax.

Require Import Binding.Lib Binding.Set.

Require Import Binding.Env.

Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).

Reserved Notation "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ" (at level 70, Ψ, Γ, e at level 60).

Reserved Notation "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ" (at level 70, Ψ, Γ, v at level 60).

Inductive typing_expr {V : Set} (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> (typ ⋆ Δ)) :
  expr V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| T_val {τ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ v : τ
| T_bind  {τ₁ τ₂ e₁ e₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e₁ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e₂ : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e₁ >>= e₂ : τ₂
| T_congE {τ τ' e} : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ'
| T_app  τ₁ τ₂ v₁ v₂ :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₂ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ v₁ v₂ : τ₂
| T_tapp {κ τ σ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ∀ᵗ κ , τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_tapp v : subst τ σ
| T_projL {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ × τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_proj L v : τ₁
| T_projR {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ × τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_proj R v : τ₂
| T_abort {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} {v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ⊥ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_abort v : τ
| T_case {τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ} {τ} {v e₁ e₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e₁ : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₂ ⊢ₑ e₂ : τ ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ + τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_case v e₁ e₂ : τ
| T_unpack {κ} {τ τ'} {v e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : ∃ᵗ κ , τ ->
  extC κ Δ ∣ map shift Ψ ∣ shift • Γ ▹ τ ⊢ₑ e : shift τ' ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_unpack v e : τ'
| T_unroll κ τ σ₁ σ₂ (HF : rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂) v :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : σ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_unroll v : σ₂
| T_cabort {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} {ψ}  :
  Ψ ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_cabort : τ
| T_capp {φ τ} {v} :
  Ψ ⊩ φ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : φ →ᶜ τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_capp v : τ

  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : φ ×ᶜ σ -> Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ σ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e_lwith v e : τ
where "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ" := (typing_expr Δ Ψ%typ Γ%typ e%syn τ%typ)
with typing_val {V : Set} (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> (typ ⋆ Δ)) : value V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| T_var {x τ} (EQ : Γ x = τ) : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_var x : τ
| T_congV {v τ τ'} : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ'
| T_unit : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨⟩ : ⊤
| T_lam {τ₁ τ₂ e} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ƛ e : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂
| T_pair {τ₁ τ₂ v₁ v₂} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₁ : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v₂ : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ : τ₁ × τ₂
| T_injl {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₁ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_inj L v : τ₁ + τ₂
| T_injr {τ₁ τ₂ v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_inj R v : τ₁ + τ₂
| T_tlam {κ τ e} :
  extC κ Δ ∣ map shift Ψ ∣ compose shift Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ Λ e : ∀ᵗ κ, τ
| T_pack κ {τ : typ ⋆ (extC κ Δ)} {τ' : typ κ Δ} {v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : subst τ τ' -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_pack v : ∃ᵗ κ, τ
| T_roll κ τ σ₁ σ₂ (HF : rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂) v :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : σ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v_roll v : σ₁
| T_lamC {φ τ} {e} :
  Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ƛᶜ e : φ →ᶜ τ
| T_withC {φ τ} {v} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Ψ ⊩ φ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ ⟨v⟩ᶜ : φ ×ᶜ τ
| T_rec {τ₁ τ₂ : typ ⋆ Δ} {e : expr (inc (inc V))} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ (τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂) ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e : τ₂ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ (v_fix e) : τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂
where "Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ" := (typing_val Δ Ψ%typ Γ%typ v%syn τ%typ).

Section ExampleClosedVoid.

Definition ntarr : typ ⋆ (extC (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) (extC ⋆ mtC)) :=
    (0ᵛ (t_var _ (VS VZ : dom (extC _ (extC _ _))) eq_refl) →ᵗ ⊥)%typ.

Definition eqA : constr (extC (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) (extC ⋆ mtC)) :=
    (tc_all ⋆ 0ᵛ ≃ t_var _ (VS VZ : dom (extC _ (extC _ _))) eq_refl)%typ.

Arguments ntarr : simpl never.

Arguments eqA : simpl never.

Definition tloop : typ ⋆ (extC ⋆ mtC) :=
    (∃ᵗ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆, eqA ×ᶜ ntarr)%typ.

Definition ltl := (∀ᵗ ⋆, tloop)%typ.

Definition foo : value ∅ :=
    v_lam (e_unpack (v_var VZ)
             (e_lwith (v_var VZ)
                (e_app (v_var VZ) (v_pack (v_withC (v_var VZ)))))).

Definition nt : expr ∅ := e_app foo (v_pack (v_withC foo)).

Definition δε {Δ : Ctx kind} : Intrinsic.Arr mtC Δ := {| Intrinsic.apply_arr (x : dom mtC) := match x with end;
                                                          Intrinsic.arr_hom (x : dom mtC) := match x with end |}.

End ExampleClosedVoid.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Inductive Cval (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ) :
    value V -> typ ⋆ Δ -> Prop :=
| C_var x τ (EQ : Γ x = τ) : Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_var x) τ
| C_unit : Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v_unit ⊤
| C_lam e τ₁ τ₂ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e : τ₂ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_lam e) (τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂)
| C_pair v₁ v₂ τ₁ τ₂ : Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v₁ τ₁ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v₂ τ₂ ->
    Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_pair v₁ v₂) (τ₁ × τ₂)
| C_injl v τ₁ τ₂ : Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ₁ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_inj L v) (τ₁ + τ₂)
| C_injr v τ₁ τ₂ : Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ₂ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_inj R v) (τ₁ + τ₂)
| C_tlam e κ τ : extC κ Δ ∣ map shift Ψ ∣ Env.compose shift Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
    Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_tlam e) (∀ᵗ κ, τ)
| C_pack κ τ τ' v : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : subst τ τ' ->
    Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_pack v) (∃ᵗ κ, τ)
| C_roll κ τ σ₁ σ₂ (HF : rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂)
    v : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : σ₂ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_roll v) σ₁
| C_lamC e φ τ : Δ ∣ φ :: Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_lamC e) (φ →ᶜ τ)
| C_withC v φ τ : Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ -> Ψ ⊩ φ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (⟨ v ⟩ᶜ) (φ ×ᶜ τ)
| C_fix e τ₁ τ₂ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ (τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂) ▹ τ₁ ⊢ₑ e : τ₂ ->
    Cval V Δ Ψ Γ (v_fix e) (τ₁ →ᵗ τ₂)
| C_cong τ τ' v : Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ τ' -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ'.

Lemma typing_val_canonical {V : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Ψ : list (constr Δ)}
      {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {v : value V} {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ -> Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ.
Proof.
  intro H.
  induction H using typing_val_mut with
    (P := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
               (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) (_ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ) => True)
    (P0 := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
               (v : value V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) (_ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ) =>
             Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ).
  - exact I. - exact I. - exact I. - exact I. - exact I. - exact I. - exact I.
  - exact I. - exact I. - exact I. - exact I. - exact I. - exact I. - exact I.
  - (* T_var *) eapply C_var. assumption.
  - (* T_congV *) exact (C_cong V Δ Ψ Γ τ τ' v t IHtyping_val).
  - (* T_unit *) eapply C_unit.
  - (* T_lam *) eapply C_lam. assumption.
  - (* T_pair *) eapply C_pair; [ apply IHtyping_val1 | apply IHtyping_val2 ].
  - (* T_injl *) eapply C_injl. apply IHtyping_val.
  - (* T_injr *) eapply C_injr. apply IHtyping_val.
  - (* T_tlam *) eapply C_tlam. assumption.
  - (* T_pack *) eapply C_pack. eassumption.
  - (* T_roll *) eapply C_roll; [ exact HF | assumption ].
  - (* T_lamC *) eapply C_lamC. assumption.
  - (* T_withC *) eapply C_withC; [ apply IHtyping_val | assumption ].
  - (* T_rec *) eapply C_fix. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Cval_sound {V : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Ψ : list (constr Δ)} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {v : value V} {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} :
  Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ -> Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v : τ.
Proof.
  induction 1; eauto using T_var, T_unit, T_lam, T_pair, T_injl, T_injr,
    T_tlam, T_pack, T_roll, T_lamC, T_withC, T_rec, T_congV.
Qed.


Lemma Ins_map_gen {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) (x : A) (Ψ Ψ' : list A) :
  Ins x Ψ Ψ' -> Ins (f x) (map f Ψ) (map f Ψ').
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl.
  - apply ins_head.
  - apply ins_tail. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Cval_ins {V : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Ψ : list (constr Δ)} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {v : value V} {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} :
  Cval V Δ Ψ Γ v τ ->
  forall (Ψ' : list (constr Δ)) (φ : constr Δ), Ins φ Ψ Ψ' -> Cval V Δ Ψ' Γ v τ.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros Ψ' φa HI.
  - apply C_var. assumption.
  - apply C_unit.
  - eapply C_lam. eapply (proj1 typing_ins_mut); [ eassumption | exact HI ].
  - eapply C_pair; [ apply (IHCval1 Ψ' φa HI) | apply (IHCval2 Ψ' φa HI) ].
  - eapply C_injl. apply (IHCval Ψ' φa HI).
  - eapply C_injr. apply (IHCval Ψ' φa HI).
  - eapply C_tlam.
    eapply (proj1 typing_ins_mut); [ eassumption | ].
    apply (Ins_map_gen (fun ψ : constr Δ => shift ψ)). exact HI.
  - eapply C_pack. eapply (proj2 typing_ins_mut); [ eassumption | exact HI ].
  - eapply C_roll; [ exact HF | ].
    eapply (proj2 typing_ins_mut); [ eassumption | exact HI ].
  - eapply C_lamC. eapply (proj1 typing_ins_mut); [ eassumption | ].
    eapply Ins_tail'. exact HI.
  - eapply C_withC; [ apply (IHCval Ψ' φa HI) | ].
    eapply tproves_ins; [ eassumption | exact HI ].
  - eapply C_fix. eapply (proj1 typing_ins_mut); [ eassumption | exact HI ].
  - eapply C_cong; [ | apply (IHCval Ψ' φa HI) ].
    eapply tproves_ins; [ exact H | exact HI ].
Qed.


Lemma tctd_arr_partial (Δ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  tctd ((tc_arr : typ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) Δ) τ) tc_arr.
Proof. apply inj_app. apply inj_ctor. Qed.

Lemma tctd_sum_partial (Δ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  tctd ((tc_sum : typ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) Δ) τ) tc_sum.

Require Import Utf8.

Require Import Binding.Core.

Require Import Binding.Inc.

Require Import Binding.Properties.

Require Import Morphisms.

Record Ctx {V : Type} :=
  {dom : Set;
   arr :> dom -> V
  }.

Arguments Ctx V : clear implicits.

Definition mtC {V : Type} : Ctx V :=
  {| dom := Empty_set;
     arr x := match x with end
  |}.

Definition extC {V : Type} (v : V) (Γ : Ctx V) : Ctx V :=
  {| dom := inc (dom Γ);
     arr x := match x with
              | VZ => v
              | VS x => Γ x
              end
  |}.

Notation "'ε'" := mtC.

Notation "Γ ▹ v" := (extC v Γ) (at level 40, left associativity).

Class IntPureCore {V : Type} (F : V → Ctx V → Type) : Type :=
  int_pure : ∀ (Γ : Ctx V) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v) , F v Γ.

Arguments int_pure {V F _ Γ}.

Record Arr {V : Type} {Γ Δ : Ctx V} : Type :=
  { apply_arr : dom Γ → dom Δ;
    arr_hom   : ∀ x : dom Γ, Δ (apply_arr x) = Γ x
  }.

Arguments Arr {V} Γ Δ.

Notation " A '[→]' B " := (Arr A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Coercion apply_arr : Arr >-> Funclass.

Record Sub {V} {F : V → Ctx V → Type} {FP : IntPureCore F} (Γ Δ : Ctx V) : Type :=
  { apply_sub : ∀ v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v), F v Δ
  }.

Notation " A '[⇒]' B " := (Sub A B) (at level 100, no associativity) : type_scope.

Arguments apply_sub {V F FP Γ Δ}.

Coercion apply_sub : Sub >-> Funclass.

Instance ArrEqC {V} : EqIndCore (Arr (V := V)) :=
  λ A B f g, ∀ x, f x = g x.

Instance SubEqC {V F} {FP : IntPureCore (V := V) F} : EqIndCore Sub :=
  λ A B f g, ∀ v x EQ, f v x EQ = g v x EQ.

Global Instance ArrowCore_Set {V} : ArrowCore (Arr (V := V)) :=
  { arrow_id   := λ _,         {| apply_arr := λ x, x; arr_hom := λ x, eq_refl |}
  ; arrow_comp := λ _ _ _ f g, {| apply_arr := λ x, f (g x);
                                arr_hom := λ x, eq_trans (arr_hom f (g x)) (arr_hom g x) |}
  }.

Class IntPure {V} (F : V → Ctx V → Type) {FP : IntPureCore (V := V) F}
    {MapF : ∀ v, FunctorCore (F v)}
    {BndF : ∀ v, BindCore (Sub := Sub) (F v)} : Prop :=
  { fmap_int_pure : ∀ (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Arr Γ Δ) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v),
        fmap f (int_pure v x EQ) = int_pure v (f x) (eq_trans (arr_hom f x) EQ)
  ; bind_set_pure : ∀ (Γ Δ : Ctx V) (f : Sub Γ Δ) v (x : dom Γ) (EQ : Γ x = v),

# 174 — Higher-kinded GADT type safety

## Task

Show that a closed, well-typed expression in the higher-kinded GADT calculus cannot reach a stuck state.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `soundness`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: none beyond the Rocq standard library.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

From Stdlib Require Import Utf8 List Arith Eqdep_dec Lia Wf_nat Wellfounded.Inverse_Image Program.Equality.

Require Import TaskPrefix.
Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax Lang.FOmegaEq.Typing Lang.FOmegaEq.OpSemantics.
Require Import Binding.Inc Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).
Import kindEqDec.
Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Definition ctx_of_list (l : list kind) : Ctx kind :=
  fold_right (@extC kind) mtC l.

Fixpoint var_index (l : list kind) : dom (ctx_of_list l) -> nat :=
  match l as l0 return (dom (ctx_of_list l0) -> nat) with
  | nil => fun _ => 0
  | k :: l' => fun x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => 0
      | VS y => S (var_index l' y)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint kind_size (k : kind) : nat :=
  match k with
  | KTyp => 0
  | KArr a b => S (kind_size a + kind_size b)
  end.

(* Beta-short normal forms (eta is handled by smart_lam, to be defined). *)
Inductive nf : kind -> Type :=
| nf_lam {k1 k2} (b : nf k2) : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)
| nf_neu {k} (s : spine k) : nf k
| nf_carr (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_cprod (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
with spine : kind -> Type :=
| sp_bvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_fvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_ctor {k} (c : tctor k) : spine k
| sp_app {k1 k2} (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : spine k2
with ncon : Type :=
| nceq (k : kind) (a b : nf k) : ncon.

Arguments nf_lam {k1 k2}.
Arguments nf_neu {k}.
Arguments nf_carr.
Arguments nf_cprod.
Arguments sp_bvar {k}.
Arguments sp_fvar {k}.
Arguments sp_ctor {k}.
Arguments sp_app {k1 k2}.
Arguments nceq.

Scheme nf_mutind := Induction for nf Sort Prop
with spine_mutind := Induction for spine Sort Prop
with ncon_mutind := Induction for ncon Sort Prop.

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Definition cast_sp {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (s : spine k0) : spine kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return spine k' with eq_refl => s end.

Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.

Definition KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d) :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KArr x y => (a = x) * (b = y) | KTyp => True end) with
  | eq_refl => (eq_refl, eq_refl)
  end.

(* Shift free (relative to the term) bound variables with index >= cutoff by k. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

Fixpoint shift_nf_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : shift_nf c 0 t = t
with shift_sp_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : shift_sp c 0 s = s
with shift_con_id (c : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} : shift_con c 0 x = x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_sp_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i); simpl; [rewrite Nat.add_0_r |]; reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_id | apply shift_nf_id ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_id.
Qed.

Fixpoint shift_nf_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    shift_nf c m (shift_nf c n t) = shift_nf c (n + m) t
with shift_sp_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    shift_sp c m (shift_sp c n s) = shift_sp c (n + m) s
with shift_con_compose (c n m : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} :
    shift_con c m (shift_con c n x) = shift_con c (n + m) x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
Definition open_fix : forall a : NArg, NRes a :=
  Fix wf_n_kind_lt NRes open_step.

Definition open (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) : nf kd :=
  open_fix (Build_NArg k0 arg depth 0 kd t).

Definition app_nf {k1 k2 : kind} (f : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match f in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (open k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 b) k2 e2
  | @nf_neu kd s => fun E => nf_neu (sp_app (cast_sp E s) a)
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

(* Classify a variable of a context written as binders ++ ambient. *)
Fixpoint split_names (binders : list kind) :
  forall (ambient : list kind), dom (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type :=
  match binders as b return
      forall ambient, dom (ctx_of_list (b ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type with
  | nil => fun ambient x => inr (var_index ambient x)
  | k :: b' => fun ambient x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => inl 0
      | VS y =>
          match split_names b' ambient y with
          | inl i => inl (S i)
          | inr j => inr j
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint norm (binders ambient : list kind) {kd : kind}
    (t : typ kd (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient))) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | t_var κ x EQ =>
      match split_names binders ambient x with
      | inl i => nf_neu (@sp_bvar κ i)
      | inr j => nf_neu (@sp_fvar κ j)
      end
  | @t_lam _ ka kr b => nf_lam (norm (ka :: binders) ambient b)
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 f a => app_nf (norm binders ambient f) (norm binders ambient a)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => nf_neu (@sp_ctor κ c)
  | @t_carr _ ψ t => nf_carr (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ t => nf_cprod (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  end
with norm_con (binders ambient : list kind) (ψ : constr (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)))
    {struct ψ} : ncon :=
  match ψ with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => nceq κ (norm binders ambient a) (norm binders ambient b)
  end.


Lemma WTarget_eq {k0 kd : kind} (v1 v2 : nf kd) (H1 H2 : kind_cod kd k0) :
  v1 = v2 -> H1 = H2 -> WTarget v1 H1 = WTarget v2 H2.
Proof. intros; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Fixpoint walk_nf_kap_congr (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap1 kap2 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (Hk : forall k1 k2 v H a, kap1 k1 k2 v H a = kap2 k1 k2 v H a)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap1 t = walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap2 t
with walk_sp_kap_congr (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap1 kap2 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (Hk : forall k1 k2 v H a, kap1 k1 k2 v H a = kap2 k1 k2 v H a)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap1 s = walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap2 s
with walk_con_kap_congr (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap1 kap2 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (Hk : forall k1 k2 v H a, kap1 k1 k2 v H a = kap2 k1 k2 v H a)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} :
    walk_con k0 depth m arg kap1 c = walk_con k0 depth m arg kap2 c.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
    + assert (E := walk_sp_kap_congr k0 depth m arg kap1 kap2 Hk _ s).
      rewrite E. destruct (walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap2 s); reflexivity.
    + apply walk_con_kap_congr; exact Hk.
    + apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
    + apply walk_con_kap_congr; exact Hk.
    + apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + f_equal.
      assert (E := walk_sp_kap_congr k0 depth m arg kap1 kap2 Hk _ s).
      rewrite E. destruct (walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap2 s) as [s'|v H].
      * f_equal. f_equal. apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
      * apply WTarget_eq.
        -- rewrite (walk_nf_kap_congr k0 depth m arg kap1 kap2 Hk _ a). apply Hk.
        -- reflexivity.
  - destruct c; simpl; f_equal; apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
Qed.

Lemma open_kap_ext (k0 : kind)
    (r1 r2 : forall y : NArg, kind_size (n_k0 y) < kind_size k0 -> nf (n_kd y))
    (Hr : forall y p, r1 y p = r2 y p) :
  forall (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0) (a0 : nf k1),
    open_kap k0 r1 k1 k2 v H a0 = open_kap k0 r2 k1 k2 v H a0.
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_kap.
  dependent destruction v; cbn.
  - exact (Hr (Build_NArg k1 a0 0 0 k2 v) (kind_size_dom_lt k1 k2 k0 H)).
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_step_ext (a : NArg)
    (f g : forall y : NArg, n_kind_lt y a -> NRes y)
    (Hfg : forall y p, f y p = g y p) :
  open_step a f = open_step a g.
Proof.
  destruct a as [k0 arg depth m kd t]. cbn [open_step].
  apply walk_nf_kap_congr.
  intros k1 k2 v H a0.
  apply open_kap_ext.
  intros y p. apply Hfg.
Qed.

Lemma open_fix_eq (a : NArg) :
  open_fix a = open_step a (fun y p => open_fix y).
Proof.
  unfold open_fix.
  apply Fix_eq. exact open_step_ext.
Qed.

Lemma open_eq (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) :
  open k0 arg depth t =
  walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg (open_kap k0 (fun y p => open_fix y)) t.
Proof.
  unfold open. rewrite open_fix_eq. cbn [open_step]. reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint walk_nf_shift_arg (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t =
    walk_nf k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap t
with walk_sp_shift_arg (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s =
    walk_sp k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap s
with walk_con_shift_arg (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} :
    walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c =
    walk_con k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap c.
Proof.
  - destruct t as [k1 k2 b | ksp sp | c t | c t]; simpl; f_equal.
    + (* nf_lam *)
      rewrite (walk_nf_shift_arg k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap _ b).
      rewrite (walk_nf_shift_arg k0 (S depth) 1 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap _ b).
      f_equal. rewrite shift_nf_compose. f_equal. lia.
    + (* nf_neu *)
      assert (E := walk_sp_shift_arg k0 depth m arg kap _ sp).
      simpl. rewrite E. destruct (walk_sp k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap sp); reflexivity.
    + (* carr *) apply walk_con_shift_arg.
    + apply walk_nf_shift_arg.
    + apply walk_con_shift_arg.
    + apply walk_nf_shift_arg.
  - destruct s as [kb i | kf i | kc c0 | k1 k2 sp a]; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + (* bvar *)
      destruct (Nat.eq_dec i depth) as [e|n].
      * subst. destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kb) as [e|n].
        -- simpl. rewrite (shift_nf_id 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg)). reflexivity.
        -- reflexivity.
      * reflexivity.
    + (* sp_app *)
      assert (E := walk_sp_shift_arg k0 depth m arg kap _ sp).
      simpl. rewrite E. destruct (walk_sp k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap sp) as [s'|v H].
      * f_equal. f_equal. apply walk_nf_shift_arg.
      * apply WTarget_eq.
        -- rewrite (walk_nf_shift_arg k0 depth m arg kap _ a). reflexivity.
        -- reflexivity.
  - destruct c; simpl; f_equal; apply walk_nf_shift_arg.
Qed.

Lemma norm_subst_one_var (ambient : list kind) (κ : kind)
    (A : typ κ (ctx_of_list ambient)) :
  norm nil ambient
    (tbind (mksubst κ A)
       (@t_var (extC κ (ctx_of_list ambient)) κ VZ eq_refl))
  = norm nil ambient A.
Proof.
  cbv [tbind mksubst]. cbn.
  (* see if LHS reduces to norm A *)
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_kap_app (kO : kind) (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2))
    (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) kO) (a : nf k1) :
  open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y) k1 k2 v H a = app_nf v a.
Proof.
  dependent destruction v; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma walk_nf_neu_eq (kO : kind) (d m : nat) (argO : nf kO)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) :
  walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) (@nf_neu kd s)
  = match walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s with
    | WSpine s' => nf_neu s'
    | WTarget v _ => v
    end.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma walk_sp_app_eq (kO : kind) (d m : nat) (argO : nf kO)
    (k1 k2 : kind) (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (A : nf k1) :
  walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) (sp_app s A)
  = match walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s with
    | WSpine s' =>
        WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A))
    | WTarget v H =>
        WTarget (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y) k1 k2 v H
                   (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A))
                (kc_step H)
    end.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma walk_nf_sp_app_eq (kO : kind) (d m : nat) (argO : nf kO)
    (k1 k2 : kind) (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (A : nf k1) :
  walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y))
    (@nf_neu k2 (sp_app s A))
  = match walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s with
    | WSpine s' =>
        nf_neu (sp_app s' (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A))
    | WTarget v H =>
        open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y) k1 k2 v H
          (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A)
    end.
Proof.
  rewrite walk_nf_neu_eq.
  rewrite walk_sp_app_eq.
  remember (walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s) as w eqn:Ew.
  destruct w as [s'|v H]; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma walk_app_nf_neu (kO : kind) (d m : nat) (argO : nf kO)
    (k1 k2 : kind) (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (A : nf k1) :
  walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y))
    (app_nf (@nf_neu (k1 ⇒ k2) s) A)
  = app_nf
      (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y))
         (@nf_neu (k1 ⇒ k2) s))
      (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A).
Proof.
  cbn [app_nf].
  rewrite walk_nf_sp_app_eq.
  rewrite walk_nf_neu_eq.
  cbn.
  destruct (walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s)
    as [s'|v H]; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite open_kap_app. reflexivity.
Qed.



Lemma preservation_UnrollE
  (Hroll : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (κ κ' : kind)
             (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ)) (τ' : typ κ' (extC κ' Δ))
             (σ₁ σ₂ σ₁' σ₂' : typ ⋆ Δ),
      rel_app κ (rec_type Δ κ τ) (subst τ (rec_type Δ κ τ)) ⋆ σ₁ σ₂ ->
      rel_app κ' (rec_type Δ κ' τ') (subst τ' (rec_type Δ κ' τ')) ⋆ σ₁' σ₂' ->
      Ψ ⊩ σ₁ ≃ σ₁' -> Ψ ⊩ σ₂ ≃ σ₂')

From Stdlib Require Import Utf8 List Arith Eqdep_dec Lia Wf_nat Wellfounded.Inverse_Image Program.Equality.

Require Import TaskPrefix.
Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax Lang.FOmegaEq.Typing Lang.FOmegaEq.OpSemantics.
Require Import Binding.Inc Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).
Import kindEqDec.
Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Local Open Scope typ_scope.

Definition ctx_of_list (l : list kind) : Ctx kind :=
  fold_right (@extC kind) mtC l.

Fixpoint var_index (l : list kind) : dom (ctx_of_list l) -> nat :=
  match l as l0 return (dom (ctx_of_list l0) -> nat) with
  | nil => fun _ => 0
  | k :: l' => fun x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => 0
      | VS y => S (var_index l' y)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint kind_size (k : kind) : nat :=
  match k with
  | KTyp => 0
  | KArr a b => S (kind_size a + kind_size b)
  end.

(* Beta-short normal forms (eta is handled by smart_lam, to be defined). *)
Inductive nf : kind -> Type :=
| nf_lam {k1 k2} (b : nf k2) : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)
| nf_neu {k} (s : spine k) : nf k
| nf_carr (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_cprod (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
with spine : kind -> Type :=
| sp_bvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_fvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_ctor {k} (c : tctor k) : spine k
| sp_app {k1 k2} (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : spine k2
with ncon : Type :=
| nceq (k : kind) (a b : nf k) : ncon.

Arguments nf_lam {k1 k2}.
Arguments nf_neu {k}.
Arguments nf_carr.
Arguments nf_cprod.
Arguments sp_bvar {k}.
Arguments sp_fvar {k}.
Arguments sp_ctor {k}.
Arguments sp_app {k1 k2}.
Arguments nceq.

Scheme nf_mutind := Induction for nf Sort Prop
with spine_mutind := Induction for spine Sort Prop
with ncon_mutind := Induction for ncon Sort Prop.

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Definition cast_sp {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (s : spine k0) : spine kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return spine k' with eq_refl => s end.

Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.

Definition KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d) :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KArr x y => (a = x) * (b = y) | KTyp => True end) with
  | eq_refl => (eq_refl, eq_refl)
  end.

(* Shift free (relative to the term) bound variables with index >= cutoff by k. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

Fixpoint shift_nf_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : shift_nf c 0 t = t
with shift_sp_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : shift_sp c 0 s = s
with shift_con_id (c : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} : shift_con c 0 x = x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_sp_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i); simpl; [rewrite Nat.add_0_r |]; reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_id | apply shift_nf_id ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_id.
Qed.

Fixpoint shift_nf_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    shift_nf c m (shift_nf c n t) = shift_nf c (n + m) t
with shift_sp_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    shift_sp c m (shift_sp c n s) = shift_sp c (n + m) s
with shift_con_compose (c n m : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} :
    shift_con c m (shift_con c n x) = shift_con c (n + m) x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
Definition open_fix : forall a : NArg, NRes a :=
  Fix wf_n_kind_lt NRes open_step.

Definition open (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) : nf kd :=
  open_fix (Build_NArg k0 arg depth 0 kd t).

Definition app_nf {k1 k2 : kind} (f : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match f in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z)
        (open k (eq_rect k1 (fun z => nf z) a k (eq_sym e1)) 0 b) k2 e2
  | @nf_neu kd s => fun E => nf_neu (sp_app (cast_sp E s) a)
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

(* Classify a variable of a context written as binders ++ ambient. *)
Fixpoint split_names (binders : list kind) :
  forall (ambient : list kind), dom (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type :=
  match binders as b return
      forall ambient, dom (ctx_of_list (b ++ ambient)) -> (nat + nat)%type with
  | nil => fun ambient x => inr (var_index ambient x)
  | k :: b' => fun ambient x =>
      match x with
      | VZ => inl 0
      | VS y =>
          match split_names b' ambient y with
          | inl i => inl (S i)
          | inr j => inr j
          end
      end
  end.

Fixpoint norm (binders ambient : list kind) {kd : kind}
    (t : typ kd (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient))) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | t_var κ x EQ =>
      match split_names binders ambient x with
      | inl i => nf_neu (@sp_bvar κ i)
      | inr j => nf_neu (@sp_fvar κ j)
      end
  | @t_lam _ ka kr b => nf_lam (norm (ka :: binders) ambient b)
  | @t_app _ k1 k2 f a => app_nf (norm binders ambient f) (norm binders ambient a)
  | @t_ctor _ κ c => nf_neu (@sp_ctor κ c)
  | @t_carr _ ψ t => nf_carr (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  | @t_cprod _ ψ t => nf_cprod (norm_con binders ambient ψ) (norm binders ambient t)
  end
with norm_con (binders ambient : list kind) (ψ : constr (ctx_of_list (binders ++ ambient)))
    {struct ψ} : ncon :=
  match ψ with
  | @c_eq _ κ a b => nceq κ (norm binders ambient a) (norm binders ambient b)
  end.


Lemma WTarget_eq {k0 kd : kind} (v1 v2 : nf kd) (H1 H2 : kind_cod kd k0) :
  v1 = v2 -> H1 = H2 -> WTarget v1 H1 = WTarget v2 H2.
Proof. intros; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

Fixpoint walk_nf_kap_congr (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap1 kap2 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (Hk : forall k1 k2 v H a, kap1 k1 k2 v H a = kap2 k1 k2 v H a)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap1 t = walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap2 t
with walk_sp_kap_congr (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap1 kap2 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (Hk : forall k1 k2 v H a, kap1 k1 k2 v H a = kap2 k1 k2 v H a)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap1 s = walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap2 s
with walk_con_kap_congr (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap1 kap2 : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (Hk : forall k1 k2 v H a, kap1 k1 k2 v H a = kap2 k1 k2 v H a)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} :
    walk_con k0 depth m arg kap1 c = walk_con k0 depth m arg kap2 c.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
    + assert (E := walk_sp_kap_congr k0 depth m arg kap1 kap2 Hk _ s).
      rewrite E. destruct (walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap2 s); reflexivity.
    + apply walk_con_kap_congr; exact Hk.
    + apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
    + apply walk_con_kap_congr; exact Hk.
    + apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + f_equal.
      assert (E := walk_sp_kap_congr k0 depth m arg kap1 kap2 Hk _ s).
      rewrite E. destruct (walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap2 s) as [s'|v H].
      * f_equal. f_equal. apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
      * apply WTarget_eq.
        -- rewrite (walk_nf_kap_congr k0 depth m arg kap1 kap2 Hk _ a). apply Hk.
        -- reflexivity.
  - destruct c; simpl; f_equal; apply walk_nf_kap_congr; exact Hk.
Qed.

Lemma open_kap_ext (k0 : kind)
    (r1 r2 : forall y : NArg, kind_size (n_k0 y) < kind_size k0 -> nf (n_kd y))
    (Hr : forall y p, r1 y p = r2 y p) :
  forall (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0) (a0 : nf k1),
    open_kap k0 r1 k1 k2 v H a0 = open_kap k0 r2 k1 k2 v H a0.
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_kap.
  dependent destruction v; cbn.
  - exact (Hr (Build_NArg k1 a0 0 0 k2 v) (kind_size_dom_lt k1 k2 k0 H)).
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_step_ext (a : NArg)
    (f g : forall y : NArg, n_kind_lt y a -> NRes y)
    (Hfg : forall y p, f y p = g y p) :
  open_step a f = open_step a g.
Proof.
  destruct a as [k0 arg depth m kd t]. cbn [open_step].
  apply walk_nf_kap_congr.
  intros k1 k2 v H a0.
  apply open_kap_ext.
  intros y p. apply Hfg.
Qed.

Lemma open_fix_eq (a : NArg) :
  open_fix a = open_step a (fun y p => open_fix y).
Proof.
  unfold open_fix.
  apply Fix_eq. exact open_step_ext.
Qed.

Lemma open_eq (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) :
  open k0 arg depth t =
  walk_nf k0 depth 0 arg (open_kap k0 (fun y p => open_fix y)) t.
Proof.
  unfold open. rewrite open_fix_eq. cbn [open_step]. reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint walk_nf_shift_arg (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t =
    walk_nf k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap t
with walk_sp_shift_arg (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s =
    walk_sp k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap s
with walk_con_shift_arg (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} :
    walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c =
    walk_con k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap c.
Proof.
  - destruct t as [k1 k2 b | ksp sp | c t | c t]; simpl; f_equal.
    + (* nf_lam *)
      rewrite (walk_nf_shift_arg k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap _ b).
      rewrite (walk_nf_shift_arg k0 (S depth) 1 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap _ b).
      f_equal. rewrite shift_nf_compose. f_equal. lia.
    + (* nf_neu *)
      assert (E := walk_sp_shift_arg k0 depth m arg kap _ sp).
      simpl. rewrite E. destruct (walk_sp k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap sp); reflexivity.
    + (* carr *) apply walk_con_shift_arg.
    + apply walk_nf_shift_arg.
    + apply walk_con_shift_arg.
    + apply walk_nf_shift_arg.
  - destruct s as [kb i | kf i | kc c0 | k1 k2 sp a]; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + (* bvar *)
      destruct (Nat.eq_dec i depth) as [e|n].
      * subst. destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kb) as [e|n].
        -- simpl. rewrite (shift_nf_id 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg)). reflexivity.
        -- reflexivity.
      * reflexivity.
    + (* sp_app *)
      assert (E := walk_sp_shift_arg k0 depth m arg kap _ sp).
      simpl. rewrite E. destruct (walk_sp k0 depth 0 (shift_nf 0 m arg) kap sp) as [s'|v H].
      * f_equal. f_equal. apply walk_nf_shift_arg.
      * apply WTarget_eq.
        -- rewrite (walk_nf_shift_arg k0 depth m arg kap _ a). reflexivity.
        -- reflexivity.
  - destruct c; simpl; f_equal; apply walk_nf_shift_arg.
Qed.

Lemma norm_subst_one_var (ambient : list kind) (κ : kind)
    (A : typ κ (ctx_of_list ambient)) :
  norm nil ambient
    (tbind (mksubst κ A)
       (@t_var (extC κ (ctx_of_list ambient)) κ VZ eq_refl))
  = norm nil ambient A.
Proof.
  cbv [tbind mksubst]. cbn.
  (* see if LHS reduces to norm A *)
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_kap_app (kO : kind) (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2))
    (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) kO) (a : nf k1) :
  open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y) k1 k2 v H a = app_nf v a.
Proof.
  dependent destruction v; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma walk_nf_neu_eq (kO : kind) (d m : nat) (argO : nf kO)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) :
  walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) (@nf_neu kd s)
  = match walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s with
    | WSpine s' => nf_neu s'
    | WTarget v _ => v
    end.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma walk_sp_app_eq (kO : kind) (d m : nat) (argO : nf kO)
    (k1 k2 : kind) (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (A : nf k1) :
  walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) (sp_app s A)
  = match walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s with
    | WSpine s' =>
        WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A))
    | WTarget v H =>
        WTarget (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y) k1 k2 v H
                   (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A))
                (kc_step H)
    end.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma walk_nf_sp_app_eq (kO : kind) (d m : nat) (argO : nf kO)
    (k1 k2 : kind) (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (A : nf k1) :
  walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y))
    (@nf_neu k2 (sp_app s A))
  = match walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s with
    | WSpine s' =>
        nf_neu (sp_app s' (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A))
    | WTarget v H =>
        open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y) k1 k2 v H
          (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A)
    end.
Proof.
  rewrite walk_nf_neu_eq.
  rewrite walk_sp_app_eq.
  remember (walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s) as w eqn:Ew.
  destruct w as [s'|v H]; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma walk_app_nf_neu (kO : kind) (d m : nat) (argO : nf kO)
    (k1 k2 : kind) (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (A : nf k1) :
  walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y))
    (app_nf (@nf_neu (k1 ⇒ k2) s) A)
  = app_nf
      (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y))
         (@nf_neu (k1 ⇒ k2) s))
      (walk_nf kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) A).
Proof.
  cbn [app_nf].
  rewrite walk_nf_sp_app_eq.
  rewrite walk_nf_neu_eq.
  cbn.
  destruct (walk_sp kO d m argO (open_kap kO (fun y p => open_fix y)) s)
    as [s'|v H]; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite open_kap_app. reflexivity.
Qed.

Inductive walkres (k0 kd : kind) : Type :=
| WSpine (s : spine kd) : walkres k0 kd
| WTarget (v : nf kd) (H : kind_cod kd k0) : walkres k0 kd.

Arguments WSpine {k0 kd}.
Arguments WTarget {k0 kd}.

Fixpoint walk_nf (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_neu s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_neu s'
      | WTarget v _ => v
      end
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : walkres k0 kd :=
  match s with
  | @sp_bvar kd i =>
      match Nat.eq_dec i depth with
      | left _ =>
          match kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kd with
          | left e =>
              WTarget (cast_nf e (shift_nf 0 m arg))
                (match e in _ = k' return kind_cod k' k0 with eq_refl => kc_refl k0 end)
          | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd i)
          end
      | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd (if Nat.leb depth i then i - 1 else i))
      end
  | @sp_fvar kd i => WSpine (@sp_fvar kd i)
  | @sp_ctor kd c => WSpine (@sp_ctor kd c)
  | @sp_app k1 k2 s a =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      | WTarget v H => WTarget (kap k1 k2 v H (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a)) (kc_step H)
      end
  end
with walk_con (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

Record NArg := {
  n_k0 : kind;
  n_arg : nf n_k0;
  n_depth : nat;
  n_m : nat;
  n_kd : kind;
  n_t : nf n_kd
}.

Definition NRes (a : NArg) : Type := nf (n_kd a).

Definition n_kind_lt (a b : NArg) : Prop := kind_size (n_k0 a) < kind_size (n_k0 b).

Definition wf_n_kind_lt : well_founded n_kind_lt :=
  wf_inverse_image NArg nat lt (fun a => kind_size (n_k0 a)) lt_wf.

Definition open_kap (k0 : kind)
    (recf : forall y : NArg, kind_size (n_k0 y) < kind_size k0 -> nf (n_kd y))
    (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0) (a0 : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match v in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with
  | @nf_lam k k3 b => fun E =>
      let '(e1, e2) := KArr_inj E in
      let b' := eq_rect k3 (fun z => nf z) b k2 e2 in
      recf (Build_NArg k1 a0 0 0 k2 b') (kind_size_dom_lt k1 k2 k0 H)
  | @nf_neu kd' s' => fun E => nf_neu (sp_app (cast_sp E s') a0)
  | nf_carr _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  | nf_cprod _ _ => fun E => match no_star_arr k1 k2 E with end
  end eq_refl.

Definition open_step (a : NArg)
    (recf : forall y : NArg, n_kind_lt y a -> NRes y) : NRes a.
Proof.
  destruct a as [k0 arg depth m kd t].
  exact (walk_nf k0 depth m arg (open_kap k0 (fun y p => recf y p)) t).
Defined.

Definition open_fix : forall a : NArg, NRes a :=
  Fix wf_n_kind_lt NRes open_step.

Definition open (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) : nf kd :=
  open_fix (Build_NArg k0 arg depth 0 kd t).

Lemma compSub_mk_subst (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂)
      (σ : typ κ Δ₁) :
  forall v (x : dom (extC κ Δ₁)) EQ,
    compSub (extC κ Δ₁) Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ (mksubst κ σ) v x EQ
    = compSub2 (extC κ Δ₁) (extC κ Δ₂) Δ₂ (liftA κ ρ) (mksubst κ (tmap ρ σ)) v x EQ.
Proof.
  intros v [|y] EQ; simpl.
  - destruct EQ. reflexivity.
  - apply t_var_irr.
Qed.

Lemma tmap_subst (κ κ' : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂)
      (τ : typ κ' (extC κ Δ₁)) (σ : typ κ Δ₁) :
  tmap ρ (subst τ σ) = subst (tmap (liftA κ ρ) τ) (tmap ρ σ).
Proof.
  change (tmap ρ (tbind (mksubst κ σ) τ)
          = tbind (mksubst κ (tmap ρ σ)) (tmap (liftA κ ρ) τ)).
  etransitivity.
  - apply (tmap_tbind κ' (extC κ Δ₁) Δ₁ Δ₂ τ ρ (mksubst κ σ)
             (compSub (extC κ Δ₁) Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ (mksubst κ σ))).
    intros v x EQ. reflexivity.
  - etransitivity.
    + apply tbind_ext. apply compSub_mk_subst.
    + symmetry.
      apply (tbind_tmap κ' (extC κ Δ₁) (extC κ Δ₂) Δ₂ τ (liftA κ ρ) (mksubst κ (tmap ρ σ))
               (mk_subst_pirr κ Δ₂ (tmap ρ σ))).
Qed.

Lemma tmap_subst_lift (κ κ' : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂)
      (τ : typ κ' (extC κ Δ₁)) (σ : typ κ Δ₁) :
  tmap ρ (subst τ σ) =
  subst (tmap (@lift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (@extC kind κ)

Proof. apply tmap_subst. Qed.

Lemma cmap_shift_comm (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂) (ψ : constr Δ₁) :
  cmap (liftA κ ρ) (cmap (mkShift κ Δ₁) ψ) = cmap (mkShift κ Δ₂) (cmap ρ ψ).
Proof.

Lemma tctd_tmap {Δ₁ : Ctx kind} {κ κ' : kind} (σ : typ κ Δ₁) (c : tctor κ') :
  tctd σ c -> forall (Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), tctd (tmap ρ σ) c.
Proof.

Definition etaT (κ κ' : kind) {Δ : Ctx kind} (τ : typ (κ ⇒ κ') Δ) : typ (κ ⇒ κ') Δ :=
  t_lam (t_app (shiftt κ τ) (t_var κ (VZ : dom (extC κ Δ)) eq_refl)).

Lemma tmap_eta (κ κ' : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂)
      (τ : typ (κ ⇒ κ') Δ₁) :
  tmap ρ (etaT κ κ' τ) = etaT κ κ' (tmap ρ τ).
Proof.
  change (t_lam (t_app (tmap (liftA κ ρ) (shiftt κ τ))

(* ---------- Type-level renaming algebra ---------- *)

Lemma t_var_irr (κ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (x : dom Δ) (p q : Δ x = κ) :
  t_var κ x p = t_var κ x q.
Proof. f_equal. apply (UIP_dec kindEqDec.eq_dec). Qed.

Lemma tmap_var_ext (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (x : dom Δ₁) (EQ : Δ₁ x = κ)
      (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂) (H : ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) :
  t_var κ (ρ₁ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₁ x) EQ) =
  t_var κ (ρ₂ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₂ x) EQ).
Proof.
  refine (eq_ind (ρ₁ x) (fun w => forall (r : Δ₂ w = κ),
            t_var κ (ρ₁ x) (eq_trans (arr_hom ρ₁ x) EQ) = t_var κ w r)
          _ (ρ₂ x) H _).
  intro r. apply t_var_irr.
Qed.

Fixpoint tmap_ext (κ : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κ Δ₁) {struct τ} :
  forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
  tmap ρ₁ τ = tmap ρ₂ τ :=
  match τ as τ' in type _ κ' return
        forall (ρ₁ ρ₂ : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂), (forall x, ρ₁ x = ρ₂ x) ->
        tmap ρ₁ τ' = tmap ρ₂ τ' with
  | t_var κ x EQ => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H => tmap_var_ext κ Δ₁ Δ₂ x EQ ρ₁ ρ₂ (H x)
  | t_lam b => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal t_lam
        (tmap_ext _ (extC _ Δ₁) (extC _ Δ₂) b
           (lift ρ₁) (lift ρ₂)
           (fun x => match x with VZ => eq_refl | VS y => f_equal (@VS (dom _)) (H y) end))
  | t_app σ τ0 => fun ρ₁ ρ₂ H =>
      f_equal2 (fun f a => @t_app Δ₂ _ _ f a)
        (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ σ ρ₁ ρ₂ H) (tmap_ext _ Δ₁ Δ₂ τ0 ρ₁ ρ₂ H)
