{f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (σ τ : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  forall y : inc (inc V),
    ((Γ' ▹ σ) ▹ τ) (@inc_map (inc V) (inc V') (@inc_map V V' f) y) = ((Γ ▹ σ) ▹ τ) y.
Proof.
  intros [|[|x]]; simpl; try reflexivity; exact (Hf x).
Qed.

Definition shiftt (κ : kind) {κ' : kind} {Δ : Ctx kind} (τ : typ κ' Δ) :
  typ κ' (@extC kind κ Δ) :=
  @shift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (typ κ') (@FMap_typ κ') (@extC kind κ)
         (@ShiftableCore_ext kind κ) Δ τ.

Lemma rel_shift {V V' : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ} {Γ' : V' -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {f : V -> V'} (Hf : forall x, Γ' (f x) = Γ x) (κ : kind) :
  forall y : V, (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ') (f y) = (Env.compose (shiftt κ) Γ) y.
Proof. intro y. unfold shiftt. simpl. apply f_equal, Hf. Qed.
  tmap (liftA κ ρ) (shiftt κ τ) = shiftt κ (tmap ρ τ).
Proof.
  rewrite shiftt_eq. rewrite shiftt_eq.
  rewrite tmap_tmap.
  rewrite tmap_tmap.
  apply tmap_ext. intros x. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition TSub (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) := @Sub kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ Δ₁ Δ₂.

Definition liftS (k : kind) {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) :
  TSub (@extC kind k Δ₁) (@extC kind k Δ₂) :=
  @lift (Ctx kind) TSub (@extC kind k)
        (@SLiftableCore_ext kind (fun κ => typ κ) IPC_typ (fun v => @FMap_typ v) k)
        Δ₁ Δ₂ ρ.

Lemma shift_is_shiftt (k κ' : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (u : typ κ' Δ) :
  @shift (Ctx kind) (@Arr kind) (typ κ') (@FMap_typ κ') (@extC kind k)
         (@ShiftableCore_ext kind k) Δ u = shiftt k u.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma compat_liftS (k : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind)
      (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₂ Δ₃) (ρR : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR' : TSub Δ₁ Δ₃)
      (H : forall κ (x : dom Δ₁) EQ, tmap ρL (ρR κ x EQ) = ρR' κ x EQ) :
  forall κ (z : dom (extC k Δ₁)) EQ,
    tmap (liftA k ρL) (liftS k ρR κ z EQ) = liftS k ρR' κ z EQ.


Definition Pirr {Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind} (ρ : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) : Prop :=
  forall v (x : dom Δ₁) (e1 e2 : Δ₁ x = v), ρ v x e1 = ρ v x e2.

Lemma liftS_pirr (k : kind) (Δ₁ Δ₂ : Ctx kind) (ρ : TSub Δ₁ Δ₂) (H : Pirr ρ) :
  Pirr (liftS k ρ).
Proof.
  intros v [|y] e1 e2; simpl.
  - apply t_var_irr.
  - apply f_equal, H.
Qed.

Lemma compSub2_pirr (Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ : Ctx kind) (ρL : @Arr kind Δ₁ Δ₂) (ρR : TSub Δ₂ Δ₃)
      (H : Pirr ρR) : Pirr (compSub2 Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ ρL ρR).
Proof.
  intros v x e1 e2. simpl. apply H.
Qed.

Definition mksubst (κ : kind) {Δ : Ctx kind} (σ : typ κ Δ) : TSub (@extC kind κ Δ) Δ :=
  @mk_subst (Ctx kind) TSub (typ κ) (@extC kind κ)
    (@SubstitutableCore_ext kind (fun k => typ k) IPC_typ κ) Δ σ.

Lemma mk_subst_pirr (κ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (σ : typ κ Δ) :
  Pirr (mksubst κ σ).
Proof.
  intros v [|y] e1 e2; simpl.
  - rewrite (UIP_dec kindEqDec.eq_dec e1 e2). reflexivity.
  - apply t_var_irr.
Qed.

(* Lower free bound variables by 1: used for eta reduction and for removing
   the substituted binder in the non-target case. *)
Fixpoint lower_nf (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (lower_nf (S cutoff) b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (lower_sp cutoff s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  end
with lower_sp (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i - 1 else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (lower_sp cutoff s) (lower_nf cutoff a)
  end
with lower_con (cutoff : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (lower_nf cutoff a) (lower_nf cutoff b)
  end.

| kc_refl (k : kind) : kind_cod k k

Lemma subst_liftA_mkshift (κ κᵣ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ κᵣ (extC κ Δ)) :
  tbind (mksubst κ (@t_var (extC κ Δ) κ VZ eq_refl))
        (tmap (liftA κ (mkShift κ Δ)) τ) = τ.
Proof.
  rewrite (tbind_tmap κᵣ (extC κ Δ) (extC κ (extC κ Δ)) (extC κ Δ) τ
             (liftA κ (mkShift κ Δ)) (mksubst κ (@t_var (extC κ Δ) κ VZ eq_refl))
             (mk_subst_pirr κ (extC κ Δ) (@t_var (extC κ Δ) κ VZ eq_refl))).
  rewrite (tbind_ext κᵣ (extC κ Δ) (extC κ Δ) τ
             (compSub2 (extC κ Δ) (extC κ (extC κ Δ)) (extC κ Δ)
                (liftA κ (mkShift κ Δ)) (mksubst κ (@t_var (extC κ Δ) κ VZ eq_refl)))
             (idSub (extC κ Δ))
             ltac:(intros v [|y] EQ; destruct EQ; simpl; apply t_var_irr)).
  apply tbind_id.
Qed.

Lemma tproves_lam_inj {Δ : Ctx kind} {Ψ : list (constr Δ)} {κₐ κᵣ : kind}
      {τ σ : typ κᵣ (extC κₐ Δ)} :
  Ψ ⊩ (t_lam τ : typ (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) Δ) ≃ t_lam σ ->
  map shift Ψ ⊩ τ ≃ σ.
Proof.
  intro HP.
  set (v0 := @t_var (extC κₐ Δ) κₐ VZ eq_refl).
  set (ρL := liftA κₐ (mkShift κₐ Δ)).
  set (τs := tmap ρL τ). set (σs := tmap ρL σ).
  assert (H1 : map (cmap (mkShift κₐ Δ)) Ψ ⊩ c_eq (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) (t_lam τs) (t_lam σs)).
  { change (map (cmap (mkShift κₐ Δ)) Ψ
            ⊩ cmap (mkShift κₐ Δ) (c_eq (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) (t_lam τ) (t_lam σ))).
    apply (tproves_tmap Δ Ψ (c_eq (κₐ ⇒ κᵣ) (t_lam τ) (t_lam σ)) HP
             (extC κₐ Δ) (mkShift κₐ Δ)). }
  change (map shift Ψ ⊩ t_lam τs ≃ t_lam σs) in H1.
  assert (Hvar : map shift Ψ ⊩ v0 ≃ v0).
  { apply (tproves_refl κₐ (extC κₐ Δ) (map shift Ψ) v0). }
  pose proof (tpi_app H1 Hvar) as H2.
  pose proof (@tpi_beta (extC κₐ Δ) (map shift Ψ) κₐ κᵣ v0 τs) as HB1.
  pose proof (@tpi_beta (extC κₐ Δ) (map shift Ψ) κₐ κᵣ v0 σs) as HB2.
  assert (Eτ : tbind (mksubst κₐ v0) τs = τ)
    by (change (tbind (mksubst κₐ (@t_var (extC κₐ Δ) κₐ VZ eq_refl))
                 (tmap (liftA κₐ (mkShift κₐ Δ)) τ) = τ);
        apply subst_liftA_mkshift).
  assert (Eσ : tbind (mksubst κₐ v0) σs = σ)
    by (change (tbind (mksubst κₐ (@t_var (extC κₐ Δ) κₐ VZ eq_refl))
                 (tmap (liftA κₐ (mkShift κₐ Δ)) σ) = σ);
        apply subst_liftA_mkshift).
  change (map shift Ψ ⊩ t_app (t_lam τs) v0 ≃ tbind (mksubst κₐ v0) τs) in HB1.
  change (map shift Ψ ⊩ t_app (t_lam σs) v0 ≃ tbind (mksubst κₐ v0) σs) in HB2.
  rewrite Eτ in HB1. rewrite Eσ in HB2.
  eapply tpi_trans.
  - eapply tpi_symm. exact HB1.
  - eapply tpi_trans.
    + exact H2.
    + exact HB2.
Qed.

Definition ctx_of_list (l : list kind) : Ctx kind :=
  fold_right (@extC kind) mtC l.

  match l as l0 return (dom (ctx_of_list l0) -> nat) with

  | KArr a b => S (kind_size a + kind_size b)

(* Beta-short normal forms (eta is handled by smart_lam, to be defined). *)
Inductive nf : kind -> Type :=
| nf_lam {k1 k2} (b : nf k2) : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)
| nf_neu {k} (s : spine k) : nf k
| nf_carr (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
| nf_cprod (c : ncon) (t : nf KTyp) : nf KTyp
with spine : kind -> Type :=
| sp_bvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_fvar {k} (i : nat) : spine k
| sp_ctor {k} (c : tctor k) : spine k
| sp_app {k1 k2} (s : spine (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a : nf k1) : spine k2
with ncon : Type :=
| nceq (k : kind) (a b : nf k) : ncon.

Arguments nf_lam {k1 k2}.
Arguments nf_neu {k}.
Arguments nf_carr.
Arguments nf_cprod.
Arguments sp_bvar {k}.
Arguments sp_fvar {k}.
Arguments sp_ctor {k}.
Arguments sp_app {k1 k2}.
Arguments nceq.

Scheme nf_mutind := Induction for nf Sort Prop
with spine_mutind := Induction for spine Sort Prop
with ncon_mutind := Induction for ncon Sort Prop.

Definition cast_nf {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (a : nf k0) : nf kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return nf k' with eq_refl => a end.

Definition cast_sp {k0 kd : kind} (e : k0 = kd) (s : spine k0) : spine kd :=
  match e in _ = k' return spine k' with eq_refl => s end.

Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.

Definition KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d) :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KArr x y => (a = x) * (b = y) | KTyp => True end) with
  | eq_refl => (eq_refl, eq_refl)
  end.

(* Shift free (relative to the term) bound variables with index >= cutoff by k. *)
Fixpoint shift_nf (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (shift_nf (S cutoff) k b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (shift_sp cutoff k s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (shift_con cutoff k c) (shift_nf cutoff k t)
  end
with shift_sp (cutoff k : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i + k else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (shift_sp cutoff k s) (shift_nf cutoff k a)
  end
with shift_con (cutoff k : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (shift_nf cutoff k a) (shift_nf cutoff k b)
  end.

Fixpoint shift_nf_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : shift_nf c 0 t = t
with shift_sp_id (c : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : shift_sp c 0 s = s
with shift_con_id (c : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} : shift_con c 0 x = x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_sp_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
    + apply shift_con_id.
    + apply shift_nf_id.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i); simpl; [rewrite Nat.add_0_r |]; reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_id | apply shift_nf_id ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_id.
Qed.

Fixpoint shift_nf_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} :
    shift_nf c m (shift_nf c n t) = shift_nf c (n + m) t
with shift_sp_compose (c n m : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} :
    shift_sp c m (shift_sp c n s) = shift_sp c (n + m) s
with shift_con_compose (c n m : nat) (x : ncon) {struct x} :
    shift_con c m (shift_con c n x) = shift_con c (n + m) x.
Proof.
  - destruct t; simpl; f_equal.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
    + apply shift_sp_compose.
    + apply shift_con_compose.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
    + apply shift_con_compose.
    + apply shift_nf_compose.
  - destruct s; simpl; try reflexivity.
    + destruct (Nat.leb c i) eqn:E.
      * assert (Hleb : Nat.leb c (i + n) = true).
        { apply Nat.leb_le. apply Nat.leb_le in E. lia. }
        rewrite Hleb. simpl. rewrite Nat.add_assoc. reflexivity.
      * rewrite E. reflexivity.
    + f_equal; [ apply shift_sp_compose | apply shift_nf_compose ].
  - destruct x; simpl; f_equal; apply shift_nf_compose.
Qed.

(* Lower free bound variables by 1: used for eta reduction and for removing
   the substituted binder in the non-target case. *)
Fixpoint lower_nf (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (lower_nf (S cutoff) b)
  | nf_neu s => nf_neu (lower_sp cutoff s)
  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (lower_con cutoff c) (lower_nf cutoff t)
  end
with lower_sp (cutoff : nat) {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : spine kd :=
  match s with
  | sp_bvar i => sp_bvar (if Nat.leb cutoff i then i - 1 else i)
  | sp_fvar i => sp_fvar i
  | sp_ctor c => sp_ctor c
  | sp_app s a => sp_app (lower_sp cutoff s) (lower_nf cutoff a)
  end
with lower_con (cutoff : nat) (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (lower_nf cutoff a) (lower_nf cutoff b)
  end.

Inductive kind_cod : kind -> kind -> Type :=
| kc_refl (k : kind) : kind_cod k k
| kc_step {k1 k2 k0 : kind} : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> kind_cod k2 k0.

Lemma kind_cod_size : forall {k k0 : kind}, kind_cod k k0 -> kind_size k <= kind_size k0.
Proof. induction 1; [lia | simpl in *; lia]. Qed.

Lemma kind_size_dom_lt (k1 k2 k0 : kind) (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0) :
  kind_size k1 < kind_size k0.
Proof. pose proof (kind_cod_size H) as Hs. simpl in Hs. lia. Qed.


Lemma size_lt_dom (k1 k2 k k0 : kind) (e : k = k1)
    (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0) (n : nat) (Heq : kind_size k0 = n) :
  kind_size k < n.
Proof. subst k. pose proof (kind_size_dom_lt k1 k2 k0 H). lia. Qed.

Inductive walkres (k0 kd : kind) : Type :=
| WSpine (s : spine kd) : walkres k0 kd
| WTarget (v : nf kd) (H : kind_cod kd k0) : walkres k0 kd.

Arguments WSpine {k0 kd}.
Arguments WTarget {k0 kd}.

Fixpoint walk_nf (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (t : nf kd) {struct t} : nf kd :=
  match t with
  | nf_lam b => nf_lam (walk_nf k0 (S depth) (S m) arg kap b)
  | nf_neu s =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => nf_neu s'
      | WTarget v _ => v

  | nf_carr c t => nf_carr (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  | nf_cprod c t => nf_cprod (walk_con k0 depth m arg kap c) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap t)
  end
with walk_sp (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    {kd : kind} (s : spine kd) {struct s} : walkres k0 kd :=
  match s with
  | @sp_bvar kd i =>
      match Nat.eq_dec i depth with
      | left _ =>
          match kindEqDec.eq_dec k0 kd with
          | left e =>
              WTarget (cast_nf e (shift_nf 0 m arg))
                (match e in _ = k' return kind_cod k' k0 with eq_refl => kc_refl k0 end)
          | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd i)
          end
      | right _ => WSpine (@sp_bvar kd (if Nat.leb depth i then i - 1 else i))
      end
  | @sp_fvar kd i => WSpine (@sp_fvar kd i)
  | @sp_ctor kd c => WSpine (@sp_ctor kd c)
  | @sp_app k1 k2 s a =>
      match walk_sp k0 depth m arg kap s with
      | WSpine s' => WSpine (sp_app s' (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a))
      | WTarget v H => WTarget (kap k1 k2 v H (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a)) (kc_step H)
      end
  end
with walk_con (k0 : kind) (depth m : nat) (arg : nf k0)
    (kap : forall (k1 k2 : kind), nf (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0 -> nf k1 -> nf k2)
    (c : ncon) {struct c} : ncon :=
  match c with
  | nceq kd a b => nceq kd (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap a) (walk_nf k0 depth m arg kap b)
  end.

  n_k0 : kind;
  n_arg : nf n_k0;
  n_depth : nat;
  n_m : nat;
  n_kd : kind;
  n_t : nf n_kd
}.

Definition NRes (a : NArg) : Type := nf (n_kd a).

Definition n_kind_lt (a b : NArg) : Prop := kind_size (n_k0 a) < kind_size (n_k0 b).

Definition wf_n_kind_lt : well_founded n_kind_lt :=
  wf_inverse_image NArg nat lt (fun a => kind_size (n_k0 a)) lt_wf.

Definition open_kap (k0 : kind)
    (recf : forall y : NArg, kind_size (n_k0 y) < kind_size k0 -> nf (n_kd y))
    (k1 k2 : kind) (v : nf (k1 ⇒ k2)) (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) k0) (a0 : nf k1) : nf k2 :=
  match v in nf k' return (k' = (k1 ⇒ k2)) -> nf k2 with

  end eq_refl.

Definition open_step (a : NArg)
    (recf : forall y : NArg, n_kind_lt y a -> NRes y) : NRes a.
Proof.

Defined.

Definition open_fix : forall a : NArg, NRes a :=
  Fix wf_n_kind_lt NRes open_step.

Definition open (k0 : kind) (arg : nf k0) (depth : nat)

Import DED_kind.

Inductive ax := L | R.

Inductive value {V : Set} :=
| v_var (x : V) : value
| v_unit : value
| v_lam (e : @expr (inc V)) : value
| v_pair (v₁ v₂ : value) : value
| v_inj (a : ax) (v : value) : value
| v_tlam (e : expr) : value
| v_pack (v : value) : value
| v_roll (v : value) : value
| v_lamC  (e : expr) : value
| v_withC (v : value) : value
| v_fix (e : @expr (inc (inc V))) : value
with expr {V : Set} :=
| e_val (v : value) : expr
| e_bind (e₁ : expr) (e₂ : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_app (v₁ v₂ : value) : expr
| e_tapp (v : value) : expr
| e_proj (a : ax) (v : value) : expr
| e_abort (v : value) : expr
| e_case (v : value) (e₁ e₂ : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_unpack (v : value) (e : @expr (inc V)) : expr
| e_unroll (v : value) : expr
| e_cabort : expr
| e_capp (v : value) : expr
| e_lwith (v : value) (e : @expr (inc V)) : expr.

Arguments value V%bind : clear implicits.

Arguments expr  V%bind : clear implicits.

Declare Scope syn_scope.

Delimit Scope syn_scope with syn.

Coercion e_val : value >-> expr.

Coercion e_app : value >-> Funclass.

Notation "e₁ >>= e₂" := (e_bind e₁ e₂) (at level 45, right associativity) : syn_scope.

Notation "'ƛ' e" := (v_lam e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨⟩" := v_unit : syn_scope.

Notation "⟨ v ⟩ᶜ" := (v_withC v) : syn_scope.

Notation "'ƛᶜ' e" := (v_lamC e) (at level 60) : syn_scope.

Local Open Scope syn_scope.

Fixpoint emap {A B : Set} (f : A [→] B) (e : expr A) : expr B :=
  match e with
  | e_val v => vmap f v
  | e₁ >>= e₂ => emap f e₁ >>= emap (f ↑) e₂
  | e_app v₁ v₂ => (vmap f v₁) (vmap f v₂)
  | e_tapp v => e_tapp (vmap f v)
  | e_proj x v => e_proj x (vmap f v)
  | e_abort v => e_abort (vmap f v)
  | e_case v e₁ e₂ => e_case (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e₁) (emap (f ↑) e₂)
  | e_unpack v e => e_unpack (vmap f v) (emap (f ↑) e)
  | e_unroll v => e_unroll (vmap f v)
  | e_cabort => e_cabort

Lemma typing_expr_bind_inv {V : Set} {Δ : Ctx kind} {Ψ : list (constr Δ)} {Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ}
      {e : expr V} {τ : typ ⋆ Δ} :
  Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ ->
  forall (eA : expr V) (eB : expr (inc V)), e = e_bind eA eB -> exists τ1 τ2, Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ eA : τ1 /\ Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ1 ⊢ₑ eB : τ2 /\ Ψ ⊩ τ2 ≃ τ.
Proof.
  intro H.
  induction H using typing_expr_mut with
    (P := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
               (e : expr V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) (_ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ e : τ) =>
             forall (eA : expr V) (eB : expr (inc V)), e = e_bind eA eB -> exists τ1 τ2, Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ₑ eA : τ1 /\ Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ▹ τ1 ⊢ₑ eB : τ2 /\ Ψ ⊩ τ2 ≃ τ)
    (P0 := fun (V : Set) (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (Γ : V -> typ ⋆ Δ)
               (v0 : value V) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ) (_ : Δ ∣ Ψ ∣ Γ ⊢ᵥ v0 : τ) => True).
  - (* T_val *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_bind *) intros eA eB EV. injection EV as E1 E2. subst. exists τ₁, τ₂. split; [ eassumption | split; [ eassumption | apply tproves_refl ] ].
  - (* T_congE *) intros eA eB EV. destruct (IHtyping_expr eA eB EV) as (τ1 & τ2 & H1 & H2 & HEQ). exists τ1, τ2. split; [ exact H1 | split; [ exact H2 | eapply tpi_trans; [ exact HEQ | eassumption ] ] ].
  - (* T_app *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_tapp *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_projL *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_projR *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_abort *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_case *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_unpack *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_unroll *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_cabort *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_capp *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_lwith *) intros eA eB EV. discriminate EV.
  - (* T_var *) exact I.
  - (* T_congV *) exact I.
  - (* T_unit *) exact I.
  - (* T_lam *) exact I.
  - (* T_pair *) exact I.
  - (* T_injl *) exact I.
  - (* T_injr *) exact I.
  - (* T_tlam *) exact I.
  - (* T_pack *) exact I.
  - (* T_roll *) exact I.
  - (* T_lamC *) exact I.
  - (* T_withC *) exact I.
  - (* T_rec *) exact I.
Qed.

Require Import Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).
Import kindEqDec.
Local Open Scope typ_scope.

(* ----------  Basic impossible-head facts for tctd/tdiscr  ---------- *)

Lemma tctd_lam_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ' κ : kind} (b : typ κ' (extC κ Δ))
      (c : tctor κ'') : tctd (@t_lam Δ κ κ' b) c -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma tctd_redex_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr κc : kind}
      (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) (a : typ κa Δ) (c : tctor κc) :
  tctd ((t_lam b) a) c -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - discriminate.
  - apply (tctd_lam_false b c); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma tctd_carr_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κc : kind} (ψ : constr Δ) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ)
      (c : tctor κc) : tctd (@t_carr Δ ψ τ) c -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma tctd_cprod_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κc : kind} (ψ : constr Δ) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ)
      (c : tctor κc) : tctd (@t_cprod Δ ψ τ) c -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma tctd_var_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ κc : kind} (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ)
      (c : tctor κc) : tctd (@t_var Δ κ x EQ) c -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma tctd_app_inv {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr κc : kind}
      (σ : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (τ : typ κa Δ) (c : tctor κc) :
  tctd (σ τ) c -> tctd σ c.
Proof. intro H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

(* cdiscrK is irreflexive. *)
Lemma cdiscrK_self {κ : kind} (c : tctor κ) : cdiscrK c c -> False.
Proof.
  unfold cdiscrK.
  destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec κ κ) as [e|n].
  - rewrite (UIP_dec kindEqDec.eq_dec e eq_refl). simpl.
    destruct c; cbn; intros H; inversion H.
  - exfalso. apply n. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A type with a tctd head cannot be discriminable from itself. *)
Lemma tdiscr_ctor_self {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (c : tctor κ) :
  ⊮ ((t_ctor c) ≃ (t_ctor c) : constr Δ) -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply (cdiscrK_self c); assumption.
  - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate.
Qed.

(* Redexes and lambdas never occur as a tdiscr side. *)
Lemma tdiscr_lam_left {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr : kind}
      (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) {κ : kind} (σ : typ κ Δ) :
  ⊮ ((t_lam b : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) ≃ σ) -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply (tctd_lam_false b c1); assumption.
  - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma tdiscr_lam_right {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr : kind}
      (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) {κ : kind} (σ : typ κ Δ) :
  ⊮ (σ ≃ (t_lam b : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ)) -> False.
Proof. intro H. apply (tdiscr_lam_left b σ). apply tdiscr_symm; assumption. Qed.

Lemma tdiscr_redex_left {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr : kind}
      (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) (a : typ κa Δ) {κ : kind} (σ : typ κ Δ) :
  ⊮ (((t_lam b) a : typ κr Δ) ≃ σ) -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply (tctd_redex_false b a c1); assumption.
  - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate.
Qed.

(* tdiscr of two applications forces tdiscr of their function parts. *)
Lemma tdiscr_app_func {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr : kind}
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ) :
  ⊮ ((σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2)) -> ⊮ (σ1 ≃ σ2).
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - eapply td_ctd.
    + apply (tctd_app_inv σ1 τ1 c1); assumption.
    + apply (tctd_app_inv σ2 τ2 c2); assumption.
    + assumption.
  - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate.
Qed.

(* carr/cprod rigidity when both sides have the same head shape. *)
Lemma tdiscr_carr_carr_false {Δ : Ctx kind} (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  ⊮ ((t_carr ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_carr ψ2 τ2)) -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply (tctd_carr_false ψ1 τ1 c1); assumption.
  - apply (tctd_carr_false ψ1 τ1 c); assumption.
  - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma tdiscr_cprod_cprod_false {Δ : Ctx kind} (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ) :
  ⊮ ((t_cprod ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_cprod ψ2 τ2)) -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply (tctd_cprod_false ψ1 τ1 c1); assumption.
  - apply (tctd_cprod_false ψ1 τ1 c); assumption.
  - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma tdiscr_var_var_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (x y : dom Δ)
      (EQ1 EQ2 : Δ x = κ) (EQ3 EQ4 : Δ y = κ) :
  ⊮ ((@t_var Δ κ x EQ1) ≃ (@t_var Δ κ y EQ3)) -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - apply (tctd_var_false x EQ1 c1); assumption.
  - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate. - discriminate.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma Hdiscr_of_hard
  (Htrans : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) (τ1 τ2 τ3 : typ κ Δ),
      nil ⊩ τ1 ≃ τ2 -> nil ⊩ τ2 ≃ τ3 -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ3) -> False)

      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),
      tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HappL : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κa κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),
      tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (σ1 ≃ σ2) -> False)
  (HcarrR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_carr ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_carr ψ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HcprodR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_cprod ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_cprod ψ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HcarrL : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_carr ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_carr ψ2 τ2) -> nil ⊩ ψ1 -> ⊮ ψ2 -> False)
  (HcprodL : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_cprod ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_cprod ψ2 τ2) -> nil ⊩ ψ1 -> ⊮ ψ2 -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ), nil ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ ψ H.
  remember nil as Ψ eqn:E.
  revert Δ ψ H E.
  refine (tproves_i_ind
    (fun (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (ψ : constr Δ) =>

    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Δ Ψ ψ H E).

Task: continue the NBE development only in `/workspace/NbeFork.v`, aiming at the heredity-substitution composition and generalized `norm_tbind` lemmas.

Outcome: the naive composition identities are false without a well-kinded context invariant. I formalized that obstruction and the supporting shift algebra, but did not prove the full walker composition or norm-substitution lemma.

Files/artifacts:
- `/workspace/NbeFork.v` (scratch only; `Task.v`, `Nbe.v`, `TaskPrefix.v`, and support files untouched).
- Compiles with `rocq c -R . Top NbeFork.v`.
- No `Admitted`/`admit`/`Abort`/axioms in the final file.

Proved in `NbeFork.v`:
- `subst_at` definition: `walk_nf k d d arg (open_kap ...) t`.
- `shift_nf_absorb`, `shift_sp_absorb`, `shift_con_absorb`:
  `shift_nf (c+r) s (shift_nf r m t) = shift_nf r (m+s) t` when `c <= m`.
- `wf_nf`, `wf_sp`, `wf_con` binder-kind well-formedness.
- `naive_composition_counterexample`: naive identity fails for `(id=1, od=0)`.
- `id_le_od_naive_counterexample`: naive identity still fails for `id <= od` when the target-kind invariant is absent (`id=od=0`, `kI=KTyp`, `kO=KTyp⇒KTyp`).
- `c2_t_not_wf`: that second counterexample is not well-formed in the required context.

Key discovery recorded in the file’s closing comment: the corrected identity needs a context `Γ` with
`wf_nf Γ t`, `nth_error Γ id = Some kI`, `nth_error Γ (S od) = Some kO`, and `id <= od`. Under that invariant, the remaining obligations reduce to shift absorption (done), lowering of sufficiently shifted inserted arguments, and the callback commutation
`shift_nf cc s (kap k1 k2 v H a) = kap k1 k2 (shift_nf cc s v) H (shift_nf cc s a)`.
For `open_kap`, that callback obligation is the shift/open commutation at the smaller binder kind, so the natural proof is by well-founded induction on `kind_size` of the target kind, nested with structural induction on `nf`.

Not proved: full `walk_nf`/`open` composition, generalized `norm_tbind`/substitution soundness, and the eta/smart-lambda lemma.

Require Import TaskPrefix.
Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds.
Require Import Binding.Intrinsic.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).
Import kindEqDec.
Require Import Eqdep_dec.
Local Open Scope typ_scope.
Definition KArr_inj {a b c d : kind} (E : KArr a b = KArr c d) : (a = c) * (b = d) :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KArr x y => (a = x) * (b = y) | KTyp => True end) with
  | eq_refl => (eq_refl, eq_refl)
  end.
Definition no_star_arr (k1 k2 : kind) (E : KTyp = KArr k1 k2) : False :=
  match E in _ = k' return (match k' with KTyp => True | KArr _ _ => False end) with
  | eq_refl => I
  end.
Ltac kind_contra E :=
  lazymatch type of E with
  | KTyp = KArr _ _ => exact (no_star_arr _ _ E)
  | KArr _ _ = KTyp => exact (no_star_arr _ _ (eq_sym E))
  | KArr ?a ?b = KArr ?c ?d =>
      let p := fresh "p" in pose proof (KArr_inj E) as p;
      let e1 := fresh "e1" in let e2 := fresh "e2" in
      destruct p as [e1 e2]; first [ kind_contra e1 | kind_contra e2 ]
  | _ => idtac
  end.
Ltac solve_cdiscrK :=
  unfold cdiscrK;
  match goal with
  | |- context [kindEqDec.eq_dec ?K ?K] =>
      let e := fresh "e" in let ne := fresh "ne" in let H := fresh "H" in
      destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec K K) as [e|ne];
      [ assert (H : e = eq_refl) by (apply UIP_dec; exact kindEqDec.eq_dec);
        rewrite H; cbn; constructor
      | exfalso; apply ne; reflexivity ]
  | |- context [kindEqDec.eq_dec ?K1 ?K2] =>
      let e := fresh "e" in let ne := fresh "ne" in
      destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec K1 K2) as [e|ne];
      [ exfalso; kind_contra e | exact I ]
  end.
Lemma cdiscr_all_rec_star : cdiscrK (tc_all ⋆) (tc_rec ⋆).
Proof. solve_cdiscrK. Qed.
Lemma cdiscr_xist_rec_star : cdiscrK (tc_xist ⋆) (tc_rec ⋆).
Proof. solve_cdiscrK. Qed.
Lemma cdiscr_all_xist_gen (κ κ' : kind) : cdiscrK (tc_all κ) (tc_xist κ').
Proof.
  destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec κ κ') as [E|NE].
  - subst κ'. solve_cdiscrK.
  - unfold cdiscrK. destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec ((κ ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) ((κ' ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆)) as [e|ne].
    + exfalso. apply NE. destruct (KArr_inj e) as [e1 _]. destruct (KArr_inj e1) as [e2 _]. exact e2.
    + exact I.
Qed.
Lemma cdiscr_xist_all_gen (κ κ' : kind) : cdiscrK (tc_xist κ) (tc_all κ').
Proof.
  destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec κ κ') as [E|NE].
  - subst κ'. solve_cdiscrK.
  - unfold cdiscrK. destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec ((κ ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) ((κ' ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆)) as [e|ne].
    + exfalso. apply NE. destruct (KArr_inj e) as [e1 _]. destruct (KArr_inj e1) as [e2 _]. exact e2.
    + exact I.
Qed.
Lemma cdiscr_all_rec_gen (κ κ' : kind) : cdiscrK (tc_all κ) (tc_rec κ').
Proof.
  unfold cdiscrK. destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec ((κ ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) ((κ' ⇒ κ') ⇒ κ')) as [e|ne].
  - destruct (KArr_inj e) as [Edom Ecod]. (* Edom: κ⇒⋆ = κ'⇒κ' , Ecod: ⋆=κ' *)
    symmetry in Ecod. subst κ'.
    destruct (KArr_inj Edom) as [E1 _]. subst κ.
    assert (H : e = eq_refl) by (apply UIP_dec; exact kindEqDec.eq_dec).
    rewrite H. cbn. exact cdiscr_all_rec_star.
  - exact I.
Qed.
Lemma cdiscr_xist_rec_gen (κ κ' : kind) : cdiscrK (tc_xist κ) (tc_rec κ').
Proof.
  unfold cdiscrK. destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec ((κ ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆) ((κ' ⇒ κ') ⇒ κ')) as [e|ne].
  - destruct (KArr_inj e) as [Edom Ecod]. symmetry in Ecod. subst κ'.
    destruct (KArr_inj Edom) as [E1 _]. subst κ.
    assert (H : e = eq_refl) by (apply UIP_dec; exact kindEqDec.eq_dec).
    rewrite H. cbn. exact cdiscr_xist_rec_star.
  - exact I.
Qed.
Lemma cdiscr_rec_all_gen (κ κ' : kind) : cdiscrK (tc_rec κ) (tc_all κ').
Proof.
  unfold cdiscrK. destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec ((κ ⇒ κ) ⇒ κ) ((κ' ⇒ ⋆) ⇒ ⋆)) as [e|ne].
  - destruct (KArr_inj e) as [Edom Ecod]. (* Edom κ⇒κ=κ'⇒⋆, Ecod κ=⋆ *)

    rewrite H. cbn. constructor.
  - exact I.
Qed.
Lemma cdiscr_rec_xist_gen (κ κ' : kind) : cdiscrK (tc_rec κ) (tc_xist κ').
Proof.

  - destruct (KArr_inj e) as [Edom Ecod]. symmetry in Ecod. subst κ.

    assert (H : e = eq_refl) by (apply UIP_dec; exact kindEqDec.eq_dec).
    rewrite H. cbn. constructor.
  - exact I.
Qed.

    (carrInjR) -> (cprodInjR) -> (carrInjL) -> (cprodInjL) ->
    forall Δ ψ, nil ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> False.

Definition HrollProp : Prop :=
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ κ' : kind)
         (τ : typ κ (extC κ Δ)) (τ' : typ κ' (extC κ' Δ))
         (σ₁ σ₂ σ₁' σ₂' : typ ⋆ Δ),

Lemma Hroll_of_discr
  (Hdiscr : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ), nil ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> False) :
  HrollProp.

  eapply roll_eq_of_discr; [ exact Hdiscr | exact HF | exact HF' | exact HEQ ].
Qed.

Lemma preservation_head_step
  (Hdiscr : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ), nil ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> False) :
  forall (e e' : expr ∅), head_step e e' ->
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ),

  - eapply preservation_LamBetaT_nil; [ exact Hdiscr | exact Hty ].

  - eapply preservation_ProjL; exact Hty.

  - eapply preservation_CaseL; exact Hty.

  - eapply preservation_UnpackE_nil; [ exact Hdiscr | exact Hty ].
  - eapply preservation_UnrollE_nil; [ apply Hroll_of_discr; exact Hdiscr | exact Hty ].
  - eapply preservation_WithE; exact Hty.
  - eapply preservation_BindE; exact Hty.
  - eapply preservation_BindE'.
    + intros Δ0 τ0 H0. apply IHHS. exact H0.
    + exact Hty.
Qed.

Lemma safe_of_progress_preservation
  (Hdiscr : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ), nil ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> False) :
  forall (e : expr ∅) (τ : typ ⋆ mtC),

Require Import TaskPrefix.
Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax Lang.FOmegaEq.Typing Lang.FOmegaEq.OpSemantics.
Require Import Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Require Import Stdlib.Program.Equality.
Require Import Stdlib.Logic.Eqdep_dec.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).
Import kindEqDec.
Local Open Scope typ_scope.

(* ----------  Basic impossible-head facts for tctd/tdiscr  ---------- *)

Lemma tctd_lam_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ' κ κc : kind} (b : typ κ' (extC κ Δ))
      (c : tctor κc) : tctd (@t_lam Δ κ κ' b) c -> False.
Proof. intro H. dependent destruction H. Qed.

Lemma tctd_redex_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr κc : kind}
      (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) (a : typ κa Δ) (c : tctor κc) :
  tctd ((t_lam b) a) c -> False.
Proof. intro H. dependent destruction H. dependent destruction H. Qed.

Lemma tctd_carr_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κc : kind} (ψ : constr Δ) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ)
      (c : tctor κc) : tctd (@t_carr Δ ψ τ) c -> False.
Proof. intro H. dependent destruction H. Qed.

Lemma tctd_cprod_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κc : kind} (ψ : constr Δ) (τ : typ ⋆ Δ)
      (c : tctor κc) : tctd (@t_cprod Δ ψ τ) c -> False.
Proof. intro H. dependent destruction H. Qed.

Lemma tctd_var_false {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ κc : kind} (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ)
      (c : tctor κc) : tctd (@t_var Δ κ x EQ) c -> False.
Proof. intro H. dependent destruction H. Qed.

Lemma tctd_app_inv {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr κc : kind}
      (σ : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (τ : typ κa Δ) (c : tctor κc) :
  tctd (σ τ) c -> tctd σ c.
Proof. intro H. dependent destruction H. assumption. Qed.

(* cdiscrK is irreflexive. *)
Lemma cdiscrK_self {κ : kind} (c : tctor κ) : cdiscrK c c -> False.
Proof.
  unfold cdiscrK.
  destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec κ κ) as [e|n].
  - rewrite (UIP_dec kindEqDec.eq_dec e eq_refl). simpl.
    destruct c; cbn; intros H; inversion H.
  - exfalso. apply n. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* A type with a tctd head cannot be discriminable from itself. *)
Lemma tdiscr_ctor_self {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (c : tctor κ) :
  ⊮ ((t_ctor c) ≃ (t_ctor c) : constr Δ) -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. dependent destruction H.
  dependent destruction HI₁. dependent destruction HI₂.
  exact (cdiscrK_self c HD).
Qed.

(* Redexes and lambdas never occur as a tdiscr side. *)
Lemma tdiscr_lam_left {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr : kind}
      (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) (σ : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) :
  ⊮ ((t_lam b : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) ≃ σ) -> False.
Proof.
  intro H. dependent destruction H.
  all: eauto using tctd_lam_false.
Qed.

Lemma cdiscr_symm {κ : kind} (c1 c2 : tctor κ) : cdiscr c1 c2 -> cdiscr c2 c1.
Proof. intros H; destruct H; econstructor. Qed.

Lemma cdiscrK_symm {κ1 κ2 : kind} (c1 : tctor κ1) (c2 : tctor κ2) :
  cdiscrK c1 c2 -> cdiscrK c2 c1.
Proof.
  intro H. unfold cdiscrK in *.
  destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec κ1 κ2) as [e|n].
  - destruct e.
    destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec κ1 κ1) as [e2|n2].
    + rewrite (UIP_dec kindEqDec.eq_dec e2 eq_refl).
      simpl in H. simpl. apply cdiscr_symm. exact H.
    + exfalso; apply n2; reflexivity.
  - destruct (kindEqDec.eq_dec κ2 κ1) as [e|n2].
    + exfalso; apply n; symmetry; exact e.
    + exact I.
Qed.

Lemma tdiscr_symm {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (τ1 τ2 : typ κ Δ) :
  ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> ⊮ (τ2 ≃ τ1).
Proof.
  intro H. dependent destruction H.
  - eapply td_ctd; eauto using cdiscrK_symm.
  - eapply td_ctd_carr; eauto.
  - eapply td_carr_ctd; eauto.
  - eapply td_ctd_cprod; eauto.
  - eapply td_cprod_ctd; eauto.
  - eapply td_cprod_carr; eauto.
  - eapply td_carr_cprod; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma tdiscr_lam_right {Δ : Ctx kind} {κa κr : kind}
      (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) (σ : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) :
  ⊮ (σ ≃ (t_lam b : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ)) -> False.

(* ---------- Reduction of Hdiscr to the remaining semantic/injectivity facts ---------- *)

Lemma Hdiscr_of_hard
  (Htrans : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) (τ1 τ2 τ3 : typ κ Δ),
      nil ⊩ τ1 ≃ τ2 -> nil ⊩ τ2 ≃ τ3 -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ3) -> False)
  (HappR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κa κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),

      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HappL : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κa κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),
      tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (σ1 ≃ σ2) -> False)
  (HcarrR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_carr ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_carr ψ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HcprodR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_cprod ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_cprod ψ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HcarrL : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_carr ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_carr ψ2 τ2) -> nil ⊩ ψ1 -> ⊮ ψ2 -> False)
  (HcprodL : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_cprod ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_cprod ψ2 τ2) -> nil ⊩ ψ1 -> ⊮ ψ2 -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ), nil ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> False.
Proof.
  assert (Haux : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (ψ : constr Δ),
             Ψ ⊩ ψ -> Ψ = nil -> ⊮ ψ -> False).
  { intros Δh Ψh ψh H0.
    refine (tproves_i_ind
      (fun (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (ψ : constr Δ) =>
         Ψ = nil -> ⊮ ψ -> False)
      _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Δh Ψh ψh H0).
  - (* ax *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ0 HIn E0. subst Ψ0. inversion HIn.
  - (* var *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κ x EQ1 EQ2 E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (tdiscr_var_var_false x x EQ1 EQ1 EQ2 EQ2 HD).
  - (* lam *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (tdiscr_lam_left τ1 (t_lam τ2) HD).
  - (* app *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr σ1 σ2 τ1 τ2 Hf IHf Ha IHa E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (IHf eq_refl (tdiscr_app_func σ1 σ2 τ1 τ2 HD)).
  - (* ctor *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κ c E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (tdiscr_ctor_self c HD).
  - (* carr *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ0 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (tdiscr_carr_carr_false ψ0 ψ0 τ1 τ2 HD).
  - (* cprod *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ0 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (tdiscr_cprod_cprod_false ψ0 ψ0 τ1 τ2 HD).
  - (* symm *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κ τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (IH eq_refl (tdiscr_symm τ2 τ1 HD)).
  - (* trans *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κ τ1 τ2 τ3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (Htrans Δ0 κ τ1 τ2 τ3 H1 H2 HD).
  - (* eta *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr τ E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    eapply tdiscr_lam_right; exact HD.
  - (* beta *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr σ τ E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (tdiscr_redex_left τ σ (subst τ σ) HD).
  - (* appInjR *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HappR Δ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem HD).
  - (* appInjL *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HappL Δ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem HD).
  - (* carrInjR *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HcarrR Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem HD).
  - (* cprodInjR *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HcprodR Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem HD).
  - (* cprodInjL *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH H1 IH1 E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HcprodL Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem H1 HD).
  - (* carrInjL *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH H1 IH1 E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HcarrL Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem H1 HD).
  }

(* tctd uniqueness, needed below. *)
Lemma tctd_unique {Δ : Ctx kind} :
  forall (κ1 : kind) (τ : typ κ1 Δ) (κ2 : kind) (c2 : tctor κ2),
    tctd τ c2 ->
    forall (κ3 : kind) (c3 : tctor κ3), tctd τ c3 ->
      exists (E : κ2 = κ3), eq_rect κ2 (fun k => tctor k) c2 κ3 E = c3.
Proof.
  refine (tctd_ind Δ
    (fun κ1 τ κ2 c2 => forall κ3 c3, tctd τ c3 ->
       exists E : κ2 = κ3, eq_rect κ2 (fun k => tctor k) c2 κ3 E = c3)
    _ _).
  - intros κ c κ3 c3 H2. dependent destruction H2.
    + exists eq_refl. reflexivity.
  - intros κ κa κ' σ τ0 c HI IH κ3 c3 H2.
    dependent destruction H2.
    apply (IH _ _ H2).
Qed.


(* Same-head tctd derivations cannot be discriminable. *)
Lemma tctd_same_head_not_discr {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ κc : kind}
      (τ1 τ2 : typ κ Δ) (c : tctor κc) :
  tctd τ1 c -> tctd τ2 c -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False.
Proof.
  intros H1 H2 HD.
  dependent destruction HD.
  all: try (exfalso; eauto using tctd_carr_false, tctd_cprod_false).
  destruct (tctd_unique κ τ1 κ₁ c₁ HI₁ κc c H1) as [E1 Hc1].
  destruct E1. simpl in Hc1.
  destruct (tctd_unique κ τ2 κ₂ c₂ HI₂ κ₁ c H2) as [E2 Hc2].
  destruct E2. simpl in Hc2.
  rewrite Hc1 in HD. rewrite Hc2 in HD.
  exact (cdiscrK_self c HD).
Qed.


Lemma HappL_proved : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κa κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),

  nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (σ1 ≃ σ2) -> False.
Proof.
  intros. exact (tctd_same_head_not_discr σ1 σ2 c H H0 H2).
Qed.

  intros. eapply Hdiscr_of_hard; eauto using HappL_proved.

(* The transitivity hard case at base kind follows from the appInjR hard case. *)
Lemma Htrans_star_of_HappR
  (HappR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κa κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),
      tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (τ1 τ2 τ3 : typ ⋆ Δ),
    nil ⊩ τ1 ≃ τ2 -> nil ⊩ τ2 ≃ τ3 -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ3) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ τ1 τ2 τ3 H12 H23 HD.
  assert (H13 : nil ⊩ τ1 ≃ τ3) by (eapply tpi_trans; eauto).
  set (σ := @t_ctor Δ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) tc_arr).
  assert (Happ : nil ⊩ (σ τ1) ≃ (σ τ3)).
  { eapply tpi_app. apply tpi_ctor. exact H13. }
  eapply (HappR Δ ⋆ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) σ σ tc_arr τ1 τ3).
  - apply inj_ctor.
  - apply inj_ctor.
  - exact Happ.
  - exact HD.
Qed.

    exact (tdiscr_carr_carr_false ψ0 ψ0 τ1 τ2 HD).
  - (* cprod *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ0 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (tdiscr_cprod_cprod_false ψ0 ψ0 τ1 τ2 HD).
  - (* symm *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κ τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (IH eq_refl (tdiscr_symm τ2 τ1 HD)).
  - (* trans *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κ τ1 τ2 τ3 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (Htrans Δ0 κ τ1 τ2 τ3 H1 H2 HD).
  - (* eta *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr τ E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    eapply tdiscr_lam_right; exact HD.
  - (* beta *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr σ τ E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (tdiscr_redex_left τ σ (subst τ σ) HD).
  - (* appInjR *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HappR Δ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem HD).
  - (* appInjL *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HappL Δ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem HD).
  - (* carrInjR *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HcarrR Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem HD).
  - (* cprodInjR *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HcprodR Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem HD).
  - (* cprodInjL *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH H1 IH1 E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HcprodL Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem H1 HD).
  - (* carrInjL *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH H1 IH1 E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
    exact (HcarrL Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem H1 HD).
  }
  intros Δ ψ H. exact (Haux Δ nil ψ H eq_refl).
Qed.

(* tctd uniqueness, needed below. *)
Lemma tctd_unique {Δ : Ctx kind} :
  forall (κ1 : kind) (τ : typ κ1 Δ) (κ2 : kind) (c2 : tctor κ2),
    tctd τ c2 ->
    forall (κ3 : kind) (c3 : tctor κ3), tctd τ c3 ->
      exists (E : κ2 = κ3), eq_rect κ2 (fun k => tctor k) c2 κ3 E = c3.
Proof.
  refine (tctd_ind Δ
    (fun κ1 τ κ2 c2 => forall κ3 c3, tctd τ c3 ->
       exists E : κ2 = κ3, eq_rect κ2 (fun k => tctor k) c2 κ3 E = c3)
    _ _).
  - intros κ c κ3 c3 H2. dependent destruction H2.
    + exists eq_refl. reflexivity.
  - intros κ κa κ' σ τ0 c HI IH κ3 c3 H2.
    dependent destruction H2.
    apply (IH _ _ H2).
Qed.


(* Same-head tctd derivations cannot be discriminable. *)
Lemma tctd_same_head_not_discr {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ κc : kind}
      (τ1 τ2 : typ κ Δ) (c : tctor κc) :
  tctd τ1 c -> tctd τ2 c -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False.
Proof.
  intros H1 H2 HD.
  dependent destruction HD.
  all: try (exfalso; eauto using tctd_carr_false, tctd_cprod_false).
  destruct (tctd_unique κ τ1 κ₁ c₁ HI₁ κc c H1) as [E1 Hc1].
  destruct E1. simpl in Hc1.
  destruct (tctd_unique κ τ2 κ₂ c₂ HI₂ κ₁ c H2) as [E2 Hc2].
  destruct E2. simpl in Hc2.
  rewrite Hc1 in HD. rewrite Hc2 in HD.
  exact (cdiscrK_self c HD).
Qed.


Lemma HappL_proved : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κa κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),
  tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
  nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (σ1 ≃ σ2) -> False.
Proof.
  intros. exact (tctd_same_head_not_discr σ1 σ2 c H H0 H2).
Qed.

Corollary Hdiscr_of_six
  (Htrans : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind) (τ1 τ2 τ3 : typ κ Δ),
      nil ⊩ τ1 ≃ τ2 -> nil ⊩ τ2 ≃ τ3 -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ3) -> False)
  (HappR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κa κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),
      tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HcarrR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_carr ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_carr ψ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HcprodR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_cprod ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_cprod ψ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False)
  (HcarrL : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_carr ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_carr ψ2 τ2) -> nil ⊩ ψ1 -> ⊮ ψ2 -> False)
  (HcprodL : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ1 ψ2 : constr Δ) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (t_cprod ψ1 τ1) ≃ (t_cprod ψ2 τ2) -> nil ⊩ ψ1 -> ⊮ ψ2 -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (ψ : constr Δ), nil ⊩ ψ -> ⊮ ψ -> False.
Proof.
  intros. eapply Hdiscr_of_hard; eauto using HappL_proved.
Qed.

(* The transitivity hard case at base kind follows from the appInjR hard case. *)
Lemma Htrans_star_of_HappR
  (HappR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κa κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ κa Δ),
      tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (τ1 τ2 τ3 : typ ⋆ Δ),
    nil ⊩ τ1 ≃ τ2 -> nil ⊩ τ2 ≃ τ3 -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ3) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ τ1 τ2 τ3 H12 H23 HD.
  assert (H13 : nil ⊩ τ1 ≃ τ3) by (eapply tpi_trans; eauto).
  set (σ := @t_ctor Δ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) tc_arr).
  assert (Happ : nil ⊩ (σ τ1) ≃ (σ τ3)).
  { eapply tpi_app. apply tpi_ctor. exact H13. }
  eapply (HappR Δ ⋆ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) σ σ tc_arr τ1 τ3).
  - apply inj_ctor.
  - apply inj_ctor.
  - exact Happ.
  - exact HD.
Qed.

Inductive rargs (Δ : Ctx kind) : kind -> kind -> Type :=
| rargs_nil {κ} : rargs Δ κ κ
| rargs_cons {κ κa κr : kind} (pre : rargs Δ κ (κa ⇒ κr)) (u : typ κa Δ) :
    rargs Δ κ κr.

Arguments rargs_nil {Δ κ}.
Arguments rargs_cons {Δ κ κa κr}.

Fixpoint rargs_apply {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ κ₂ : kind} (a : typ κ Δ) (args : rargs Δ κ κ₂)
    {struct args} : typ κ₂ Δ :=
  match args as ar in rargs _ k1 k2 return typ k1 Δ -> typ k2 Δ with
  | rargs_nil => fun a => a
  | rargs_cons pre u => fun a => rargs_apply a pre u
  end a.

Inductive kind_reach : kind -> kind -> Type :=
| kr_refl (k : kind) : kind_reach k k
| kr_step {a r k2 : kind} : kind_reach r k2 -> kind_reach (a ⇒ r) k2.

Lemma kind_reach_cod {κ k2 : kind} (H : kind_reach κ k2) :
  forall κa κr : kind, k2 = κa ⇒ κr -> kind_reach κ κr.
Proof.
  induction H as [k | a r k2 Hpre IH]; intros κa κr E.
  - rewrite E. apply (@kr_step κa κr κr). apply kr_refl.
  - apply (@kr_step a r κr). apply (IH κa κr E).
Qed.

Lemma kind_reach_size {κ κ₂ : kind} (H : kind_reach κ κ₂) :
  kind_size κ₂ <= kind_size κ.
Proof.
  induction H as [k | a r k2 Hpre IH].
  - lia.
  - simpl in *. lia.
Qed.



Lemma kind_reach_cod_det {κ κa κa' κr : kind}

Lemma Hdiscr_any_of_star
  (Hstar : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ A ≃ B -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False) :
  forall (κ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ κ Δ),
    nil ⊩ A ≃ B -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False.
Proof.
  induction κ as [| κa κr IH]; intros Δ A B H HD.
  - exact (Hstar Δ A B H HD).
  - set (Δ' := extC κa Δ).
    set (A' := tmap (mkShift κa Δ) A).
    set (B' := tmap (mkShift κa Δ) B).
    assert (H' : nil ⊩ (A' ≃ B')).
    { change (nil ⊩ cmap (mkShift κa Δ) (c_eq (κa ⇒ κr) A B)).
      apply (tproves_tmap Δ nil (c_eq (κa ⇒ κr) A B) H (extC κa Δ) (mkShift κa Δ)). }
    assert (HD' : ⊮ (A' ≃ B')).
    { change (⊮ cmap (mkShift κa Δ) (c_eq (κa ⇒ κr) A B)).
      apply (tdiscr_cmap Δ (c_eq (κa ⇒ κr) A B) HD (extC κa Δ) (mkShift κa Δ)). }
    set (x := @t_var (extC κa Δ) κa VZ eq_refl).
    assert (Hx : nil ⊩ (x ≃ x)) by (apply (tproves_refl κa (extC κa Δ) nil x)).
    assert (Happ : nil ⊩ ((A' x) ≃ (B' x))).
    { eapply tpi_app; [ exact H' | exact Hx ]. }
    assert (HDapp : ⊮ ((A' x) ≃ (B' x)))
      by (apply (tdiscr_app_same_arg A' B' x HD')).
    exact (IH (extC κa Δ) (A' x) (B' x) Happ HDapp).
Qed.
EOF

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Context-indexed normal forms.                                      *)

Fixpoint ins_at (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) : list kind :=
  match r, Γ with
  | 0, _ => κ :: Γ
  | S r', nil => κ :: nil
  | S r', k :: Γ' => k :: ins_at r' κ Γ'
  end.

Lemma length_ins_at (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
  length (ins_at r κ Γ) = S (length Γ).
Proof.
  revert r. induction Γ as [|k Γ' IH]; intros r.
  - destruct r; reflexivity.
  - destruct r; simpl; [reflexivity| apply IH].
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_ins_at_lt (r i : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
  i < r -> nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) i = nth_error Γ i.
Proof.
  revert i Γ. induction r as [|r IH]; intros i Γ Hlt.
  - lia.
  - destruct Γ as [|k Γ']; destruct i as [|i]; simpl in *.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + reflexivity.
    + apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_ins_at_eq (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
  r <= length Γ ->
  nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) r = Some κ.
Proof.
  revert Γ. induction r as [|r IH]; intros Γ Hle.
  - destruct Γ; reflexivity.
  - destruct Γ as [|k Γ']; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_ins_at_gt (r i : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
  r < i ->
  nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) i = nth_error Γ (i - 1).
Proof.
  revert i Γ. induction r as [|r IH]; intros i Γ Hlt.
  - destruct Γ as [|k Γ']; destruct i as [|i]; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + reflexivity.
    + lia.
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct Γ as [|k Γ']; destruct i as [|i]; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma nth_ins_target_kind (r : nat) (κ κd : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
  r <= length Γ ->
  nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) r = Some κd -> κd = κ.
Proof.
  intros Hle H. rewrite nth_error_ins_at_eq in H by exact Hle.
  injection H as H. symmetry. exact H.
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax Lang.FOmegaEq.Typing Lang.FOmegaEq.OpSemantics.
Require Import Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).
Import kindEqDec.
Local Open Scope typ_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A minimal beta-reduction relation, used to state the SN/Tait target. *)
(* Constraints inside carr/cprod are treated opaquely: beta never steps
   inside a constraint, which is sound for the tdiscr model we need.     *)

Inductive bstep {Δ : Ctx kind} : forall {κ : kind}, typ κ Δ -> typ κ Δ -> Prop :=
| bstep_beta {κa κr : kind} (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) (a : typ κa Δ) :
    bstep ((t_lam b) a) (subst b a)
| bstep_app_l {κa κr : kind} {f f' : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ} (a : typ κa Δ) :
    bstep f f' -> bstep (f a) (f' a)
| bstep_app_r {κa κr : kind} (f : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) {a a' : typ κa Δ} :
    bstep a a' -> bstep (f a) (f a')
| bstep_lam {κa κr : kind} {b b' : typ κr (extC κa Δ)} :
    bstep b b' -> bstep (t_lam b) (t_lam b')
| bstep_carr {ψ : constr Δ} {a a' : typ ⋆ Δ} :
    bstep a a' -> bstep (t_carr ψ a) (t_carr ψ a')
| bstep_cprod {ψ : constr Δ} {a a' : typ ⋆ Δ} :
    bstep a a' -> bstep (t_cprod ψ a) (t_cprod ψ a').

Definition SN {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (τ : typ κ Δ) : Prop :=
  Acc (@bstep Δ κ) τ.

Lemma SN_bstep {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} {τ τ' : typ κ Δ} :
  SN τ -> bstep τ τ' -> SN τ'.
Proof.
  intros H Hstep. exact (Acc_inv H Hstep).
Qed.

(* The standard Tait candidate at base is SN.  Note: this alone does not
   separate constructor heads; it only gives termination. *)
Fixpoint Red {Δ : Ctx kind} (κ : kind) (τ : typ κ Δ) : Prop :=
  match κ with
  | KTyp => SN τ
  | KArr κa κr => forall (a : typ κa Δ), Red κa a -> Red κr (τ a)
  end.

(* A few genuinely proved SN facts. *)
Lemma SN_ctor {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (c : tctor κ) : SN (@t_ctor Δ κ c).
Proof.
  constructor. intros τ' Hstep. dependent destruction Hstep.
Qed.

Lemma SN_var {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ) :
  SN (@t_var Δ κ x EQ).
Proof.
  constructor. intros τ' Hstep. dependent destruction Hstep.
Qed.

Lemma Red_ctor_star {Δ : Ctx kind} (c : tctor ⋆) : Red ⋆ (@t_ctor Δ ⋆ c).
Proof. apply SN_ctor. Qed.

Lemma Red_var_star {Δ : Ctx kind} (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = ⋆) :
  Red ⋆ (@t_var Δ ⋆ x EQ).
Proof. apply SN_var. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Exact equivalence of the base fact with HappR_star.                  *)

Lemma HappR_star_of_Hstar
  (Hstar : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (A ≃ B) -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κr κc : kind)
         (σ1 σ2 : typ (⋆ ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
    tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
    nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ κr κc σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 H HD.
  exact (Hstar Δ τ1 τ2 (tpi_appInjR HI1 HI2 H) HD).
Qed.

Lemma Hstar_of_HappR_star
  (HappR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (⋆ ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
    nil ⊩ (A ≃ B) -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ A B H HD.
  set (σ := @t_ctor Δ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) tc_arr).
  assert (Happ : nil ⊩ (σ A) ≃ (σ B)).
  { eapply tpi_app. apply tpi_ctor. exact H. }
  eapply (HappR Δ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) σ σ tc_arr A B).
  - apply inj_ctor.
  - apply inj_ctor.
  - exact Happ.
  - exact HD.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* What a normalization/Tait model would have to provide.               *)
(* `nf` is intended to be a beta(-eta) normalizer.  The first obligation
   is soundness for nil tproves; the second is head separation, which SN
   alone (Red at base = SN) does NOT give.                              *)

Definition Normalizer := forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind), typ κ Δ -> typ κ Δ.

Definition nf_sound (nf : Normalizer) : Prop :=
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
    nil ⊩ (A ≃ B) -> nf Δ ⋆ A = nf Δ ⋆ B.

Definition nf_separates (nf : Normalizer) : Prop :=
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
    ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> nf Δ ⋆ A <> nf Δ ⋆ B.

Lemma Hstar_of_normalizer
  (nf : Normalizer) (Hs : nf_sound nf) (Hd : nf_separates nf) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
    nil ⊩ (A ≃ B) -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ A B H HD.
  exact (Hd Δ A B HD (Hs Δ A B H)).
Qed.

(* Key remaining research gap: construct `nf` and prove `nf_sound` and

   weak for `nf_separates`: distinct constructor heads are all SN.
   The context-indexed hereditary-substitution/total-NBE route is needed
   (or an equivalent semantic model). *)
EOF

Require Import Lang.FOmegaEq.Types Lang.FOmegaEq.Kinds Lang.FOmegaEq.Syntax Lang.FOmegaEq.Typing Lang.FOmegaEq.OpSemantics.
Require Import Binding.Intrinsic Binding.Lib Binding.Env.
Require Import Stdlib.Program.Equality.
Import Binding.Intrinsic (Ctx, dom, extC, Build_Ctx, mtC).
Import kindEqDec.
Local Open Scope typ_scope.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A minimal beta-reduction relation, used to state the SN/Tait target. *)
(* Constraints inside carr/cprod are treated opaquely: beta never steps
   inside a constraint, which is sound for the tdiscr model we need.     *)

Inductive bstep {Δ : Ctx kind} : forall {κ : kind}, typ κ Δ -> typ κ Δ -> Prop :=
| bstep_beta {κa κr : kind} (b : typ κr (extC κa Δ)) (a : typ κa Δ) :
    bstep ((t_lam b) a) (subst b a)
| bstep_app_l {κa κr : kind} {f f' : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ} (a : typ κa Δ) :
    bstep f f' -> bstep (f a) (f' a)
| bstep_app_r {κa κr : kind} (f : typ (κa ⇒ κr) Δ) {a a' : typ κa Δ} :
    bstep a a' -> bstep (f a) (f a')
| bstep_lam {κa κr : kind} {b b' : typ κr (extC κa Δ)} :
    bstep b b' -> bstep (t_lam b) (t_lam b')
| bstep_carr {ψ : constr Δ} {a a' : typ ⋆ Δ} :
    bstep a a' -> bstep (t_carr ψ a) (t_carr ψ a')
| bstep_cprod {ψ : constr Δ} {a a' : typ ⋆ Δ} :
    bstep a a' -> bstep (t_cprod ψ a) (t_cprod ψ a').

Definition SN {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (τ : typ κ Δ) : Prop :=
  Acc (fun (x y : typ κ Δ) => @bstep Δ κ y x) τ.

Lemma SN_bstep {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} {τ τ' : typ κ Δ} :
  SN τ -> bstep τ τ' -> SN τ'.
Proof.
  intros H Hstep. destruct H as [Hacc]. apply Hacc. exact Hstep.
Qed.

(* The standard Tait candidate at base is SN.  Note: this alone does not
   separate constructor heads; it only gives termination. *)
Fixpoint Red {Δ : Ctx kind} (κ : kind) : typ κ Δ -> Prop :=
  match κ as k return typ k Δ -> Prop with
  | KTyp => fun τ => SN τ
  | KArr κa κr => fun τ => forall (a : typ κa Δ), Red κa a -> Red κr (τ a)
  end.

(* A few genuinely proved SN facts. *)
Lemma SN_ctor {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (c : tctor κ) : SN (@t_ctor Δ κ c).
Proof.
  constructor. intros τ' Hstep. dependent destruction Hstep.
Qed.

Lemma SN_var {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ : kind} (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = κ) :
  SN (@t_var Δ κ x EQ).
Proof.
  constructor. intros τ' Hstep. dependent destruction Hstep.
Qed.

Lemma Red_ctor_star {Δ : Ctx kind} (c : tctor ⋆) : Red ⋆ (@t_ctor Δ ⋆ c).
Proof. apply SN_ctor. Qed.

Lemma Red_var_star {Δ : Ctx kind} (x : dom Δ) (EQ : Δ x = ⋆) :
  Red ⋆ (@t_var Δ ⋆ x EQ).
Proof. apply SN_var. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Exact equivalence of the base fact with HappR_star.                  *)

Lemma HappR_star_of_Hstar
  (Hstar : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
      nil ⊩ (A ≃ B) -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κr κc : kind)
         (σ1 σ2 : typ (⋆ ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
    tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
    nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ κr κc σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 H HD.
  exact (Hstar Δ τ1 τ2 (tpi_appInjR HI1 HI2 H) HD).
Qed.

Lemma Hstar_of_HappR_star
  (HappR : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κr κc : kind)
      (σ1 σ2 : typ (⋆ ⇒ κr) Δ) (c : tctor κc) (τ1 τ2 : typ ⋆ Δ),
      tctd σ1 c -> tctd σ2 c ->
      nil ⊩ (σ1 τ1) ≃ (σ2 τ2) -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
    nil ⊩ (A ≃ B) -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ A B H HD.
  set (σ := @t_ctor Δ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) tc_arr).
  assert (Happ : nil ⊩ (σ A) ≃ (σ B)).
  { eapply tpi_app. apply tpi_ctor. exact H. }
  eapply (HappR Δ (⋆ ⇒ ⋆) (⋆ ⇒ ⋆ ⇒ ⋆) σ σ tc_arr A B).
  - apply inj_ctor.
  - apply inj_ctor.
  - exact Happ.
  - exact HD.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* What a normalization/Tait model would have to provide.               *)
(* `nf` is intended to be a beta(-eta) normalizer.  The first obligation
   is soundness for nil tproves; the second is head separation, which SN
   alone (Red at base = SN) does NOT give.                              *)

Definition Normalizer := forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (κ : kind), typ κ Δ -> typ κ Δ.

Definition nf_sound (nf : Normalizer) : Prop :=
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
    nil ⊩ (A ≃ B) -> nf Δ ⋆ A = nf Δ ⋆ B.

Definition nf_separates (nf : Normalizer) : Prop :=
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
    ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> nf Δ ⋆ A <> nf Δ ⋆ B.

Lemma Hstar_of_normalizer
  (nf : Normalizer) (Hs : nf_sound nf) (Hd : nf_separates nf) :
  forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
    nil ⊩ (A ≃ B) -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Δ A B H HD.
  exact (Hd Δ A B HD (Hs Δ A B H)).
Qed.

(* Key remaining research gap: construct `nf` and prove `nf_sound` and
   `nf_separates`.  In particular, note that Red ⋆ τ = SN τ is far too
   weak for `nf_separates`: distinct constructor heads are all SN.
   The context-indexed hereditary-substitution/total-NBE route is needed
   (or an equivalent semantic model). *)

nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) r = Some κd -> κd = κ.
Proof.
  intros Hle H. rewrite nth_error_ins_at_eq in H by exact Hle.
  injection H as H. symmetry. exact H.
Qed.

Inductive inf (Γ : list kind) : kind -> Type :=
| inf_lam {κa κr : kind} (b : inf (κa :: Γ) κr) : inf Γ (κa ⇒ κr)
| inf_neu {κ : kind} (s : isp Γ κ) : inf Γ κ
| inf_carr (c : icon Γ) (t : inf Γ ⋆) : inf Γ ⋆
| inf_cprod (c : icon Γ) (t : inf Γ ⋆) : inf Γ ⋆
with isp (Γ : list kind) : kind -> Type :=
| isp_bvar {κ : kind} (i : nat) (H : nth_error Γ i = Some κ) : isp Γ κ
| isp_fvar {κ : kind} (x : nat) : isp Γ κ
| isp_ctor {κ : kind} (c : tctor κ) : isp Γ κ
| isp_app {κ1 κ2 : kind} (s : isp Γ (κ1 ⇒ κ2)) (a : inf Γ κ1) : isp Γ κ2
with icon (Γ : list kind) : Type :=
| icon_eq (κ : kind) (a b : inf Γ κ) : icon Γ.

Arguments inf Γ : clear implicits.
Arguments isp Γ : clear implicits.
Arguments icon Γ : clear implicits.
Arguments inf_lam {Γ κa κr}.
Arguments inf_neu {Γ κ}.
Arguments inf_carr {Γ}.
Arguments inf_cprod {Γ}.
Arguments isp_bvar {Γ κ}.
Arguments isp_fvar {Γ κ}.
Arguments isp_ctor {Γ κ}.
Arguments isp_app {Γ κ1 κ2}.
Arguments icon_eq {Γ}.

Scheme inf_mutind := Induction for inf Sort Prop
with isp_mutind := Induction for isp Sort Prop
with icon_mutind := Induction for icon Sort Prop.

Fixpoint ins_list_at (c : nat) (d Γ : list kind) : list kind :=
  match c, Γ with
  | 0, _ => d ++ Γ
  | S c', nil => d
  | S c', k :: Γ' => k :: ins_list_at c' d Γ'
  end.

Lemma ins_list_at_eq (c : nat) (d Γ : list kind) :
  c <= length Γ -> ins_list_at c d Γ = firstn c Γ ++ d ++ skipn c Γ.
Proof.
  revert Γ. induction c as [|c IH]; intros Γ Hc.
  - destruct Γ; reflexivity.
  - destruct Γ as [|k Γ']; [simpl in Hc; lia|].
    simpl in Hc. simpl. rewrite IH by lia. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_ins_list_lt (c i : nat) (d Γ : list kind) :
  i < c -> c <= length Γ ->
  nth_error (ins_list_at c d Γ) i = nth_error Γ i.
Proof.
  intros Hi Hc. rewrite ins_list_at_eq by exact Hc.
  assert (Hlen : i < length (firstn c Γ)) by (rewrite length_firstn; lia).
  rewrite nth_error_app1 by exact Hlen.
  rewrite nth_error_firstn.
  replace (Nat.ltb i c) with true by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_lt; exact Hi).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_ins_list_ge (c i : nat) (d Γ : list kind) :
  c <= i -> c <= length Γ ->
  nth_error (ins_list_at c d Γ) (i + length d) = nth_error Γ i.
Proof.
  intros Hi Hc. rewrite ins_list_at_eq by exact Hc.
  rewrite app_assoc.
  assert (Hlen : length (firstn c Γ ++ d) <= i + length d).
  { rewrite length_app, length_firstn. lia. }
  rewrite nth_error_app2 by exact Hlen.
  replace (Nat.add i (length d) - length (firstn c Γ ++ d)) with (Nat.sub i c) by (rewrite length_app, length_firstn; lia).
  rewrite nth_error_skipn.
  replace (Nat.add c (Nat.sub i c)) with i by lia.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint shift_inf (d : list kind) (c : nat) {Γ : list kind} (Hc : c <= length Γ)
    {κ : kind} (t : inf Γ κ) {struct t} : inf (ins_list_at c d Γ) κ


Definition cast_inf {Γ : list kind} {κ κ' : kind} (e : κ = κ') (t : inf Γ κ) : inf Γ κ' :=
  match e in (_ = z) return inf Γ z with eq_refl => t end.

Inductive iwalkres (Γ : list kind) (κ0 : kind) : kind -> Type :=
| iw_spine {κ : kind} (s : isp Γ κ) : iwalkres Γ κ0 κ
| iw_target {κ : kind} (v : inf Γ κ) (H : kind_cod κ κ0) : iwalkres Γ κ0 κ.

Arguments iw_spine {Γ κ0 κ}.
Arguments iw_target {Γ κ0 κ}.

Definition iwalkres_inf {Γ : list kind} {κ0 κ : kind} (r : iwalkres Γ κ0 κ) : inf Γ κ.
Proof.
  dependent destruction r.
  - exact (@inf_neu Γ κ s).
  - exact v.
Defined.

Definition iwalkres_app {Γ : list kind} {κ0 κ1 κ2 : kind}
    (kap : forall (Γ' : list kind) (k1 k2 : kind),
        inf Γ' (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) κ0 -> inf Γ' k1 -> inf Γ' k2)
    (r : iwalkres Γ κ0 (κ1 ⇒ κ2)) (a : inf Γ κ1) : iwalkres Γ κ0 κ2.
Proof.
  dependent destruction r.
  - exact (@iw_spine Γ κ0 κ2 (@isp_app Γ κ1 κ2 s a)).
  - exact (@iw_target Γ κ0 κ2 (kap Γ κ1 κ2 v H a) (kc_step H)).
Defined.

Definition le_cons (κa : kind) {Γ : list kind} {r : nat} (Hr : r <= length Γ) :
  S r <= length (κa :: Γ) := le_n_S r (length Γ) Hr.

Fixpoint walk_inf (Γ : list kind) (κ0 : kind) (r : nat) (Hr : r <= length Γ)
    (arg : inf Γ κ0)
    (kap : forall (Γ' : list kind) (k1 k2 : kind),
        inf Γ' (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) κ0 -> inf Γ' k1 -> inf Γ' k2)
    {κd : kind} (t : inf (ins_at r κ0 Γ) κd) {struct t} : inf Γ κd
with walk_isp (Γ : list kind) (κ0 : kind) (r : nat) (Hr : r <= length Γ)
    (arg : inf Γ κ0)
    (kap : forall (Γ' : list kind) (k1 k2 : kind),
        inf Γ' (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) κ0 -> inf Γ' k1 -> inf Γ' k2)
    {κd : kind} (sp : isp (ins_at r κ0 Γ) κd) {struct sp} : iwalkres Γ κ0 κd
with walk_icon (Γ : list kind) (κ0 : kind) (r : nat) (Hr : r <= length Γ)
    (arg : inf Γ κ0)
    (kap : forall (Γ' : list kind) (k1 k2 : kind),
        inf Γ' (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) κ0 -> inf Γ' k1 -> inf Γ' k2)
    (x : icon (ins_at r κ0 Γ)) {struct x} : icon Γ.
Proof.
  - destruct t as [κa κr b | κ sp | x t | x t].
    + (* lam *)
      exact (@inf_lam Γ κa κr
        (@walk_inf (κa :: Γ) κ0 (S r) (le_cons κa Hr)
           (@shift_inf (κa :: nil) 0 Γ (Nat.le_0_l (length Γ)) κ0 arg)
           kap κr b)).
    + (* neutral *)
      exact (@iwalkres_inf Γ κ0 κ (@walk_isp Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap κ sp)).
    + (* carr *)
      exact (@inf_carr Γ (@walk_icon Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap x)
               (@walk_inf Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap ⋆ t)).
    + (* cprod *)
      exact (@inf_cprod Γ (@walk_icon Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap x)
               (@walk_inf Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap ⋆ t)).
  - destruct sp as [κ i H | κ x | κ c0 | κ1 κ2 sp a].
    + (* bvar *)
      destruct (Nat.eq_dec i r) as [Ei|Ei].
      * subst i.
        pose proof (nth_ins_target_kind r κ0 κ Γ Hr H) as Heq.
        exact (@iw_target Γ κ0 κ
                 (cast_inf (eq_sym Heq) arg)
                 (match Heq in (_ = z) return kind_cod κ z with
                  | eq_refl => kc_refl κ
                  end)).
      * destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec i r) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt].
        -- exact (@iw_spine Γ κ0 κ
                   (@isp_bvar Γ κ i

        -- subst i. exfalso. apply Ei. reflexivity.
        -- exact (@iw_spine Γ κ0 κ
                   (@isp_bvar Γ κ (i - 1)

    + (* fvar *)
      exact (@iw_spine Γ κ0 κ (@isp_fvar Γ κ x)).
    + (* ctor *)
      exact (@iw_spine Γ κ0 κ (@isp_ctor Γ κ c0)).
    + (* app *)
      exact (@iwalkres_app Γ κ0 κ1 κ2 kap
               (@walk_isp Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap (κ1 ⇒ κ2) sp)
               (@walk_inf Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap κ1 a)).
  - destruct x as [κ a b]. exact (@icon_eq Γ κ

      (@walk_inf Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap κ b)).
Defined.

Arguments walk_inf Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap {κd} t.
Arguments walk_isp Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap {κd} sp.
Arguments walk_icon Γ κ0 r Hr arg kap x.

Record NArgI := {
  na_Γ : list kind;
  na_k0 : kind;
  na_arg : inf na_Γ na_k0;
Definition open_kap_body (a : NArgI)
    (recf : forall y : NArgI, in_kind_lt y a -> IRes y)
    (k1 k2 : kind) (H : kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) (na_k0 a))
    {Γ' : list kind} (v : inf Γ' (k1 ⇒ k2)) (a0 : inf Γ' k1) : inf Γ' k2.
Proof.
  dependent destruction v.
  - (* lambda *)
    exact (recf (Build_NArgI Γ' k1 a0 k2 v)
             (kind_size_dom_lt k1 k2 (na_k0 a) H)).
  - (* neutral *)
    exact (@inf_neu Γ' k2 (@isp_app Γ' k1 k2 s a0)).

Definition open_step (a : NArgI)
    (recf : forall y : NArgI, in_kind_lt y a -> IRes y) : IRes a.
Proof.
  destruct a as [Γ κ0 arg κd body].
  exact (@walk_inf Γ κ0 0 (Nat.le_0_l (length Γ)) arg
           (fun Γ' k1 k2 v H a0 => open_kap_body
              (Build_NArgI Γ κ0 arg κd body) recf k1 k2 H v a0)
           κd body).
Defined.

Definition open_fix : forall a : NArgI, IRes a :=
  Fix wf_in_kind_lt IRes open_step.

Definition open_inf (Γ : list kind) (κ0 : kind) (arg : inf Γ κ0)
    {κd : kind} (t : inf (κ0 :: Γ) κd) : inf Γ κd :=
  open_fix (Build_NArgI Γ κ0 arg κd t).

Fixpoint ins_at (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) : list kind :=
  match r, Γ with
  | 0, _ => κ :: Γ
  | S r', nil => κ :: nil
  | S r', k :: Γ' => k :: ins_at r' κ Γ'
  end.

Lemma length_ins_at (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
  length (ins_at r κ Γ) = S (length Γ).
Proof.
  revert r. induction Γ as [|k Γ' IH]; intros r.
  - destruct r; reflexivity.
  - destruct r; simpl; [reflexivity| rewrite IH; reflexivity].

172	      (fun (Δ : Ctx kind) (Ψ : list (constr Δ)) (ψ : constr Δ) =>
173	         Ψ = nil -> ⊮ ψ -> False)

199	    exact (HappL Δ0 κa κr κ σ1 σ2 c τ1 τ2 HI1 HI2 Hprem HD).
200	  - (* carrInjR *) intros Δ0 Ψ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem IH E0 HD. subst Ψ0.
201	    exact (HcarrR Δ0 ψ1 ψ2 τ1 τ2 Hprem HD).

212	(* tctd uniqueness, needed below. *)
213	Lemma tctd_unique {Δ : Ctx kind} :
214	  forall (κ1 : kind) (τ : typ κ1 Δ) (κ2 : kind) (c2 : tctor κ2),
215	    tctd τ c2 ->
216	    forall (κ3 : kind) (c3 : tctor κ3), tctd τ c3 ->
217	      exists (E : κ2 = κ3), eq_rect κ2 (fun k => tctor k) c2 κ3 E = c3.
218	Proof.
219	  refine (tctd_ind Δ
220	    (fun κ1 τ κ2 c2 => forall κ3 c3, tctd τ c3 ->
221	       exists E : κ2 = κ3, eq_rect κ2 (fun k => tctor k) c2 κ3 E = c3)
222	    _ _).
223	  - intros κ c κ3 c3 H2. dependent destruction H2.
224	    + exists eq_refl. reflexivity.
225	  - intros κ κa κ' σ τ0 c HI IH κ3 c3 H2.
226	    dependent destruction H2.
227	    apply (IH _ _ H2).
228	Qed.

232	Lemma tctd_same_head_not_discr {Δ : Ctx kind} {κ κc : kind}
233	      (τ1 τ2 : typ κ Δ) (c : tctor κc) :
234	  tctd τ1 c -> tctd τ2 c -> ⊮ (τ1 ≃ τ2) -> False.

236	  intros H1 H2 HD.

238	  all: try (exfalso; eauto using tctd_carr_false, tctd_cprod_false).

350	(* Reduce consistency at every kind to consistency at base kind. *)
351	Lemma Hdiscr_any_of_star
352	  (Hstar : forall (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ ⋆ Δ),
353	      nil ⊩ A ≃ B -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False) :
354	  forall (κ : kind) (Δ : Ctx kind) (A B : typ κ Δ),
355	    nil ⊩ A ≃ B -> ⊮ (A ≃ B) -> False.
356	Proof.
357	  induction κ as [| κa IHa κr IHr]; intros Δ A B H HD.
358	  - exact (Hstar Δ A B H HD).
359	  - set (Δ' := extC κa Δ).
360	    set (A' := tmap (mkShift κa Δ) A).
361	    set (B' := tmap (mkShift κa Δ) B).
362	    assert (H' : nil ⊩ (A' ≃ B')).
363	    { change (nil ⊩ cmap (mkShift κa Δ) (c_eq (κa ⇒ κr) A B)).
364	      apply (tproves_tmap Δ nil (c_eq (κa ⇒ κr) A B) H (extC κa Δ) (mkShift κa Δ)). }
365	    assert (HD' : ⊮ (A' ≃ B')).
366	    { change (⊮ cmap (mkShift κa Δ) (c_eq (κa ⇒ κr) A B)).
367	      apply (tdiscr_cmap Δ (c_eq (κa ⇒ κr) A B) HD (extC κa Δ) (mkShift κa Δ)). }
368	    set (x := @t_var (extC κa Δ) κa VZ eq_refl).
369	    assert (Hx : nil ⊩ (x ≃ x)) by (apply (tproves_refl κa (extC κa Δ) nil x)).
370	    assert (Happ : nil ⊩ ((A' x) ≃ (B' x))).
371	    { eapply tpi_app; [ exact H' | exact Hx ]. }
372	    assert (HDapp : ⊮ ((A' x) ≃ (B' x)))
373	      by (apply (tdiscr_app_same_arg A' B' x HD')).
374	    exact (IHr (extC κa Δ) (A' x) (B' x) Happ HDapp).
375	Qed.

35	Fixpoint ins_at (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) : list kind :=
36	  match r, Γ with
37	  | 0, _ => κ :: Γ
38	  | S r', nil => κ :: nil
39	  | S r', k :: Γ' => k :: ins_at r' κ Γ'
40	  end.

42	Lemma length_ins_at (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
43	  length (ins_at r κ Γ) = S (length Γ).
44	Proof.
45	  revert r. induction Γ as [|k Γ' IH]; intros r.
46	  - destruct r; reflexivity.
47	  - destruct r; simpl; [reflexivity| rewrite IH; reflexivity].
48	Qed.
49	
50	Lemma ins_at_eq (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
51	  r <= length Γ -> ins_at r κ Γ = firstn r Γ ++ κ :: skipn r Γ.
52	Proof.
53	  revert Γ. induction r as [|r IH]; intros Γ Hr.
54	  - destruct Γ; reflexivity.
55	  - destruct Γ as [|k Γ']; [simpl in Hr; lia|].
56	    simpl in Hr. simpl. f_equal. apply IH. lia.
57	Qed.
58	
59	Lemma nth_error_ins_at_lt (r i : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
60	  i < r -> r <= length Γ -> nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) i = nth_error Γ i.
61	Proof.
62	  intros Hlt Hr. rewrite ins_at_eq by exact Hr.
63	  assert (Hi : i < length (firstn r Γ)) by (rewrite length_firstn; lia).
64	  rewrite nth_error_app1 by exact Hi.
65	  rewrite nth_error_firstn.
66	  replace (Nat.ltb i r) with true by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_lt; exact Hlt).
67	  reflexivity.
68	Qed.
69	
70	Lemma nth_error_ins_at_eq (r : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
71	  r <= length Γ -> nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) r = Some κ.
72	Proof.
73	  intro Hr. rewrite ins_at_eq by exact Hr.
74	  replace (Nat.ltb r (length (firstn r Γ))) with false.
75	  2: { symmetry. apply Nat.ltb_ge. rewrite length_firstn. lia. }
76	  rewrite nth_error_app2 by (rewrite length_firstn; lia).
77	  replace (r - length (firstn r Γ)) with 0 by (rewrite length_firstn; lia).
78	  reflexivity.
79	Qed.
80	
81	Lemma nth_error_ins_at_gt (r i : nat) (κ : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
82	  r < i -> r <= length Γ -> nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) i = nth_error Γ (i - 1).
83	Proof.
84	  intros Hlt Hr. rewrite ins_at_eq by exact Hr.
85	  replace (Nat.ltb i (length (firstn r Γ))) with false.
86	  2: { symmetry. apply Nat.ltb_ge. rewrite length_firstn. lia. }
87	  rewrite nth_error_app2 by (rewrite length_firstn; lia).
88	  replace (i - length (firstn r Γ)) with (i - r) by (rewrite length_firstn; lia).
89	  remember (i - r) as d eqn:Ed.
90	  assert (Hpos : 0 < d) by lia.
91	  destruct d as [|m]; [lia|].
92	  simpl.
93	  rewrite nth_error_skipn.
94	  replace (Nat.add r m) with (i - 1) by lia.
95	  reflexivity.
96	Qed.
97	
98	Lemma nth_ins_target_kind (r : nat) (κ κd : kind) (Γ : list kind) :
99	  r <= length Γ ->
100	  nth_error (ins_at r κ Γ) r = Some κd -> κd = κ.
101	Proof.
102	  intros Hle H. rewrite nth_error_ins_at_eq in H by exact Hle.
103	  injection H as H. symmetry. exact H.
104	Qed.

106	Inductive inf (Γ : list kind) : kind -> Type :=
107	| inf_lam {κa κr : kind} (b : inf (κa :: Γ) κr) : inf Γ (κa ⇒ κr)
108	| inf_neu {κ : kind} (s : isp Γ κ) : inf Γ κ
109	| inf_carr (c : icon Γ) (t : inf Γ ⋆) : inf Γ ⋆
110	| inf_cprod (c : icon Γ) (t : inf Γ ⋆) : inf Γ ⋆
111	with isp (Γ : list kind) : kind -> Type :=
112	| isp_bvar {κ : kind} (i : nat) (H : nth_error Γ i = Some κ) : isp Γ κ
113	| isp_fvar {κ : kind} (x : nat) : isp Γ κ
114	| isp_ctor {κ : kind} (c : tctor κ) : isp Γ κ
115	| isp_app {κ1 κ2 : kind} (s : isp Γ (κ1 ⇒ κ2)) (a : inf Γ κ1) : isp Γ κ2
116	with icon (Γ : list kind) : Type :=
117	| icon_eq (κ : kind) (a b : inf Γ κ) : icon Γ.

136	Fixpoint ins_list_at (c : nat) (d Γ : list kind) : list kind :=
137	  match c, Γ with
138	  | 0, _ => d ++ Γ
139	  | S c', nil => d
140	  | S c', k :: Γ' => k :: ins_list_at c' d Γ'
141	  end.

143	Lemma ins_list_at_eq (c : nat) (d Γ : list kind) :
144	  c <= length Γ -> ins_list_at c d Γ = firstn c Γ ++ d ++ skipn c Γ.
145	Proof.
146	  revert Γ. induction c as [|c IH]; intros Γ Hc.
147	  - destruct Γ; reflexivity.
148	  - destruct Γ as [|k Γ']; [simpl in Hc; lia|].
149	    simpl in Hc. simpl. rewrite IH by lia. reflexivity.
150	Qed.
151	
152	Lemma nth_error_ins_list_lt (c i : nat) (d Γ : list kind) :
153	  i < c -> c <= length Γ ->
154	  nth_error (ins_list_at c d Γ) i = nth_error Γ i.
155	Proof.
156	  intros Hi Hc. rewrite ins_list_at_eq by exact Hc.
157	  assert (Hlen : i < length (firstn c Γ)) by (rewrite length_firstn; lia).
158	  rewrite nth_error_app1 by exact Hlen.
159	  rewrite nth_error_firstn.
160	  replace (Nat.ltb i c) with true by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_lt; exact Hi).
161	  reflexivity.
162	Qed.
163	
164	Lemma nth_error_ins_list_ge (c i : nat) (d Γ : list kind) :
165	  c <= i -> c <= length Γ ->
166	  nth_error (ins_list_at c d Γ) (i + length d) = nth_error Γ i.
167	Proof.
168	  intros Hi Hc. rewrite ins_list_at_eq by exact Hc.
169	  rewrite app_assoc.
170	  assert (Hlen : length (firstn c Γ ++ d) <= i + length d).
171	  { rewrite length_app, length_firstn. lia. }
172	  rewrite nth_error_app2 by exact Hlen.
173	  replace (Nat.add i (length d) - length (firstn c Γ ++ d)) with (Nat.sub i c) by (rewrite length_app, length_firstn; lia).
174	  rewrite nth_error_skipn.
175	  replace (Nat.add c (Nat.sub i c)) with i by lia.
176	  reflexivity.
177	Qed.

179	Fixpoint shift_inf (d : list kind) (c : nat) {Γ : list kind} (Hc : c <= length Γ)
180	    {κ : kind} (t : inf Γ κ) {struct t} : inf (ins_list_at c d Γ) κ
181	with shift_isp (d : list kind) (c : nat) {Γ : list kind} (Hc : c <= length Γ)
182	    {κ : kind} (sp : isp Γ κ) {struct sp} : isp (ins_list_at c d Γ) κ
183	with shift_icon (d : list kind) (c : nat) {Γ : list kind} (Hc : c <= length Γ)
184	    (x : icon Γ) {struct x} : icon (ins_list_at c d Γ).
185	Proof.
186	  - destruct t as [κa κr b | κ sp | x t | x t].
187	    + (* lam: insert d after the binder *)
188	      apply (@inf_lam (ins_list_at c d Γ) κa κr).
189	      (* body source context is κa :: Γ; shift with cutoff S c *)
190	      exact (@shift_inf d (S c) (κa :: Γ) ltac:(simpl; lia) κr b).
191	    + apply inf_neu. exact (@shift_isp d c Γ Hc κ sp).
192	    + apply inf_carr.
193	      * exact (@shift_icon d c Γ Hc x).
194	      * exact (@shift_inf d c Γ Hc ⋆ t).
195	    + apply inf_cprod.
196	      * exact (@shift_icon d c Γ Hc x).
197	      * exact (@shift_inf d c Γ Hc ⋆ t).
198	  - destruct sp as [κ i H | κ x | κ c0 | κ1 κ2 sp a].
199	    + (* bvar: shift indices at or after cutoff *)
200	      destruct (Nat.leb c i) eqn:E.
201	      * apply Nat.leb_le in E.
202	        apply isp_bvar with (i := Nat.add i (length d)).
203	        etransitivity; [ exact (nth_error_ins_list_ge c i d Γ E Hc) | exact H ].
204	      * apply Nat.leb_gt in E.
205	        apply isp_bvar with (i := i).
206	        etransitivity; [ exact (nth_error_ins_list_lt c i d Γ E Hc) | exact H ].
207	    + apply isp_fvar. exact x.
208	    + apply isp_ctor. exact c0.
209	    + exact (@isp_app (ins_list_at c d Γ) κ1 κ2
210	                (@shift_isp d c Γ Hc (κ1 ⇒ κ2) sp)
211	                (@shift_inf d c Γ Hc κ1 a)).
212	  - destruct x as [κ a b].
213	    exact (@icon_eq (ins_list_at c d Γ) κ
214	             (@shift_inf d c Γ Hc κ a) (@shift_inf d c Γ Hc κ b)).
215	Defined.
216	
217	Arguments shift_inf d c {Γ} Hc {κ} t.
218	Arguments shift_isp d c {Γ} Hc {κ} sp.
219	Arguments shift_icon d c {Γ} Hc x.

226	| iw_spine {κ : kind} (s : isp Γ κ) : iwalkres Γ κ0 κ
227	| iw_target {κ : kind} (v : inf Γ κ) (H : kind_cod κ κ0) : iwalkres Γ κ0 κ.

232	Definition iwalkres_inf {Γ : list kind} {κ0 κ : kind} (r : iwalkres Γ κ0 κ) : inf Γ κ.

236	  - exact v.

239	Definition iwalkres_app {Γ : list kind} {κ0 κ1 κ2 : kind}
240	    (kap : forall (Γ' : list kind) (k1 k2 : kind),
241	        inf Γ' (k1 ⇒ k2) -> kind_cod (k1 ⇒ k2) κ0 -> inf Γ' k1 -> inf Γ' k2)
242	    (r : iwalkres Γ κ0 (κ1 ⇒ κ2)) (a : inf Γ κ1) : iwalkres Γ κ0 κ2.
243	Proof.
244	  dependent destruction r.
245	  - exact (@iw_spine Γ κ0 κ2 (@isp_app Γ κ1 κ2 s a)).
246	  - exact (@iw_target Γ κ0 κ2 (kap Γ κ1 κ2 v H a) (kc_step H)).
247	Defined.
